Desc_389.cn: 亦刀亦剑之法讲究“刀作剑形、剑走刀势”，运使者可融刀之刚猛与剑之灵动为一体，使之相辅相成，变化不定。
Desc_389.ru: Эта техника сочетает в себе устрашающую силу Клинка с гибкостью Меча, поэтому те, кто практикует ее, могут поражать своего противника непредсказуемыми атаками.

Desc_390.en: The key to the array is coordination between its practitioners as they must move in unison with meticulous precision to spread out when evading enemies or concentrating their forces like a mighty sword.
Desc_390.cn: 元山七煞阵之要，在于同心戮力，一往无前，列阵者法度严谨，同进同退，散如星火燎原，聚若宝剑除妖。

Desc_391.en: Those who practice it must train themselves in a room full of hanging golden blades by striking the sharp edges only with their palms, until they are skilled enough to predict the movement of the blades and prevent injuries.
Desc_391.cn: “幽洞不拘金锁意，纵横无系去还来”。金刀换掌功乃是在群刀倒挂的金刀阵中练成，修习者不假外力，仅以肉掌相抗，久而久之，便可达到“明辨刀势、沾而不伤”的境界。

Desc_392.en: Legend has it that Sakyamuni once threw an elephant into the air which didn't land until three days later. The technique is based on one's Bodhicitta and diligent training, and those who practice it may have overwhelming strength like the Buddha.
Desc_392.cn: 相传释迦牟尼为太子时，曾将大象掷向高空，其后三日，象方坠地。释迦掷象功以道心为因，苦修为本，可令人身心具足，迸发巨力。

Desc_393.en: This divination technique has been passed down among generations of astrologers, and those who practice it have the ability to divine weather, fortune, and even life and death.
Desc_393.cn: 太卜掌三兆、三易、三梦之法，主天子卜筮。太卜玄典奥妙精微，乃古之卜者所传，可令人通晓方位运转、来去吉凶、死生变化。
Desc_393.ru: Эта техника гадания передавалась из поколения в поколение астрологами, и те, кто ее практикует, обладают способностью предсказывать погоду, удачу и даже жизнь и смерть.

Desc_394.en: In the beginning there was nothingness, and it had no name. From the beginning, there was something but without form. The great way of Taichu Rehidden connects to the beginning of the universe without revealing all of its secrets. Those who practice it can advance endlessly into the infinite expanse of the universe, or defend themselves with impregnable forces.
Desc_394.cn: “太初有无，无有无名。一之所起，有一而未形”。太初归藏诀诀未道尽，法不用全，却通万物之始，成一气之初，修习者能成未成之功，进之无穷，退之不灭。

Desc_395.en: One must hit the skull with hard objects to practice this Lion-Face Clan skill until their scalp is as hard and impenetrable as iron. However without the protection of True Qi, a beginner may suffer from serious injuries and bleeding.
Desc_395.cn: 狮相铁头功需以硬物击打头颅方可练成，此功虽可使人头坚似铁，刀枪不入，但初学者若无真气护体，则难免头破血流。

Desc_396.en: Speed is the key to military success. Impetuous Rush is a set of techniques for both offense and defense that depends on speed instead of skill. Those who practice it must move swiftly with great resolution and determination.
Desc_396.cn: 正所谓：“兵闻拙速，未睹巧之久也”。兵闻拙速讲究“以速取胜，不用计巧，攻而必取，动则不迷”，既是用兵之法，亦可为存身之道。

Desc_397.en: Strength Substitution is a set of techniques from the Lion-Face Clan with Yin energy on the inside and Yang on the outside, which protects the soft internal forces with powerful external strength.
Desc_397.cn: “困敌之势，不以战；损刚益柔”。损刚益柔讲究“内阴而外阳，内柔而外刚”，乃狮相门以刚护柔、以实应虚的横练之法。
Desc_397.ru: Замещение Силы - это набор техник Клана Львинолицых с Энергией Инь внутри и Ян снаружи, который защищает мягкие внутренние силы мощной внешней Силой.

Desc_398.en: Ding-heaving Might is a set of martial arts from the Lion-Face Clan that trains one's external strength. Its practitioner can exert immense force with their muscles to lift a cauldron that weighs hundreds of kilos.
Desc_398.cn: 霸王举鼎刚猛无俦，乃狮相门外壮之法，运功者力从筋起，节节发劲，举重若轻，勇武过人，如有霸王拔山盖世之姿。

Desc_399.en: Those who practice Lion's Roar must let out a drawn-out and thunderous roar when injured, and with rich internal Qi forces, the roar can reach li away and intimidate all creatures.
Desc_399.cn: 狮啸功气势惊人，需借伤残之势而发，运功者引吭长啸，隐隐如雷，若由内力淳厚者施为，则数里之外犹有回响，闻者无不震怖。
Desc_399.ru: Те, кто практикует Львиный рык, должны издавать протяжный и громоподобный рев при ранении, а благодаря богатым внутренним силам Ци этот рев может достигать ли на расстоянии и устрашать всех существ.

Desc_400.en: The warriors who fight to the last moment are mourned by the victors. Tyrant Unchained is said to have been created by Xiang Yu, Hegemon-King of Western Chu, as he risked his life and unleashed all his power to fight in a battle to the death.
Desc_400.cn: “抗兵相加，哀者胜矣”。相传霸王解甲功乃是西楚霸王项羽于绝境中所创，乃是在九死一生的战阵中，舍生向死，有去无还的搏命之法。

Desc_401.en: Five Ghosts' Burden is a Taoist spell that changes reality with illusions as long as its practitioner seeks assistance from the Five Ghosts with sincerity and spiritual seal.
Desc_401.cn: 五鬼搬运法乃道门法术，诀曰：“山龙廉贞有向，水龙巨门见水”，施展者需净心诚意，以灵符为引，延请五鬼，从而以无易有，以虚易实。
Desc_401.ru: Бремя пяти призраков - это даосское заклинание, которое изменяет реальность с помощью иллюзий до тех пор, пока его практикующий искренне обращается за помощью к Пяти Призракам и имеет духовную Печать.

Desc_402.en: The first is vision, the second is hearing, and the third is intelligence. Well-informed is a set of observation and perception techniques of the Ranshan Sect, and those who master it can see and hear everything in great detail from a thousand miles away.
Desc_402.cn: “一曰长目，二曰飞耳，三曰树明”。此功乃然山派远望、察听、辩想之功，功成者五感通明，能知千里之外，隐微之中，故曰“长目飞耳功”。

Desc_403.en: Yin Yang Eyes is a bizarre set of techniques that blend illusion with reality. Those who practice it imbue their eyes with True Qi to confuse and disorient those who look them in the eye.
Desc_403.cn: 阴阳眼术亦真亦幻，神秘非常，修习者可将真气灌注于双目之中，使人见之则迷，陡生阴阳错乱、意散神消之感。
Desc_403.ru: Глаза Инь Ян - это причудливый набор техник, которые сочетают иллюзию с реальностью. Те, кто практикует это, наполняют свои глаза Истинной Ци, чтобы сбить с толку и дезориентировать тех, кто смотрит им в глаза.

Desc_404.en: Soul Absorption is a mind method that utilizes the power of seal symbols and spells to confine one's spirit and dispel evil ghosts.
Desc_404.cn: 所谓：“太一守骸，太上摄魂”。摄魂大法以符图为引，咒诀为辅，乃是以神明之力拘系人魂、辟除鬼魅的玄门心法。
Desc_404.ru: Поглощение души - это метод разума, который использует силу символов Печати и заклинаний, чтобы ограничить свой Дух и рассеять злых призраков.

Desc_405.en: This unique set of techniques from the Ranshan Sect grants its practitioner the ability to summon celestial enforcers and manipulate weather to suppress and eliminate all evil spirits.
Desc_405.cn: 诀曰：“上应天罡，下辟不祥，万精厌伏，所向无殃”。六丁六甲阵乃然山派独门奇术，施术者能召天兵护法，厉行风雷，役使百神。
Desc_405.ru: Этот уникальный набор техник Секты Жаньшань дает практикующему способность призывать небесных стражей и управлять погодой, чтобы подавлять и уничтожать всех злых Духов.

Desc_406.en: The spell of righteousness and divine law purifies the soul of the caster and deters all evil from coming near with the heavenly power of the seven greater stars of Ursa Major.
Desc_406.cn: 天罡咒正气浩然，总摄玄纲，其诀曰：“北斗七元，神气统天，威光万千，断绝邪源”，有斩邪灭踪、归真保宁之用，能助施术者内外贞白，辟除妖邪。
Desc_406.ru: Заклинание праведности и божественного закона очищает душу заклинателя и удерживает все зло от приближения с помощью небесной силы семи великих звезд Большой Медведицы.

Desc_407.en: Created by Guiguzi, Revolving Elephant involves symbols that represent tangible objects and uses these concepts to bend reality in return, so that a simple set of words can achieve infinite possibilities.
Desc_407.cn: “言有象，事有比。其有象比，以观其次”。象拟比转功乃鬼谷祖师所创，其法欲取反与，欲实反虚，能以无形求有声，以无为而致无不为。

Desc_408.en: The ancient sages are pioneers of all lives that observe the way of the universe and contemplate its beginning and end. Those who practice Reverted Transformations imitate the sages to transform all things back to their original states.
Desc_408.cn: “圣人之在天地间也，为众生之先。观阴阳之开阖以命物，筹策万类之终始，而守司其门户”。万化各归之法反以观往，复以验来，效仿圣人之道，可使万物复归于原有。

Desc_409.en: Crystal Clear is a unique set of techniques of the Jade-Maiden Sect that trains one's mind and soul until they are connected with all natural beings, granting them the grace and appearance of an immortal.
Desc_409.cn: 冰清玉洁之法，曰：“持身厉行，练精养志”，乃是使人养精合神，通于天地，从而容姿清迥、举止脱俗的璇女派奇技。

Desc_410.en: What should the Jingwei bird flying west fill up the East Sea with? Jingwei Filling the Sea comprises only four techniques but can be difficult to counter with relentless movements like the mythical Jingwei bird filling the sea with small stones.
Desc_410.cn: “西飞精卫鸟，东海何由填”。精卫填海式虽仅有衔、投、起、落四种变化，但如精卫移山塞海一般往复来回、绵延不断之下，却也难以尽解。

Desc_411.en: Black jade is rarer that depends on how dark its shade is. The techniques draw Yin True Qi from the bottom of the practitioner's body up to their chest and heart, aiding meditation and freeing them from all distractions.
Desc_411.cn: 墨玉者，愈黑而愈贵重，虽黑而不改其洁。此功起于中极之下，止于心府之间，乃是引玄阴真气归于百神之舍，可定心凝神，化杂思而成真念。

Desc_412.en: The key to the formation is the graceful posture of the performers drifting with the wind, making one forget about reality and feel as if they are strolling in paradise.
Desc_412.cn: 天女散花阵讲究“徘徊牵引，随风而动，来往随意，飘然无着”，观者往往心神迷醉，犹如身处云宫仙阙之中，以至于不知迩远，忘却虚实。
Desc_412.ru: Ключом к формированию является грациозная поза исполнителей, плывущих по Рану, заставляя забыть о реальности и почувствовать себя так, словно они прогуливаются по раю.

Desc_413.en: Stunning Aura is a set of techniques about intangible reality, and those who practice it step on bright lights and clothe themselves in pure auras to drift to and fro at will as if riding the wind and clouds.
Desc_413.cn: 霞姝仙衣法虚无自然，澹然存真，运功者引明光而作履，凝清气以为衣，如可乘风拂云，任意来去，正是：“下靡兰蕙，上拂羽盖，缥乎忽忽，若神仙之仿佛”。

Desc_414.en: Mirror Mirage turns one's mind and soul into a mirror that reflects their thoughts and desires, blending reality with fantasy to confuse and bewilder one's opponent.
Desc_414.cn: “峥嵘栋梁，一旦而摧，水月镜像，无心去来”。镜花水月之法能化心神为镜，照映万千思绪，混同虚实真伪，使人惘然恍惚，不知所措。
Desc_414.ru: Зеркальный мираж превращает разум и душу человека в зеркало, отражающее его мысли и желания, смешивая реальность с фантазией, чтобы сбить с толку противника.

Desc_415.en: With the chaotic sea of Qi as Hunyuan and meridians as Yin and Yang, this technique purifies auras and eliminates all menaces, granting one the power to resuscitate and mend the sky.
Desc_415.cn: 女娲补天式以气海为混沌，诸脉为阴阳，能和同清浊，绝止凶戾，使生机复苏，化伤止害，有补修苍天，扶正四极之力。
Desc_415.ru: Благодаря хаотическому морю Ци в виде Хуньюаня и меридианам в виде Инь и Ян, эта техника очищает ауры и устраняет все угрозы, даруя человеку силу оживлять и исправлять небо.

Desc_416.en: It's not that one has any special abilities, it's just that they are good at using tools. Created by weaponsmiths, Weaponous Versatility unleashes the full potential of every implement equipped and makes the practitioner as agile as a monkey. The more artifacts equipped, the more powerful one becomes.
Desc_416.cn: “君子性非异也，善假于物也”。七手八脚功乃匠人所创，能借器物之势成我之威风，顺器物之利助我之来去，身携越多器物，越有便利。

Desc_417.en: Wooden Armor is one of the telekinetic techniques of the Swordsmith Villa, and those who practice it must equip countless tiny mechanisms onto their body to counter enemy's vigorous force and defend themselves.
Desc_417.cn: 木甲护身法乃铸剑山庄御物法门之一，欲修此法者，需将无数细小的机关设置于躯干之上，从而在遇敌之时卸去劲力，护守其身。

Desc_418.en: Weaponsmiths must temper and carve implements repeatedly to practice this technique until they are able to pinpoint their opponent's weaknesses with the impact sounds of artifacts and take advantage of these weaknesses.
Desc_418.cn: 辟甲真刚十四诀乃匠人于反复锤炼、雕琢器物时练就，修习者可从器物的撞击、挥舞之声中察觉其薄弱之处与缝隙所在，以彼之弱而成我之所强。

Desc_419.en: Divine intelligence divides all things, and the insightful eye sees what is false and true. A complex system of mechanisms will be installed inside the array so that the Cruxes can sense the tiniest movements and avoid danger, as if aided by the gods.
Desc_419.cn: 正所谓：“神机分万象，慧眼见虚实”。神机阵内由列阵者布下重重机关，阵眼可借机关察知虚实，避开凶险，动必有功，如有神助。

Desc_420.en: Celestial Armor is a set of techniques that imbue one's Qi into the armor to mend the weaknesses, capable of turning common iron into fine and indestructible adamantine.
Desc_420.cn: 凡兵有质，神甲无形。天兵披甲术乃是以内力灌注于甲胄之中，弥补缺隙，化虚为实的法门，可令凡铁化为精金，不为外力所摧毁。
Desc_420.ru: Небесная Броня - это набор техник, которые наполняют Броню своей Ци для устранения слабых мест, способных превратить обычное железо в прекрасный и неразрушимый адамантин.

Desc_421.en: The nine orifices, five internal organs, and twelve joints all relate to the weather. Only the most exceptional and skilled weaponsmiths may master Gadget's Heart and use the spirits of artifacts to nourish their physical body and imbue them with Qi.
Desc_421.cn: “九窍、五藏、十二节，皆通乎天气”。玲珑九窍之法非能工难以参悟，非巧匠难以功成，可以宝物之灵滋养九窍，使人内充外逸、气足神完。

Desc_422.en: Heaven Forge is a set of celestial techniques recorded on heavenly iron. The tome comprises two pages that describe a variety of metals, ores, mountains, and earthen veins in great detail.
Desc_422.cn: 天铸玄铁册之法记于天铁之上，乃天造之物，非凡人书写。此册共上下两页，记凡铁三十类、金英十九类、奇山七座、地脉五条，道尽其中诸般变化。
Desc_422.ru: Небесная кузница - это набор небесных техник, записанных на небесном железе. Том состоит из двух страниц, на которых в мельчайших подробностях описываются различные металлы, руды, горы и земляные жилы.

Desc_423.en: Four Fingered Green Paste is a set of medicinal techniques that teach one how to apply herbal ointments with four fingers in various ingenious ways.
Desc_423.cn: 四指青膏乃是将百草青汁涂抹于四指之上，再以抹、化、截、封等巧妙手法施药的法门。
Desc_423.ru: Четырехпалая зеленая паста - это набор лечебных техник, которые учат наносить травяные мази четырьмя пальцами различными изобретательными способами.

Desc_424.en: Human beings are comprised of three portions, and each portion has three pulses. Those who practice this skill examine the upper, middle, and lower parts of one's body, and the nine main pulses to identify illnesses and even predict death.
Desc_424.cn: 正所谓：“人有三部，部有三候”。三部九侯法以切脉、按诊之术遍察人体上、中、下三部，每部天、地、人三侯，修习者能明百病，知邪疾，辨虚实，断死生。

Desc_425.en: The Way of the Severed Bone is a bizarre set of medical techniques that aids in analyzing the body from the skin, vital organs, bones to blood and marrow in great detail.
Desc_425.cn: 透骨切剖法乃剖析人体之术，非寻常医术，此法自肌肤至脏腑，自骨骼至血髓，人身要害，关窍玄机，无有不知。
Desc_425.ru: "Способ отрубленной кости" - это причудливый набор медицинских техник, который помогает в мельчайших деталях проанализировать тело от кожи, жизненно важных органов, костей до крови и костного мозга.

Desc_426.en: Five-Ingredient refers to five kinds of herbs with "yellow" in their names that can ward off evil spirits. Five-Ingredient Antidote Art uses these five yellows as medicinal guides, which can dispel all kinds of poisons, eliminate irritation, promote Qi, and dissipate evil.
Desc_426.cn: 五黄，即五味名中带黄、于恶月使用的辟邪药材。五黄辟毒术以五黄为引，能辟除百毒，消解疠气，使阳气生发，阴邪退散。

Desc_427.en: Spring is the season of birth, summer the season of growth; autumn is the harvest season, and winter is the storing season. This is the law of Qi. People should do the same, dividing a day into four hours. Meridian Respite follows the natural changes of the four seasons and extracts Qi from the opponent's meridians to enchant and hypnotize them.
Desc_427.cn: “春生，夏长，秋收，冬藏，气之常也，人亦应之，以一日分为四时”。子午安息香合于营卫运行之理，深入经隧之中，可使中者神气归藏，困倦安息。

Desc_428.en: When Qi is strong, the blood flows; when Qi is weak, it stops. Blood Expulsion is a complicated set of techniques that are difficult to practice. One must use the internal forces to guide the blood flow by either changing its speed or direction.
Desc_428.cn: “气壮则血行，气衰则血止”。驱血法极难修炼，需以内力导引体内血液，或改变气血运转之速度，或调换气血运行之流向。

Desc_429.en: The method cleanses one's blood vessels and meridians with herbal poison to allow endless True Qi to flow through, granting them immortality as if one had drunk the Whitewater of Immortality from the Kunlun Mountains.
Desc_429.cn: 白水出于昆仑之山，饮之不死。白水长生法脱胎于黄白之术，其法乃是以药毒之偏性助人打通经脉，使真气源源不绝，如同仙人服食神丹，寿无穷已，与天地相毕。

Desc_430.en: The mighty Jiao Loong can summon lightning and ride storms to roam the infinite universe. This set of techniques grants its practitioner the Jiao Loong's ability to ascend to the heavens and restore their bones and flesh.
Desc_430.cn: “譬彼蛟龙，乘云浮兮，雷动电发，馺高举兮，驰风骋雨，游无穷兮”。青蛟生骨功讲究“升虚凌冥，沛浊浮清”，有使骨肉再生、阴阳相续之用。

Desc_431.en: The Jade Cicada "molts, ridding itself of filth, enabling it to float about outside of the earth, remaining untouched by mundane filth." This method can refine one's Innate Essence and store up one's Innate Soul. It is said that those who practice this skill will attain immortality as long their Qi is not dispersed.
Desc_431.cn: 玉蝉之为物：“蜕于浊秽，以浮游尘埃之外，不获世之污垢”。九色玉蝉法能炼化元精，积储元魂，传说修此秘法者，只要内气不散，便成不死不灭之身。

Desc_432.en: It is human nature to be silent. Feeling moved leads to desire arising. Desire Above All is practiced with a human being's most natural desire. Its practitioner should move at will and forget about the outcome—hence freeing themselves from restraints.
Desc_432.cn: “人生而静，天之性也。感于物而动，性之欲也”。随所欲之法由人之天性而发，运功者可随欲而动，不计得失，因物所感，无有拘束。

Desc_433.en: When the meridians are unblocked, the blood and Qi will flow. Meridian Grasp is a complicated but direct set of techniques that assists one in seizing the opponent's main meridians to terminate their blood and Qi flows, thus immobilizing them.
Desc_433.cn: 所谓：“脉道以通，血气乃行”。拿脉功架势繁而不乱、直取要害，乃是通过拿捏脉门而使人气血不行、无法动作的技法。

Desc_434.en: This method is easy to learn but hard to master. Those who practice it can control their bones and joints at will to make their body shrink in an instant without any gaps in between their muscle and flesh.
Desc_434.cn: 易筋缩骨功易学难精，时有妙用，乃是控制自身关节、骨骼，以使身形能够陡然缩小，筋肉之间不留丝毫间隙的法门。

Desc_435.en: Those who practice this method must start with meditation and contemplate their own body to connect to the seven chakras of concentrated spiritual Qi inside one's body, and eventually achieve the ultimate unity of body and soul.
Desc_435.cn: 三脉七轮乃人体灵气汇集之所。修习七轮感应法者需由静定入门，观想周身，及至觉察体内气机流动、脉轮旋转，便可身心相应，运化自如。

Desc_436.en: Mandala Mantra is a secret Buddhist skill that concentrates on the accumulation of merit. Its practitioners must draw the mandala symbol in their mind and recite the teachings of the Buddha to connect to the heavens, whilst surrounded by a halo of celestial blessings.
Desc_436.cn: 曼荼罗真言轮圆具足，功德汇聚，形如团花，乃佛门秘藏，修习者心画宝印，口发真言，可开菩提道，破地狱门，望之如有天雨妙华环绕其身。

Desc_437.en: The Wisdom King's Dull Flame is a technique based on contemplating the spiritual heat in the abdomen. Those who practice it see the five divine symbols of nature, burning out all poison with a Dull Flame and removing all obstacles with the light of wisdom.
Desc_437.cn: 明王拙火定乃是经由观想腹中灵热而入定之法，修习者可见烟雾、萤火、阳焰、灯照、青天等五相，以炽燃之拙火断灭三毒，智慧之明光成就无碍。

Desc_438.en: Mahamudra is said to be an imprint of the Buddha that is passed down not by words or symbols. It is a method above all cycles of life and death that encompasses a universe of ultimate truths and wisdom.
Desc_438.cn: 大手印不以言传，不具表象，相传乃是由佛祖亲手印定，周遍于生死涅槃之一切法中，故有至高无上之德，包容万物之用。

Desc_439.en: Those that see my body develop Bodhicitta, those that hear my name turn from wickedness to good, those who hear my way gain great intellect, and those who know my heart become Buddhas. Only great scholars who have the great ability to use countless misfortunes as nutrition can tread this path.
Desc_439.cn: “见我身者发菩提心，闻我名者断恶修善，闻我法者得大智能，知我心者即身成佛”。唯有顿超三大阿僧祗劫，以无量劫为食粮的大能之士方可修得即身成佛之法。

Desc_440.en: Bewitching Whiff is a poisoning method of the Five Immortals Sect that turns the enemy's unclean auras into Gu Baits, and those who practice it can use this Gu toxin as bait to consume their enemy's blood and Qi.
Desc_440.cn: 迷虫香可以百毒为饵，气血为食，乃是五仙教将敌身阴浊之气化为蛊引的饲蛊之法。

Desc_441.en: Enthralling Miasma is a gas created from one's True Qi that has no color or scent, but is capable of disturbing the mind of one's opponent, forcing them to suffer in intense agony.
Desc_441.cn: 喜怒哀惧爱恶欲，谓之七情。乱情瘴乃是由真气激发迷香而成，此香虽无色无味，却能扰乱人心，使人七情郁结、五内煎熬。
Desc_441.ru: Завораживающие миазмы - это газ, созданный из Истинной ци человека, который не имеет ни цвета, ни запаха, но способен потревожить разум противника, заставляя его страдать в сильной агонии.

Desc_442.en: With a bewitching aroma, these ruby-like parasites inhabit the southwestern mountains and feed on poison. Disciples of the Five Immortals Sect plant these bugs into bodies and control their movements with poison to stimulate acupoints and make the hosts more belligerent.
Desc_442.cn: 红玉九香虫质如红玉，身有异香，出自西南群山之中，喜食毒物。五仙教弟子以秘法将此虫种入体内，可使其随毒性变化而动，从而刺激诸穴，激发宿主凶性。

Desc_443.en: The Gu Art is the technique of channeling poisonous parasites. The Gu Extermination Spell is passed down from generations of Gu keepers, and with only a few words, those who chant the spell can kill parasites and deter them from coming near.
Desc_443.cn: 灭蛊咒乃饲蛊之人所传，仅有“厌魅蛊道，咒起尸鬼，凡害我者，还诸本人”十六字，却能使蛊虫断命坏身，不敢加害，可谓出则有神，言而必灵。

Desc_444.en: Blood Doll Expulsion is a wicked and arcane spell that draws one's Yang energy and bewitches them into self-mutilation. The spellbound will suffer from spiritual pain, but it will backfire on the caster as well.
Desc_444.cn: 血偶破煞法极为阴毒，乃是以精气为引，使人恍惚迷离、自戕其身的秘术，中此术者固然魂损魄伤，施术者亦不免受其反噬。

Desc_445.en: Those who practice this technique conceal poison from decaying corpses in their mouth, and when it is unleashed, it seems as if dark clouds spawn to cover the sky, and locusts buzz over fields of rice.
Desc_445.cn: 丧魂息之毒藏于唇齿之间，乃陈年腐尸所化，吐出时恰如黑云蔽日、万蝗齐飞，故有“神仙丧胆，恶鬼失魂”之称。

Desc_446.en: The colorless and benign silkworm controls poisonous Gu to absorb True Qi instead of feeding on Gu Baits. It is a secret and marvelous technique of the Five Immortals Sect and may only be passed down to those who have contributed to the sect.
Desc_446.cn: 天蚕噬蛊性情温和，无色无形，不以蛊引为食，却能借由驭使它蛊而吸取真气，此乃五仙教秘传之奇蛊，非有功于圣教者不可授予。

Desc_447.en: Tamed Ghost is a bizarre spell that sorcerers in ancient times used to invoke spirits and command ghosts. The spellbound will only see and hear specters until they completely lose their sanity.
Desc_447.cn: 鬼降大法能事无形，以舞降神，乃上古巫觋沟通神灵、役使百鬼的奇术，中此术者，无不目见鬼形，耳闻鬼声，乃至神机逆乱，举止癫狂。
Desc_447.ru: Прирученный призрак - это причудливое заклинание, которое колдуны в древние времена использовали для вызова Духов и повелевания призраками. Зачарованный будет видеть и слышать только призраков, пока полностью не потеряет рассудок.

Desc_448.en: Sky Serpent Metamorphosis is a secret skill of the Five Immortals Sect that imbues strong poison into one's bone marrow to mend injuries and extend their lives. Those who master it are bathed in divine light, but will have tender bones and lose strength due to the poison.
Desc_448.cn: “一龙一蛇，与时俱化”。天蛇换骨功乃是将奇毒化入骨髓之中，从而生残补缺、延命保身的五仙教秘法，功成者骨骼尽软，身有玄光，却也往往会因奇毒之故而日渐消瘦。

Desc_449.en: The method for Cosmic Barrier connects hundreds of acupoints inside one's body so that they may complement each other like the twinkling stars in the sky, aiding one in drawing Qi in the most unfortunate moments and turning the tide of battle.
Desc_449.cn: 所谓：“金方烧易得，星度算来玄”。天关通之法可将体内数百孔穴连为一体，使之如周天星辰一般此弱彼强，此消彼长，从而助人行气化势，逆中取胜。

Desc_450.en: Hebo is the river god that rides a Loong and stirs up storms. Those who practice this method will have their True Qi flow like a surging river that captures the enemy forces and makes use of their strength.
Desc_450.cn: 河伯乃河水之神，能兴风作浪，乘龙游川。河伯娶妻可使真气奔腾如河水，卷荡来敌之气力，使彼之气力为我所用。

Desc_451.en: This method is formless like still water hiding danger. Those who practice it can seize their enemy's True Qi as naturally as the river flows into the ocean during an exchange of their internal forces.
Desc_451.cn: 六转天潢之法似水无形，暗流涌动，运功者能于敌我内力流转之时，驭使敌之真气化为己用，宛如天河流转，百川入海。

Desc_452.en: The meridians circulate blood and Qi and maintain Yin and Yang, and the muscles and bones are used to connect the joints. Those who practice this method may turn their internal forces into cold air that freezes their eight main veins instantly to make them as solid and indestructible as packed ice.
Desc_452.cn: “经脉者，所以行血气而营阴阳，濡筋骨，利关节者也”。寒冰八脉之法，乃是以内力化作寒冰之气瞬间冻结八脉，使之固若坚冰，一时难以伤毁。

Desc_453.en: The Big Dipper represents death, and Sagittarius represents life. The array commands the power of the Sagittarius stars as the practitioners vitalize one another and boost each others' stances and Qi circulations with the natural energy that exists between heaven and earth.
Desc_453.cn: 所谓：“北斗注死，南斗注生”。南斗六星阵借势于南斗诸星，列阵者彼此相生，互助气势，可生归真凝神，生化万物之气。

Desc_454.en: The nine celestial bodies can eliminate evil and control fate. This method clears any obstruction in one's Qi flows and connects them to the heavens. Those who practice it have sharp and glowing eyes that see the most opportune times for strikes in battles with the aid of celestial bodies.
Desc_454.cn: 正所谓：“天有九曜，人有九窍”。九曜又称九执，能攘妖邪、主祸福。九曜星君眼乃是助人打通关窍，存神于天的法门，运功者双目炯炯，精光焕赫，能凭借星相察觉战机，如同星君借眼，无往不利。

Desc_455.en: Expulsion of Misfortune is a set of unique arts for the direst moment that strips one of all hopes before bringing them back to life. It can only be used in the most desperate moment and will be more effective if the practitioner is severely injured.
Desc_455.cn: “七元真君，北极之灵，至真摄鬼，群魔摧倾”。七元解厄大法乃置人死地而后生的绝技，非陷入绝境不可轻易施展，运功者越受摧残，此功越显神效。

Desc_456.en: Enraged Visage is a set of techniques of Fuloong Sanctuary that transform the sheer power of rage into strength. Those who practice it will glare with their hair on end, eliminating their enemy with an intimidating force.
Desc_456.cn: 怒相功全凭心念而发，乃伏龙坛以怒助力之法，运功者横眉立目，须发上指，能以骇人声势摧破外敌。

Desc_457.en: This method focuses on strength and speed. Those who practice it will have their Qi flow through the body and can unleash it the moment they encounter an enemy, with an unstoppable force like an enraged Loong turning its head.
Desc_457.cn: 龙回首讲究“寓意于力，瞬发瞬收”，运功者气走全身，遇敌便出，宛如龙鳞被撄，奋而回首，其势猛烈，常人绝难抵挡。

Desc_458.en: Divine Flame Shroud is an exclusive technique of strength of Fuloong Sanctuary. Those who practice it withhold their strength and True Qi inside their body and shroud it in divine flames, as if protected by celestials when seen from afar.
Desc_458.cn: 神火罩功乃伏龙坛独门运劲之法，运功者涵劲蓄势，蕴气不吐，可使阳火真气笼罩全身，望之如有神火护体。

Desc_459.en: The Loong is constantly changing. If it dives deep, it will be unpredictable. If it moves, it will be infinite. Loong Rush Array takes the shape of a Jiao Loong and borrows its divine might, making its practitioners move in an unpredictable and inviolable way no matter how their positions change.
Desc_459.cn: “天地后冲，龙变其中，潜则不测，动则无穷”。龙闯阵以形取意，状若蛟龙，不论结阵者的位置如何变动，皆有风云突回、首尾相应之用。

Desc_460.en: The method is a set of techniques of Fuloong Sanctuary that requires its practitioner to hit themselves with heavy weapons until Yang energy is generated to repel Yin auras, as if their unbreakable bones were cast by Leigong, the god of thunder.
Desc_460.cn: “夫雷霆者，天地枢机”。雷公铸骨乃伏龙坛横练之法，修习时需重击全身，乃至阳气生发，阴煞自除，似能身受雷霆而不倒，召合五脏之神气。

Desc_461.en: Those who practice this technique transform the surrounding True Qi into a Yang fire and focus it in the chest before it bursts forth as a powerful light and triggers their full potential. It is of pure Yang and can only be practiced by devoted souls, or it will backfire.
Desc_461.cn: 天芒丹心术由内而外，能将周身真气化为阳火，聚于心口，迸发强光，激发莫大潜力。此功至刚至纯，心有杂念者必受阳火反噬，故非心性纯粹之人不可修炼。

Desc_462.en: Thousand Years of Inebriation is not only a method but also a state of mind. Those who practice it must be inebriated to unleash its power, as it relieves one from all sorrow and makes them feel as if they can travel the entire world in an instant.
Desc_462.cn: “酒中有意无须尽，四海无涯任我行”。千年醉既是技法，亦为心念，需借痛饮之势而发，可助人神游天地，消一切愁绪，展万丈胸怀。

Desc_463.en: Blot Out the Sky and the Sun is a marvelous and powerful set of techniques that stirs up sandstorms with True Qi and blocks the sunlight, as a wide expanse of dark clouds covers the sky.
Desc_463.cn: 遮天蔽日功威能广大，乃是以真气扰动一方天地的奇术。此功一旦运起，便见飞沙走石，漫天昏黑，如同长云蔽目，日月无光。
Desc_463.ru: "Закрой небо и солнце" - это чудесный и мощный набор техник, который вызывает песчаные бури с помощью Истинной ци и блокирует солнечный свет, поскольку небо застилает широкая полоса темных облаков.

Desc_464.en: The key to Splattering Mud is entangling. Those who practice it often entangle themselves with the enemy, as if splattered by mud, which is why such techniques are despised by nobles.
Desc_464.cn: 烂泥绝技唯以一“缠”字为要，运用者常四体抱架，缠绕敌身，形如烂泥，多为君子所不齿。
Desc_464.ru: Ключом к разбрызгиванию грязи является запутывание. Те, кто практикует это, часто связываются с врагом, словно забрызганные грязью, вот почему дворяне презирают такие приемы.

Desc_465.en: Qi Disorder is a chaotic technique that can only be used by someone who suffers from Inner Breath Chaos. Practitioners would often lose their sanity and suffer from immense pain, which leads them to violence and a thirst for blood.
Desc_465.cn: 乱气杀乃逆乱之法，非内息紊乱之人无法运用。此功一旦发作，修习者往往心智失常，苦不堪言，但也因此愈发凶恶残忍，嗜血如狂。

Desc_466.en: Ghostshriek is a bizarre and eerie method, and those who practice it exert a force from Dantian to unleash an endless howl, which sounds like a ghost's shriek and deters anyone who hears it.
Desc_466.cn: 鬼夜哭之法怪异可怖，乃是丹田运劲，以力鼓声，长啸不止，使人如闻野鬼怨泣，望风而逃的法门。
Desc_466.ru: Призрачный крик - это причудливый и жуткий метод, и те, кто его практикует, используют силу Даньтянь, чтобы издавать бесконечный вой, который звучит как крик призрака и отпугивает любого, кто его слышит.

Desc_467.en: Sanguine Devouring is a sacrificial method that comprises 28 techniques. Unlike ordinary humans, those who practice it have an insatiable thirst for blood and no sanity or conscience left.
Desc_467.cn: 血食功以鲜血为牺牲，杀戮为祭祀，共有刿、剖、伐、施等二十八式，运功者见血则狂，食血则喜，心无怜悯，不似常人。
Desc_467.ru: Сангвиническое пожирание - это жертвенный метод, который включает в себя 28 техник. В отличие от обычных людей, у тех, кто практикует это, неутолимая жажда крови и не осталось ни здравомыслия, ни совести.

Desc_468.en: Soul Haulage is a wicked and mysterious spell passed down from ancient sorcerers. Those who practice it can absorb souls and transform a human into a ghost with evil Qi energy, as well as the inverse.
Desc_468.cn: 移魂大法脱化于厌胜之术，乃古之灵巫所传。此法恶毒诡秘，能以邪祟之气拘转人鬼阴阳，勾魂摄魄，嫁祸索命尽皆不在话下。
Desc_468.ru: Перемещение души - это злое и таинственное заклинание, передающееся по наследству от древних магов. Те, кто практикует это, могут поглощать души и превращать человека в призрака с помощью злой Энергии Ци, а также наоборот.

Desc_469.en: Those who practice this method must forsake their existence and all emotions before undergoing ten tribulations and gradually abandoning their inner spirits until they are void of human desires.
Desc_469.cn: 欲成心我两灭之法，当摒弃自我，断灭七情，不感生，不悲死，经十层苦练，渐舍三魂七魄，而后心念成空，再无人欲。
Desc_469.ru: Те, кто практикует этот метод, должны отказаться от своего существования и всех эмоций, прежде чем претерпеть десять невзгод и постепенно отказаться от своего внутреннего Духа, пока они не освободятся от человеческих желаний.

Desc_470.en: Blood Children Formation is an extremely evil method that ignores all suffering in the world. All performers are connected spiritually to the core of the array, granting them the power of rebirth and rejuvenation.
Desc_470.cn: 十二血童大阵不以众生为念，不以五逆为苦，乃天下至邪之法，助阵者皆与阵主心意相连，神魂相通，故能以死为生，以身代厄。

Desc_471.en: Instead of the teachings of the Buddha or cleansed spirits, Demonic Channeling aims for freedom in demonic transformation, and those who master it will be released from worldly suffering and have the power to destroy all good morals.
Desc_471.cn: 天魔乃欲界第六天之主，有无量眷属，常障碍佛道。天魔通不以禅定为法，不以非想为要，唯求于他化之中得自在，功成者不受五衰之苦，而有破坏善法之能。

Desc_472.en: Bloodswiller Immortality is the ultimate secret skill of the Sanguine Sect that empowers those who practice it with endless desires and obsessions until they eliminate all troubles and obstacles and achieve immortality.
Desc_472.cn: “万法本空相，尘劫若火轮，入我魔罗道，成我不死身”。血童不死身乃血犼教无上之秘法，其势由无明妄心而发，绝知断见乃止，可助人灭尽一切烦恼、阻碍，成就不死不灭之躯。

Desc_473.en: Be upright, both physically and mentally, and you may grasp the essentials of Shaolin Long Fist. Seemingly stiff with its direct strikes and blocks, it's actually a well-knit set of techniques that demonstrates the very spirit of Shaolin martial arts.
Desc_473.cn: 少林长拳讲究“筋顺骨直，正大光明”，招式尽是横截直击，虽然看似简单刻板，然而法度却极严谨，堪称少林武学之典范。

Desc_474.en: Vajra Palm is easy to learn but hard to master. With a modicum of training, even novice martial artists will be able to break a rock with their bare hands. However, only after a painstaking endeavor will one restrain the excessive Yang energy provoked by this technique and find a way to generate equally strong Yin energy, thus achieving an advanced, balanced state.
Desc_474.cn: 少林金刚掌易学难精，虽初练即生开碑碎石之刚强掌力，然而若要练至阳劲内敛而生阴劲乃至刚柔相济的上乘境界，却极是艰难。

Desc_475.en: Pounce like a tiger, dive like a hawk. The force of Great Through-back Boxing runs through and connects both arms through the back, hence the name. The techniques are all fierce and direct with impressive range, a graceful stance, and smooth movement.
Desc_475.cn: “其起如虎扑人，其落如鹰捉物”，力贯双臂，左右一体，谓之“通臂”也。大通臂拳招式刚猛，直上直下，放长而击远，势整而力顺。

Desc_476.en: A perfect imitation of the Eighteen Arhats' respective stances and special powers, the Sixty-eight Fists of Arhat exercise a combination of dexterity and stability, and temper the force with mercy.
Desc_476.cn: 六十八式罗汉拳模仿十八罗汉之姿态神通，既有灵活多变之招式，又不离三正守中之根本，可谓刚柔并济，神形完备。
Desc_476.ru: Совершенная имитация соответствующих позиций Восемнадцати Архатов и их особых способностей, Шестьдесят восемь Кулаков Архата демонстрируют сочетание Ловкости и стабильности, а также умеряют силу милосердием.

Desc_477.en: The majestic Great Vajra Fist strikes with unrivaled force and stability. Its movements are extremely bold and imposing, yet at the same time elegant and methodical.
Desc_477.cn: 大金刚拳刚猛绝伦，力发千斤，拳力稳重果决，气势雄浑，招式大开大合，井然不失法度，举手投足间均显示出莫大的威力。
Desc_477.ru: Величественный кулак Великой Ваджры наносит удары с непревзойденной силой и стабильностью. Его движения чрезвычайно смелы и внушительны, но в то же время элегантны и методичны.

Desc_478.en: When he first came to China, Bodhidharma brought no scripture, save for the brilliant ideas in his mind. Each of the eighteen techniques is equally exquisite, yet it's their common principle of "Tamed heart, emptied mind" that truly demonstrates the essence of Shaolin martial arts.
Desc_478.cn: 所谓：“达摩西来一字无，全凭心意用功夫”，达摩十八手招式固然精奇，而那“守心住缘，无念为宗”的功法总诀更为少林武学之真髓。

Desc_479.en: The peerless Vajra Prajna Palm strengthens the inner Qi through extensive training of muscular power, achieving incredible might. Even a single blow will initiate a flurry of unstoppable onslaught, hence its renown for being the strongest palm technique of Shaolin Temple.
Desc_479.cn: 金刚般若掌刚强无俦，由外而内，内外兼修，威力奇大无比。掌力一旦吐出便汹涌难绝，层层叠叠，莫可抵挡，堪称少林第一神掌。

Desc_480.en: May the light of my mind illuminate all temples. Fist of Purging Light's moves are simple, gentle, yet exert supreme might. By practicing it, one can achieve amazing feats with simple moves, the vigorous force of which stops at nothing, just like the divine light of Buddha shining on all places at all times.
Desc_480.cn: “愿我智慧光，普照十方刹”。降魔光明拳质朴温和，却具无上大力，招式举重若轻，劲力无所不至，正如佛光普照一切时，一切处。

Desc_481.en: This style has dozens of different techniques. The knees and elbows are both used on offense and defense, which allows the moves to continuously flow putting them in quite the predicament. It's called the "Closed Fists" because the opponent is kept boxed in, on the ropes.
Desc_481.cn: 三十六闭手每一式均有虚实、正反、引送、沉浮等数十种不同手法。攻防之际膝肘并用，招式连绵不断，令敌人进退维谷，所以谓之“闭”也。

Desc_482.en: This style is surprisingly vivid and skillful despite the fact it looks awkward and hilarious like a duck. As the practitioner swings from left to right, front to back, they employ surprisingly quick and fierce moves.
Desc_482.cn: 鸭形拳生动灵巧，妙趣横生，虽然望之犹如一鸭，似是无比滑稽，但于左摇右摆，前撩后拨之中，却隐含着极迅疾的凶狠招式。

Desc_483.en: This style is like a silkworm spinning silk and poisoned arrows combined. Its attacks ensnare and deal significant damage to any opponent that comes within range.
Desc_483.cn: 十二手滥缠丝拳行拳如春蚕吐丝，发放如毒箭离弦。诀曰：“脚踏长山手拉弓，巴拿抖造力无穷，擒拿挂劈缠丝劲，直踏中宫冲洪门”。
Desc_483.ru: Этот стиль подобен тутовому шелкопряду, прядущему шелк, и стрелам с Ядом в сочетании. Его атаки заманивают в ловушку и наносят значительный урон любому противнику, который оказывается в пределах досягаемости.

Desc_484.en: The Taoist boxing arts are even more novel and were learned from the white apes in the mountains. This style is ever-changing with unthinkable moves that mimic the erratic form of the mountain ape and which also render it a wonder of the fist arts.
Desc_484.cn: “道人更自出新奇，乃是山中白猿授”。白猿通臂拳灵动多变，招式匪夷所思，极尽山猿蹿跃嬉戏之形态，堪称拳法中之一奇。

Desc_485.en: This style changes unpredictably, with movements that appear graceful, yet have more than enough bite. Grace and power often go hand in hand, it is said.
Desc_485.cn: 移花接木手若真若假，变幻莫测。招式看似轻柔无已，实则凌厉至极，正是：“柔为刚之本，刚为柔之用，若欲极刚，必力极柔”。
Desc_485.ru: Этот стиль меняется непредсказуемо, с движениями, которые кажутся грациозными, но в то же время обладают более чем достаточной остротой. Говорят, что грация и сила часто идут рука об руку.

Desc_486.en: The power of this technique is tremendous. What's more, it's quick and invigorates the whole body, like a thunderclap.
Desc_486.cn: 天罡雷轰掌威力极强，骤发骤收，催坚毁物只在一瞬之间。掌法一经使动则全身劲力暴增，掌中如灌闪电轰雷，声势无比惊人。
Desc_486.ru: Сила этой техники огромна. Более того, это быстро и бодрит все тело, как удар грома.

Desc_487.en: Samadhi is a state of intense concentration brought on via meditation, and the Vajra Samadhi Palm is a high-level skill of the inner sanctum of the Emei Sect that is hard yet supple and utterly flawless. Like a vajra that has achieved samadhi, one is able to achieve all regardless of the obstacles with the Vajra Samadhi Palm, hence the name.
Desc_487.cn: 金刚三昧掌乃峨眉内门神掌之绝诣，刚柔一体，绝无破绽。“如金刚能一切无碍，能通达一切诸法之三昧”，故而谓之“金刚三昧”。

Desc_488.en: Consisting of 32 stances, Wudang Long Fist is a set of techniques that value the practitioner's will over sheer physical power. The distinct and natural moves make it possible to shift stances to the varying rhythms of battle.
Desc_488.cn: 武当长拳共有三十二式，尚意而不尚力。招式开合分明，运化自然，静则四肢舒展慢条斯理，动则手足齐到势如连环。

Desc_489.en: Make every part of your body spin, yet maintain unification. The techniques of Wind-chasing Palm form a tight-knit combo, which liberates the practitioner from their physical constraints and endows them with a wind-like elusiveness in battle.
Desc_489.cn: “周身无处不旋转，神固体逸不散乱”。追风云环掌招招相连，式式相接，行功走架间不拘于身，不困于形，犹如清风飞扬。

Desc_490.en: With its elusive moves and pervasive force, Wudang Soft Palm leaves no visible trace where it strikes while effectively destroying vital organs—an iron hand in a velvet glove.
Desc_490.cn: 武当绵掌出手无形，落手无声，掌力随方就圆，无孔不入。中掌之处绝无丝毫痕迹，但脏腑已然重伤，可谓绵里藏铁，柔中寓刚。
Desc_490.ru: Благодаря своим неуловимым движениям и всепроникающей силе, мягкая ладонь Удана не оставляет видимых следов в местах ударов, эффективно разрушая жизненно важные органы — железная рука в бархатной перчатке.

Desc_491.en: Let the 8 trigrams guide your steps and strikes. Also known as the Palm of the Trigrams for using the 8 trigrams to encode the direction of movement in battle, Bagua Zhang in action is characterized by ceaseless, ever-changing movements.
Desc_491.cn: 游身八卦掌首重走转步法，所谓：“八卦掌，卦上走，人在卦上变身手”。御敌之际足不停步，掌不离身，随走随变，甚是玄妙精微。

Desc_492.en: Agile and spontaneous, it's the strongest palm strike unique art to ever come out of a Taoist sect. With the practitioner guiding both palms, the strikes launched using this technique seem to come from nowhere, hence it is exalted as "unfettered."
Desc_492.cn: 太乙逍遥掌乃道门内家掌法之绝技。其姿态飘逸灵动，洋洋洒洒，以意气为本而招式为末，双掌随意而发，无中生有，洒脱有如神仙，如入逍遥之境。

Desc_493.en: The continuous depletion of one's desires persists until one acts accordingly to the natural Way. The further one advances practicing Esoteric Fist, the lesser styles and stances will matter for them in combat. By doing nothing, one is enabled to do everything; by fighting against nothing, one can defeat anything.
Desc_493.cn: 所谓：“损之又损，以至于无为”。玄功神拳愈练招式愈少，愈练劲力愈空，是以“无为而无不为”，无招乃胜有招，劲空则容万法。

Desc_494.en: Allegedly taught by the Taoist grandmaster Lü Dongbin, Wudang Yang Fist follows the way of nature and utilizes its force. Sometimes, with its subtle, succinct movement, even if launched later than your opponent's strike, it will still be the first to land.
Desc_494.cn: 相传乃道门吕祖所传之神拳。武当纯阳拳用自然之道，运自然之力，拳力和煦如阳光普照，慢劲快打而后发先至，无愧于“武当一黄庭，纯阳三分技”。

Desc_495.en: Only under an incandescent state of Yang energy can one use this one and only Taoist unarmed technique. Solemn and overwhelming, the Ultimate Yang Fist strikes a harmonious balance between the violent and gentle.
Desc_495.cn: “阳气鼎盛之极，正气浩荡之极”，谓之“紫阳”也。紫阳正气拳乃是玄门正宗拳法之绝诣，拳力非刚非柔，庄严宏大，铺天盖地。

Desc_496.en: The meaning of battle is nullified before an adept practitioner of Taiji Fist. Named after Taiji, the state of undifferentiated absolute, and the origin of Yin and Yang, this set of techniques harmonizes the two aspects of Qi, and exploits the opponent's weakness to counteract their strength.
Desc_496.cn: 无极生太极，太极阴阳之母也。太极拳阴阳相随，圆融一体，以柔克刚，四两拨千斤，正是：“妙手一运一太极，太极一运化乌有”。

Desc_497.en: All four moves of Mountain-shaking Palm are, if not foolproof, simple, thus easy to learn and practice. The genuine power of this set of techniques lies in practicing training for years, which is only unleashed when facing a worthy enemy.
Desc_497.cn: 推山掌招式粗浅，易学易练，仅横竖正反四式掌法，厉害之处全在年深月久之劲力积蓄，临敌之际一并迸发，却也颇为惊人。

Desc_498.en: Consisting of 24 moves, the Hand of Iron Lash enables the practitioner to slam their opponent with the backs of both hands. By twisting the waist and swinging the arms when launching the attack, one can make use of the momentum to double the already impressive force.
Desc_498.cn: 以双手之手背反复摔砸敌身之重手法。狮相铁担手共有二十四式，出招之时必先“旋腰甩臂，借势而发”，此时力上加力，掌力便即倍增。

Desc_499.en: It launches an attack like releasing an arrow; pound the opponent as the lightning strikes. A violent set of techniques, the Gate-busting Strikes have their vigorous force originate from the waist down and course through the entire body, bursting through the enemy's defense.
Desc_499.cn: 大开门八式刚强暴烈，劲整力猛，正是：“动如绷弓，发若炸雷”，劲力自下盘而发，直透全身，可达四面八方，名有“破开敌人门户”之意。

Desc_500.en: A unique art of raw strength that wrends flesh and metal alike. No mortal body can withstand its hammerlike onslaught.
Desc_500.cn: 大力开碑掌乃外门硬功之绝技，可以分金断玉，开山裂石，掌力似巨锥穿凿，似大锤猛击，奇强无比，非血肉之躯可以抵挡。
Desc_500.ru: Уникальное искусство необузданной Силы, которая разрывает как плоть, так и металл. Ни одно смертное тело не может противостоять его удару, подобному удару молота.

Desc_501.en: "Accumulate three layers of scabs from breaking sandbags, and you may punch through a wall with your bare hands." Requiring great perseverance, the Gravel Palm techniques condition the hands to allow a practitioner to deliver bone-breaking blows while unarmed, as if wielding a weapon.
Desc_501.cn: “黄痂生三层，手上铺金砂，钻墙可成洞，肉掌变铁叉”。狮相金砂掌非莫大毅力不能练就，其掌力凌厉有如钢刀，中者筋断骨折，可谓无坚不摧。

Desc_502.en: My strength plucked up the hills, my might shadowed the world. The Conqueror's Bow Draw relies on raw strength, yet is capable of guiding the opponent's action through its great momentum.
Desc_502.cn: 霸王开弓手气势雄强，霸道豪迈，虽为外门硬功，但劲力收发之际却能生出一股极强的吞吐吸引之力，当真是：“气吞山河，拔山盖世”也。
Desc_502.ru: Моя Сила покоряла холмы, моя мощь окутывала тенью весь мир. Натягивание лука Завоевателя опирается на грубую Силу, но в то же время способно направлять действия противника благодаря своей огромной инерции.

Desc_503.en: Rush like a mountainous torrent; sweep like a stormy gust. The bold and decisive Cloud's Wrath, with its overwhelming momentum, raises a storm wherever the practitioner arrives and effectively sweeps their opponents away.
Desc_503.cn: “飓风忽起云颠狂，波涛摆掣鱼龙僵”。云狂式“发似山洪奔泻，收似风卷残云”，其姿态飞扬勇决，其威势回山倒海，奔行间周身呼啸生风，所向无不披靡。

Desc_504.en: The signature supreme art of the Lion-Face Clan. Once launched, this unparalleled palm strike allows the practitioner's every joint to crackle with explosive sound. Whenever blocked, the power of the attack surges all the better to penetrate the opponent's defense.
Desc_504.cn: 大神威掌乃狮相门之镇山绝学。神威掌力至淳至刚，世上无双，发掌之时全身骨骼节节爆响，掌力一遇阻拦更威力陡增，不退反进。

Desc_505.en: The straight may seem crooked; the most skillful may seem clumsy. Conforming to no rule or style, The Clumsy Strike fends off and destroys whatever is in the practitioner's vicinity. The unmatched intensity of its raw power has earned itself a formidable reputation even among the most violent techniques of martial arts schools all over China.
Desc_505.cn: “大直若屈，大巧若拙”。大拙手无招无式，一经施展则周身无处不是至强掌力，四面八方无处不为掌力所摧，其力之厚堪称天下外门神功第一。

Desc_506.en: Graceful and dexterous, the Jade Maidens Sect' Enmeshing Clutch is specially designed to assail the opponent's wrists and elbows. Its stances are tightly interlocked, and its maneuvers are unnervingly adept.
Desc_506.cn: 玉女兜罗手姿态优美，灵巧多变，乃是专门袭取敌人之手腕臂肘的奇特手法，招式之间环环相扣，劲力收发细密如织。

Desc_507.en: Consisting of a series of snapping jabs, this set of techniques aims to lure the enemy into pursuit and attack, like funneling liquor into a cup, thus letting down their guard through distraction. The Jade Maidens Sect surely believe that victory favors the bold.
Desc_507.cn: 玉卮手一发即收，迅疾无比，招式看似门户洞开，进攻多而遮拦少，实则招招“引酒入卮”，诱敌近身，乃败中取胜之险恶手法。

Desc_508.en: A vicious Martial Art that mutilates the opponent with pure Yin energy. As the power is exercised, the practitioner's palms turn iron blue and render their opponent's abdomen and limbs cold and stiff once an attack lands. The invading Yin energy saps the victim of vitality, often leading to their eventual demise.
Desc_508.cn: 寒阴掌乃是以纯阴掌力伤人的阴毒功法。运功之时，掌心铁青，阴风骤起，中者下腹僵冷，四肢冰凉，气血渐而泄失，终于一命呜呼。

Desc_509.en: Derived from the ancient divination skill of Qimen Dunjia, the Small Nine-Heaven Techniques' form alters intuitively, following a cosmic rule. Capable of seamlessly transitioning into any technique, it's as unpredictable as mother nature herself.
Desc_509.cn: 小九天九式变化精微，由三奇应克之数而化。诀曰：“六丙到巽，火起风行”，其起如旱地春雷；又曰：“六乙到坎，玉兔投泉”，其落如风流云散。

Desc_510.en: Concentrate your Qi, and forge yourself into a cauldron. With movements fluid and agile, the Jade Ding Fist utilizes Pure True Qi and calm strength to suppress the opponent's movement.
Desc_510.cn: “气汇云门沉玉鼎，力走孔最铸金觞”。金觞玉鼎拳灵动小巧，招式繁密，真气精纯透如玉鼎，拳力精强固若金觞，故名“金觞玉鼎”。
Desc_510.ru: Сконцентрируй свою Ци и преврати себя в котел. Благодаря плавным и проворным движениям, кулак Дин из Нефрита использует чистую Истинную ци и спокойную Силу, чтобы подавить движение противника.

Desc_511.en: At dawn, I am the Morning Cloud; at dusk, the Driving Rain. Named after the residence of Goddess Yaoji, the technique is just as elegant and unpredictable as the Goddess of Cloud and Rain herself. With incessant maneuvers, this technique confuses the opponent like smoke and mirrors.
Desc_511.cn: 所谓：“旦为朝云，暮为行雨”，瑶姬云雨式美轮美奂，绝柔至软，可谓绰约如处子，婉转若游龙。其招式连绵不尽，似轻烟薄雾般幻化莫测。

Desc_512.en: Imbued with extreme Yin energy, the fierce, chilling Hoarfrost Palm infects the opponent with Cryotoxin, freezing their blood and closing their meridians. Death is inevitable.
Desc_512.cn: 寒冰神掌凌厉绝伦，至阴至寒。掌风及身则寒毒汹涌而入，不但全身热力尽散，血液冻结成冰，而且经络尽数封闭，可谓有死无生。
Desc_512.ru: Наполненная экстремальной Энергией Инь, свирепая, леденящая ладонь Инея заражает противника Криотоксином, замораживая его кровь и перекрывая меридианы. Смерть неизбежна.

Desc_513.en: The Five Beasts are the tiger, deer, bear, ape, and bird. This fist art alternates between movement and rest, yet is quick, steady, and heavy with its blows.
Desc_513.cn: 所谓五禽：“一曰虎，二曰鹿，三曰熊，四曰猿，五曰鸟”。柴山五禽拳外壮筋骨，内调脏腑，招式动静相间，沉稳轻快并重。
Desc_513.ru: Пять зверей - это тигр, олень, медведь, обезьяна и птица. Это кулачное искусство чередует движение и отдых, но при этом удары быстрые, устойчивые и тяжелые.

Desc_514.en: The Great Snow Palm Method is solid, tough, and supple without losing its power. It relies primarily on rolling, leaping, and direct pushes as well as pushes to the side. It is said that this skill was created by a centenarian who lived on Changbai Mountains and had fought a great cat there, supposedly a tiger or leopard.
Desc_514.cn: 大雪山掌法即坚且韧，轻灵而不失稳健，招式多以翻滚纵跃，横推直扑为主，传说乃是长白山中一位百岁高人与虎豹搏斗时所创。

Desc_515.en: This technique's name is derived from the strikingly sanguine feature of one's palm whilst performing it. Those injured by this technique will find that the blood coursing through their veins will move faster and faster until it reaches a roiling boil. The pain that accompanies it is beyond words.
Desc_515.cn: 因运功之际，掌心赤红如欲滴血，故名“掌血功”。为掌血功所伤者，全身血液愈行愈快，渐而翻滚有如沸水，可谓苦不堪言。

Desc_516.en: The Clematis dispels stone as well as bone, it is fierce, yet divine. The Kongsang Sect's medicine and poisons are both specialties. This technique is able to convert medicine into a strange poison that dissolves tendons and bones, leaving the opponent enfeebled on the ground.
Desc_516.cn: “威灵仙消积石，解骨鲠，性猛而功神也”。空桑派药毒双绝，能使良药化为奇毒，中此毒掌者筋消骨化，瘫软在地而亡。

Desc_517.en: The poisonous quality of this technique is without compare. Those who use Yin Qi while practicing this technique will store cinnabar in their Tianzong acupoint and be free from the toxin; however, those who use Yang Qi to unleash their power from the Yanggu acupoint will kill the enemy instantly.
Desc_517.cn: 丹砂神掌剧毒无比，毒性异常猛烈。修习此毒掌者以阴气储丹砂之精于“天宗”，即可于自身无碍；以阳气发丹砂之毒于“阳谷”，即可致人于死命。

Desc_518.en: The moves of the Divine Jiao Palm are quite odd for they seem to wriggle like the tail of the mythic Flood Loong, the Jiao itself. With a flurry, poisonous wind erupts, the likes of which are seen nowhere else.
Desc_518.cn: “潜鳞有饿蛟，掉尾取渴虎”。青蛟神掌招式古怪奇绝，掌势蜿蜒有如蛟尾，一掌拍出即腥风大作，其毒猛恶，世间未有。

Desc_519.en: The force of this technique is formidable and can be unleashed without moving the arms. Its technique unique, and many believe it to be Vajra's mighty power.
Desc_519.cn: 金刚锤拳力厚重，肩不抬臂不转即可于方寸之间出拳伤人，因发力方法十分独特，故而多有不明所以之人以为此乃金刚之神通也。
Desc_519.ru: Сила этой техники огромна, и ее можно использовать, не двигая руками. Его техника уникальна, и многие верят, что Ваджра обладает могучей силой.

Desc_520.en: This Martial Art sometimes has all four limbs fanned out and the head rocking from side to side, seeming as if there are four arms and two heads; other times it has one jumping back and forth with arms and legs moving in unison, seeming as if there are four heads and eight arms. This peculiarity puts the dharma-laksana of the "five great vajras" on full display.
Desc_520.cn: 五怒手时而四肢箕张，摇头晃脑，犹如四臂而二首；时而前纵后扑，手足齐动，犹如四首而八臂，乃是示现“五大金刚”之忿怒形的特异功法。

Desc_521.en: This technique has ten moves in total, which are incredibly skillful and profound in their significance for they correspond to the "ten victories" of the Bodhisattva: "Alms, precept observation, willingness to progress, remaining still in meditation, intellect, handiness, honesty, strength, and wisdom."
Desc_521.cn: 波罗密掌共有十式，精妙非常，寓意深奥，对应菩萨之“十胜行”，即：“布施、持戒、精进、禅定、智慧、方便、大愿、大力、大智”。

Desc_522.en: This technique is formidable with each palm having different strengths: left, right, Yin, Yang. The Yin force is unusually cold, and the Yang force is unusually hot. If caught in the middle of the two, it's pure torture. If the opponent doesn't die at the practitioner's hands, they will wish they had.
Desc_522.cn: 金刚黑砂掌沉雄霸道，两手掌力各不相同，一左一右，一阴一阳，阴力奇冷，阳力奇热，中者冷热煎熬，二力相合则非死也必重伤。

Desc_523.en: This technique turns Qi into fire that is transferred to each palm, which is used to deal damage to the opponent. While performing moves, the palms are like steel knives that seem to have electricity coursing through them.
Desc_523.cn: 灵热掌乃是以内气化作内火，再导内火灌注于双掌，以精纯灵热之气损伤敌人之密法。运功之时，掌如钢刀，掌上似有电光灼照。

Desc_524.en: This technique is ruthless without compare. It has six moves that all cause the practitioner's face to change to the six colors of the vajra: blue, yellow, red, white, black, or green, based on which move is used.
Desc_524.cn: 金刚诛灭手狠辣绝伦。其手法共有六式，行功者之面色亦会随着这六式而显示出“青，黄，赤，白，空，碧”六种变化，正是“金刚真谛之六色”也。

Desc_525.en: The "four gods" are described as follows: "First is the Dhritarashtra of silver, he is as strong as can be; second is the Virudhaka of glaze, he can be tempered to the length desired; third, is the Virupaksa of crystal, for his variations are limitless; and fourth is the Dhanada of gold for he is forever heard about without end."
Desc_525.cn: 所谓须弥山四神掌：“一曰白银埵持国，坚厚无比；二曰琉璃埵增长，远近如意；三曰水晶埵广目，变化无常；四曰黄金埵多闻，无穷无尽”。

Desc_526.en: Vairocana's Seal is the balled palm, and the body is brilliant and unable to be confused, like the living Buddha. Vairocana's Palm is the divine palm of the Vajra Sect, its power is without bound.
Desc_526.cn: 手结“大日如来法印”，身有“遍照一切光明”，迷悟不二，生佛一如，大日如来掌乃金刚宗之神掌真义，有无边无际之大能伟力。
Desc_526.ru: Печатью Вайрочаны является сжатая ладонь, а тело блестящее, и его невозможно спутать, как живого Будду. Ладонь Вайрочаны - это божественная ладонь Секты Ваджры, ее сила безгранична.

Desc_527.en: The Scorpion Sting is counter-intuitive in every way: a blow may be launched from the right, yet strike the left, making the unsettling fist style impossible to anticipate.
Desc_527.cn: 阴风蝎子手招招逆行，式式倒转，出于左而攻右，出于右而攻左，伏低乃是攻上，蹿高却为袭下，出手毫无征兆，十分诡异。
Desc_527.ru: Жало скорпиона во всех отношениях противоречит интуиции: удар может быть нанесен справа, но в то же время наноситься слева, что делает невозможным предугадать тревожный стиль удара кулаком.

Desc_528.en: Pervasive and insidious like a snake, keen and racking like its fang, this unarmed technique may rip opponent's defenses apart and make already painful injuries excruciating.
Desc_528.cn: “忽远忽近，盘旋蜿蜒，反肘斜进，无孔不入”，即“蝮蛇之技”；“透骨锥心，锁胁闭血，千牙万齿，麻痒难当”，即“千针之法”。
Desc_528.ru: Всепроникающий и коварный, как змея, острый и терзающий, как ее клык, этот невооруженный прием может разрушить защиту противника и сделать и без того болезненные ранения мучительными.

Desc_529.en: Gentle yet poisonous, the force of this vicious unarmed technique is directed inward for suction instead of outward for pummeling. By sucking on the victims' skin and leaving bloody marks, it effortlessly infuses venom into their vital organs through the bloodstream.
Desc_529.cn: 血蛭掌手法轻柔，毒性绵密，其掌力绝不外吐反而向掌心急吸，掌到之处肌肤故然流血不止，淋漓可怖，毒质也已由此而侵入脏腑。

Desc_530.en: A malicious palm strike envenomed with three different types of poison. An unprepared victim will go through a dead body's stages of decomposition while alive, suffering one of the three agonizing symptoms: stiffness, lividity, or disembowelment.
Desc_530.cn: 三尸断魂掌阴毒无已，一掌之中共有三种不同的毒质，其一曰“僵”，中者麻木不仁；其二曰“斑”，中者面目乌黑；其三曰“疝”，中者肚破肠穿。

Desc_531.en: The Cyan Spider's venom lingers, even in the afterlife. An unarmed technique with unpredictable patterns and ensnaring movements, infusing the venom of the mystical Cyan Spider into the victim's body.
Desc_531.cn: “青蛛有绝毒，缠魂五百世”。青蛛缠魂手奇诡莫测，掌力如丝如网，奇毒无比。青蛛绝毒更有“即令身死亦难尽除，仍会带往来世”之说。
Desc_531.ru: Яд голубого паука сохраняется даже в загробной жизни. Невооруженная техника с непредсказуемыми узорами и заманивающими движениями, вводящая яд мистического Голубого паука в тело жертвы.

Desc_532.en: Launched with a leap, this venomous unarmed strike crushes the opponent with built-up momentum and formidable imbued toxins. Not only human flesh will be wrend asunder; even metallic armors will dissolve before it.
Desc_532.cn: 朱蟾毒掌出掌之前必先全身蓄力，随即飞身跃出，其力道之强，毒性之猛，不仅非血肉之躯能够承受，任何铁衣金甲亦触之即溃。

Desc_533.en: The ultimate secret technique of the Five Immortals Sect. The skin on the chest of those who mastered this technique will become multihued with the colors of blue, yellow, red, and black. At this point, they will be able to imbue each of their strikes with different venoms, rendering the technique unpredictable.
Desc_533.cn: 青黄赤黑神掌乃苗疆五仙教之绝秘，功成者心口显出四色，双手有如僵尸，所发毒质每掌不同，有千百种变化，解无可解，避无可避。

Desc_534.en: Unparalleled toxic, the Souldeath Palm not only corrodes the mortal body, but also tears the victim's soul apart. However, due to its vicious nature, it backfires on the practitioner from time to time and imperils their life.
Desc_534.cn: 九死离魂手至奇至毒，世间绝无仅有，中者魂飞魄散，故名“离魂”。然而此功恶尽恶绝，行功者亦会受其反噬，不免九死一生，故又谓之“九死”。

Desc_535.en: For this technique, one's palm must strike a hot soldering iron 81 times every day for nine years, only then will one have forged their bones and tendons to be able to withstand the might that the practitioner will wield.
Desc_535.cn: 诀曰：“三三九九煅铁骨”，煅骨拳需每日以肉掌反复拍击高温烙铁九九八十一次，历经九年方成，旨在锻筋炼骨，强壮拳力。

Desc_536.en: This technique is quick and silent, with its attacks hidden in defense. Like a tiger hidden in the tall grass, it pounces and becomes a soaring Loong. While boxing, the practitioner's movements follow the Five Elements and Bagua with the stance of a drunkard and the might of the Eight Immortals.
Desc_536.cn: 伏龙醉八仙拳动迅静定，寓守于攻，屈如伏虎而伸比腾龙。行拳之际，脚踏五行八卦，姿态好似醉酒，有锵锵然之威风，如醉八仙之脱迹。

Desc_537.en: The Flamesmelt Palm is the unique Defensive Art of the Fuloong Sanctuary. It can conjure a wave of flames out of thin air that will envelop enemies within a few zhang. This Martial Art is taxing on the body, but the results are astonishing.
Desc_537.cn: 火炼掌乃伏龙坛之独门绝技，可凭空而发一道刚强炽浪，直取数丈之外的敌人，此功法极耗精神，但当者即燃，尤其骇人。

Desc_538.en: This technique melds power with the mind, strength with spirit. It is mighty indeed. The practitioner appears like a drunkard or an enraged soul. One must be cautious though, for if the mind is not like a boulder, and the intent is not stronger than metal, then it will consume the practitioner.
Desc_538.cn: 疯魔醉拳势与心结，力与神通，威力极强。行功之际如痴如醉，状如疯魔，稍有不慎则神智难返，需当心如磐石，意比金坚，方可施为。

Desc_539.en: The name of this technique comes from the fact that its might is great, and it gives off flamelike flashes of light that are bright like the sun or moon, and the fact that it leaves the practitioner drained in short order.
Desc_539.cn: 所谓“炫绝”：炫者，威势浩大，有火光迸发，炫然有如日月；绝者，其力一吐，绝无回还余地，非力竭势尽不能休止。

Desc_540.en: This technique is quick, with a storm of blows that unpredictably rain down on the opponent. This technique comes from beyond the East Sea, and there is actually a Palm of the Greater Jade Sun God as well.
Desc_540.cn: 小玉阳神拳轻捷跳脱，招招凌空而发，拳势东倒西歪，变幻莫测，繁密有如细雨。小玉阳神拳源自东海之外，与大玉阳神拳一奇一正，并世无双。

Desc_541.en: The name of this technique is a reference to the six Yang meridians, three on the hands and three on the feet. The might of the Six Yang Palm is formidable, and those caught within a practitioner's reach will find themselves in a living hell as their internal organs are turned to dust.
Desc_541.cn: 离火六阳掌由“手三阳，足三阳”六阳经脉而发，其力至刚纯阳，猛烈淳厚已极，中者如入炼狱火窟，五脏六腑无不化作焦炭。

Desc_542.en: This technique is powerful and fierce with moves like mountains and precipices. Attacks wash over the opponent like raging waves. This technique comes from beyond the East Sea, and there is actually a Palm of the Lesser Jade Sun God as well.
Desc_542.cn: 大玉阳神拳勇壮剽悍，式式渊渟岳峙，拳势左右一体，好整以暇，宏大好似狂澜。大玉阳神拳源自东海之外，与小玉阳神拳一正一奇，并世无双。

Desc_543.en: The Loong Palm is ferocious, veritably earthshaking. This technique is one that the Fuloong Sanctuary does not share with outsiders. When unleashed, A Loong's roar erupts, and the wind and clouds change color like when an enraged Loong arrives, hence its name.
Desc_543.cn: 化龙掌刚猛无俦，震古烁今，乃伏龙坛之不传绝诣。所谓：“出之有声，石破天惊，啸如龙呤；无形有质，风云变色，状如狂龙”，故曰“化龙”也。

Desc_544.en: Whoever practices this technique will appear as if they've gone mad. They'll bite, claw, pursue, and bark like a rabid dog, inflicting extra stress and fear of a wild attack.
Desc_544.cn: 疯狗拳举止无定，状似癫狂，行功走架绝无章法，吐唾牙咬，死缠烂打，无所不用其极，加之狺狺狂吠不止，却也格外骇人。
Desc_544.ru: Тот, кто практикует эту технику, будет выглядеть так, как будто он сошел с ума. Они будут кусаться, царапаться, преследовать и лаять, как бешеные собаки, вызывая дополнительный стресс и страх перед дикой Атакой.

Desc_545.en: A Martial Art with no specific moves or stances, the Agonizing Palm is capable of directly damaging the heart and lungs. All four variations of Slow, Hasty, Drill, and Lock are dedicated to maiming the opponent without an immediate trace.
Desc_545.cn: 摧心掌无甚招式，掌力共有“缓、急、钻、缚”四种变化，可刚可柔，直透心肺，乃是纯以暗劲伤人于无形的阴狠功法。

Desc_546.en: A brutal set of techniques that target the opponent's lower body. It is said to be able to break every joint and lacerate every muscle from hip to ankle.
Desc_546.cn: 七十二地煞拳凶狠异常，乃是专攻下路之猛恶手法，所谓：“抓膝拿踵节节断，剥腨剔股片片离”，自股至踵无不为其所制。
Desc_546.ru: Жестокий набор приемов, нацеленных на нижнюю часть тела противника. Говорят, что он способен сломать каждый сустав и разорвать каждую мышцу от бедра до лодыжки.

Desc_547.en: Fresh human or animal corpses are soaked in a toxic solution until dissolved, and then used by the disciples of the Sanguine Sect to hone their Necrogenic Palm skills. Rit requires 49 training cycles to achieve the intended lethality.
Desc_547.cn: 取人畜新死之尸体浸泡于毒水之中，待到尸体为毒水所化尽，即可取其毒质用以练功，七七四十九次之后，遂成腐尸毒掌。

Desc_548.en: Only when exposed to raw blood will the Blood-soaked Palm show its true colors. Fierce, violent, and toxic, the Blood-soaked Palm requires the practitioner's own blood to unleashits toxicity. The toxicity varies from person to person due to different blood qualities.
Desc_548.cn: 血煞掌凶狠暴戾，毒性猛烈，需以自身鲜血催动毒质，正是：“见血而发，愈伤愈狂”。因各人血质不同，所发毒性亦有不同变化。

Desc_549.en: Like a tender trap, the Bone-melting Palm sends its sinister force and insidious toxins into the opponent's body without warning, depleting their Yang energy and corroding their bones.
Desc_549.cn: 百鬼化骨掌势若柔丝，出无影，入无形，掌力一旦入体，便会蚕食人身筋骨，尽消人身阳元内气，其毒更甚附骨之疽，阴邪至极。
Desc_549.ru: Подобно нежной ловушке, Ладонь, плавящая кости, без предупреждения посылает свою зловещую силу и коварные токсины в тело противника, истощая его Энергию Ян и разъедая кости.

Desc_550.en: This fiendish technique was named Soul-shattering Palm for three reasons: its brutal training method involving human experimentation; its unrelenting focus on vital parts of human body; its horrendous effect of inflicting agony and an unceasing itch, whose victims usually die of self-mutilation.
Desc_550.cn: 天魔残魂掌之“残魂”，其指有三：“修炼之法无比残忍，需以活人试掌；出手招招残忍，所指皆为人身要害；中者剧痛奇痒，无不自残身体而亡”。

Desc_551.en: The Sanguine Sect's signature unarmed technique with a deleterious effect. Whenever this technique is used, black smoke and a foul wind will fill the air that render unconscious anyone in the vicinity, and the direct victim of the palm strike will die a gruesome death by bursting like a bloated cadaver.
Desc_551.cn: 血犼魔掌奇毒绝恶，乃血犼教之毒掌绝诣。此掌一出，黑烟弥漫，腥风骤起，闻者立刻昏厥，中者全身膨胀数倍，胸腹爆裂而死。

Desc_552.en: Hunch your back, open your eyes, and bare your teeth; become a tiger ready to pounce. Imitating both the form and the spirit of a tiger, the Crouching Tiger Claw is exalted for its fortitude, precision, and power.
Desc_552.cn: 所谓：“拱项缩头，瞠目眺牙如伏虎”。少林伏虎爪即仿虎形，亦具虎神，招式严谨，地盘扎实，出手稳健，刚劲有力。

Desc_553.en: The training of Shaolin One Finger Chan may seem to rely entirely on physical power, yet it is able to generate Qi through raw force and achieve a tranquil mental state through ceaseless movement. Its practice methods require extra attention with its extremely strict requirements; even the slightest misplacement would be unacceptable.
Desc_553.cn: 少林一指禅尽是外壮之功，全无内炼之法，却能气随力生，由动入静，十分独特。其练法极其考究，要求无比严格，次序绝不可错。

Desc_554.en: Originating from the story of the Flower Sermon where Gautama Buddha gives a wordless sermon to his disciples by holding up a white flower, this unruffled Finger Art enables its practitioner to deliver formless finger strikes with profound Qi.
Desc_554.cn: 拈花指功出指柔和，从容不迫，意态安详，好似指拈“金色菠萝花”，指力无形无相，乃是由“佛祖拈花，迦叶微笑”之典故而生，极是深奥。

Desc_555.en: Not requiring a build-up of momentum to deliver a thunderous strike, the Vajra Finger defines the word "steadfast." The opponent's bones will crack like rotten twigs before it, and rocks part like stale wool.
Desc_555.cn: 大力金刚指无需借势即能以手指发出千斤之力，可谓力大无穷，厚实刚强至极。以之摧敌筋骨，如断枯槁，破石碎玉，如穿败絮。

Desc_556.en: Circulate your force until you can discern neither its origin nor its end; make your attacks infrangible, inevasible. All evil spirits and outlaws are thus bound within this metaphoric ring, deprived of the chance escape and harm others.
Desc_556.cn: “五指虚捏，圈转成环，力无所生，亦无所终，坚固不破，无能截断”，乃称“少林捏转金刚圈”。一切邪魔外道，皆缚于此圈方寸当中，再难脱缚伤人。

Desc_557.en: The ultimate Finger Art of Shaolin Temple. With moves ancient, simple, and profound, this swift and fierce technique enables its practitioner to pulverize a stone by pinching it with their bare hand.
Desc_557.cn: 少林龙爪手招式古朴精深，迅猛绝伦，指力坚逾钢铁，无固不破，抓树可留痕，搓石可成粉，威力奇大，乃少林指爪之最高绝诣。
Desc_557.ru: Непревзойденное искусство рисования пальцами в храме Шаолинь. Благодаря древним, простым и глубоким движениям, эта быстрая и яростная техника позволяет практикующему превратить камень в пыль, сжимая его голой рукой.

Desc_558.en: The practitioner of this technique seems to have iron claws and flies considering how fast they launch attacks. Truly the practitioner seems like an eagle swooping down on its prey.
Desc_558.cn: 峨眉鹰爪功讲究“臂如翼展，指如钢钩”，出手迅捷，招式狠辣，犹如雄鹰扑食时的姿态，力由双臂而发，指爪顺势伤敌。
Desc_558.ru: У практикующего эту технику, похоже, железные когти и мухи, учитывая, с какой скоростью они проводят Атаки. Воистину, практикующий подобен орлу, пикирующему на свою добычу.

Desc_559.en: The power of the Emei One Finger Chan comes from within, from one's Qi Martial Art that coalesces incorporeally on a point where the user is like a lightning bolt on its opponent.
Desc_559.cn: 峨眉一指禅由内而外，乃是运转内气由指尖外放的内门功法，指力有质而无形，细密而尖锐，触之有如电击，可隔物而发。
Desc_559.ru: Сила Эмэй One Finger Chan исходит изнутри, из Боевой техники Ци, которая бестелесно сливается в точке, где пользователь подобен удару молнии в своего противника.

Desc_560.en: In this style, offense and defense are one. Regarding defense: whether high or low, as long as one maintains peace of mind they will remain free from danger and in harmony. Regarding offense: the flood waters of strikes flow horizontally and thus disaster converges as one.
Desc_560.cn: 跛打八十式攻防一体。守势诀曰：“以上临下，居安思危，相佐相互，上下融洽”；攻势诀曰：“洪水横流，祸乱丛聚，齐发齐收，无往不利”。

Desc_561.en: The fists of practitioners of this style are said to be like poplars and willows in the springtime and are said to move like the wind. The style is also elegant and graceful, constantly moving unpredictably. Its thorns are many, although enemies are best approached from the flanks.
Desc_561.cn: 所谓：“手如三春杨柳，步如风摆荷叶”。分花拂柳式姿态柔美，飘忽无定，招招手采边门，式式绵里藏针，绝不正面迎敌。

Desc_562.en: This technique is used telekinetically. What's more, the further the distance, the greater the blast radius. As the move is unleashed, flashes of light in seven colors are given off, hence the name.
Desc_562.cn: 光相指可隔空而发，所指距离越远，指力笼罩范围越大。出指之际，指上宝光大盛，光有七色，灿然炫目，故名“光相”。
Desc_562.ru: Эта техника используется телекинетически. Более того, чем дальше расстояние, тем больше радиус взрыва. Когда движение запускается, испускаются вспышки света семи цветов, отсюда и название.

Desc_563.en: The Thousand Corporeal Skills has thousands of moves and forms yet also has none for the spirit is the master of the mind, and movement comes from the mind. This truly is one of Emei's most extraordinary Martial Arts.
Desc_563.cn: 通身千手法有千招千式亦无一招一式，一切心随神主，动静从心。所谓：“百折连腰尽无骨，一撒通身皆是手”，堪称峨眉功法之至奇也。

Desc_564.en: The bright mountain, Emei, is primeval and, like it, this technique has mysteries that abound for it is enveloped in ancient Qi, and its form is like that of the primeval chaos when the world first formed. When this technique is used, a cacophony fills the air, and the practitioner seems to become imbued with some otherworldly heroism.
Desc_564.cn: “谓一元者，大始也”。大光明山一元指浑厚奥妙，质如天地正本元初之气，形如混沌而无色无相，出指轰然有声，气贯长虹。

Desc_565.en: This technique focuses on the "Twelve Acupoints" and uses one finger to unleash seven lethal forces. This technique remains a unique secret kept by the Emei Sect.
Desc_565.cn: 天罡指穴法专点人身“十二正经”之要穴，一指点出共生七道奇正相生的罡力，精妙无已，举世无双，乃峨眉派之独门点穴秘传。
Desc_565.ru: Эта техника фокусируется на "двенадцати акупунктурных точках" и использует один палец, чтобы высвободить семь смертоносных сил. Эта техника остается уникальным секретом, хранящимся Сектой Эмэй.

Desc_566.en: Celestial Hand is a legacy technique of Emei's ancestors. Unlike many of Emei Sect's swift and graceful unique arts, it possesses few variations, and its finger force advances without retreat. When unleashed, it manifests the form of an azure loong with devastating might—where it points, life withers and demons perish. Those who perfect this art can seize the very light of the sun, moon, and stars, wielding it like a deity.
Desc_566.cn: 天一神手乃峨眉先祖遗技，与峨眉派诸多迅奇灵逸的绝技大不相同，不仅招式变化奇少，指力更是有进无退，出则化显青龙玄象，玄象所指，生灵死，妖魔灭，威力奇大，天一神手大成者，更可捉日月星辰之光为己用，有神幻之威。

Desc_567.en: This technique is nimble, sharp, and precise, as if one were wielding a needle. It feels sharp and painful to the touch. This technique is a unique in that it attacks the opponents' primary acupoints, as well as vital points like eyes and ears.
Desc_567.cn: 指针功轻巧灵活，指力细密尖锐，有如指间夹针，触之有刺痛感，乃是专门袭击敌身各大穴道及眼耳等脆弱部位的手法。

Desc_568.en: This technique introduces the essence of herbs into the fingers, and can be practiced through the Orthodox or Heterodox path. The Orthodox path enables the target to deaden the sensation of pain, whereas the Heterodox path makes the target tired.
Desc_568.cn: 长春指乃是引百草精华蓄于指内而成，共有正逆两种用法：正，可为人减轻痛楚，化衰提神；逆，可令人神困体乏，剧痛难当。

Desc_569.en: This technique is like electricity. The force of the fingers is like wielding a drill, allowing vital points like eyes, throat, heart, and ribs to be struck. Its effect on the heart is extremely poisonous.
Desc_569.cn: 一指一品红出手如电，指力如锥，直取敌人眼目、咽喉、心口、两肋之要害，中者剧毒攻心，血流如柱，正是：“戳指成血洞，遍开一品红”。

Desc_570.en: The poppy is extremely toxic, particularly the blue variety for it robs one of their intellect and plunges them into an excruciating fit of depression. This technique is graceful, yet unpredictable, and it leaves opponents wishing they had never been born.
Desc_570.cn: “虞美人剧毒，尤以青花者为甚，夺心智，生忧愁，悲痛莫名”。青花虞美人招式华丽，变幻莫测，中者悲从中来，痛不欲生。

Desc_571.en: With this style, for every finger used, there are 49 changes in orientation that are available. Attacks come at opponents from all directions, truly too much to deal with.
Desc_571.cn: 漫天花雨式自上而下，凌空而发，每出一指均含七七四十九种方位变化，好似前后左右并四面八方齐至，令人左支右绌，应接不暇。
Desc_571.ru: При таком стиле для каждого используемого пальца доступно 49 изменений ориентации. Атаки обрушиваются на противников со всех сторон, и с ними действительно слишком сложно справиться.

Desc_572.en: Using the refined poison of a mandala flower, moving but a finger gives off a thick, fragrant aroma that leaves the mind reeling. Those affected become paralyzed, and while they're still alive, they might as well be dead.
Desc_572.cn: 大花曼陀罗指以曼陀罗花之奇毒炼就，运指生香，浓郁扑鼻，闻之心神荡漾，邪魅自生，中者全身麻痹，神魂颠倒，虽生犹死也。

Desc_573.en: This exquisite technique, Flower Fall Moonlit Finger, is the pinnacle of nimbleness, of gentleness. Using it is like a flower blossoming, it is moving and the force of it seems there, yet isn't, like a mirror mirage.
Desc_573.cn: 万花灵月指美妙绝伦，灵动阴柔至极，指出如异花绽放，动人心魄，指力似是而非，若有若无，恰似镜花水月，绝难捉摸。

Desc_574.en: Wait until autumn, the 8th day of the 9th month, thereupon my flower will kill all. This technique's poison is unparalleled. Worse still, it's fast acting. Its strikes are quick and crazed, and none have escaped it alive. There is no greater killer in the Valley of Flowers.
Desc_574.cn: “待到秋来九月八，我花开后百花杀”。百花杀剧毒无比，凌厉无俦，攻势快密如狂，指到身残，无所不杀，乃百花谷绝无仅有的霸道杀手。

Desc_575.en: This style actually is up into "8 Lives and 8 Deaths," meaning that there are 16 in total. This style is ancient and mysterious. No one has ever been able to come to master more than one in their lifetime.
Desc_575.cn: 血朱花八法又分“八生八死”共十六式，乃上古遗技，因过于精微神奇，即令天资最聪颖者亦只能领悟其中一法，能参透二法以上之人可谓千古未有。

Desc_576.en: The Tao created one, which in turn created two, which created three, which then created all things. This technique uses the "Three Pure Ones, the Three Realms, and the Triratna." All three styles are as one. They are all strict, but do not lose their purity nor their nature.
Desc_576.cn: “道生一，一生二，二生三，三生万物”。三清指以“三清、三境、三宝”每三式为一组，法度严谨而不失清和自然。

Desc_577.en: This technique comes from the Flying Claw from Guiguzi. "At first glance, it seems that nothing is there, but where there was nothing there is certainly now something." This technique appears out of nowhere, it flies at opponents, finding their openings, bringing them under control, and allowing the weak to defeat the strong.
Desc_577.cn: 钩钳指由鬼谷子之飞箝术而化，讲究“乍同乍异，用虚引实，空往而实来”，以巧妙手法于绝无破绽当中创造破绽，而后飞而钳之，以弱胜强。

Desc_578.en: The so-called five words are as follows: "disease, resentment, sorrow, anger, and joy." This art of Exotic Weapons is ever-changing, using words and expressions to draw in the enemy and then conquer them.
Desc_578.cn: 所谓五言：“曰病、曰怨、曰忧、曰怒、曰喜”。五言五态手变化多端，乃是以言辞及神态牵引敌人心神意志，进而克敌制胜的奇门功法。

Desc_579.en: This technique's movements are circular, as if there were a fulcrum about which the practitioner was turning. Upon encountering an obstacle, there is a strong force that acts in opposition to it. It is said that one should never go against the force around this fulcrum, only defeat will follow.
Desc_579.cn: 持枢式周行如环，势若“持枢”，一遇阻碍便会生出极强的反击之力，有道是：“持枢，天之正也，不可干而逆之，逆之者，虽成必败”。

Desc_580.en: The moves of this technique are quite peculiar and actually onctradict the general principles of martial arts. The power seems all over the place, and the mind and spirit seem to be in a state of utter chaos. Even those that practice it don't fully understand it. One must have a keen intellect to control it.
Desc_580.cn: 离合指招式古怪，大悖武学常理，一指点出，指力纷杂错乱，形神忽合忽离，纵是运指之人亦无比迷惘，非具察隙知远之大智能者不能驾驭。

Desc_581.en: This technique opens and closes in great display with an unusual and stylish stance. Every move is employed steadily, as if a weighted feather were held in the practitioner's hand.
Desc_581.cn: “指天画地曰合纵，手扫六合即连横”。大阴阳纵横手大开大阖，气度非凡，每一式均平稳送出，可谓缓中寓疾，举轻若重。
Desc_581.ru: Эта техника великолепно открывается и закрывается благодаря необычной и стильной Стойке. Каждое движение выполняется неуклонно, как если бы практикующий держал в руке утяжеленное перо.

Desc_582.en: This secret Taoist technique requires innate Primordial Qi. Its power is true and pure, nearing the source of heaven and earth, the origin of all things. This technique is formidable indeed, like a mountain or the sun itself.
Desc_582.cn: 天地元一指乃道门秘术，非先天元气不能催动。元一指力至真至纯，近乎天地之本源，万物之根本，可谓阳煦山立，百折不摧。

Desc_583.en: Gentle and graceful in appearance, the Mystic Finger focuses on pulling on the opponent's joints of the arm. Its power enables the practitioner to disrupt their opponent from afar.
Desc_583.cn: 一玄手柔和婉转，清丽雅致，或引臂肘，或曳指腕，出指若即若离，烟视媚行，指力有如柔索可以及远，绝不与人过分接近。
Desc_583.ru: Нежный и грациозный на вид, Мистический палец фокусируется на вытягивании суставов руки противника. Его сила позволяет практикующему поражать своего противника издалека.

Desc_584.en: A set of swift finger strikes imbued with genuine Yin power, the Permafrost Finger Art enables its practitioner to freeze whatever their fingertips touch.
Desc_584.cn: 玄冰指法出指迅疾如风，指力即阴且寒，指尖因凝聚纯阴真力以至冰冷刺骨，如罩寒霜，可以点水成冰，所指立即冻结。
Desc_584.ru: Серия быстрых ударов пальцами, наполненных подлинной силой Инь, "Искусство пальцев вечной мерзлоты" позволяет практикующему замораживать все, к чему прикасаются кончики его пальцев.

Desc_585.en: Although easy to learn and deadly in action, the Jade Splinter Finger is a double-edged sword and harmful to the practitioner's heart meridian. It efficiently wipes out enemies, but the practitioners themselves will inevitably be drained of their own life force over time.
Desc_585.cn: 玉殒指上手奇快，杀伤力极大，然而名为“玉殒”，实为两败俱伤之法，一经施展，心脉必损，虽能杀敌，但久而久之，自己亦不免香消而玉殒也。

Desc_586.en: "The Yellow Emperor married a woman from the land of Xiling called Leizu, who was his wife. Leizu is also remembered as the Progenitor of Silk as she invented sericulture." Tactful and subtle, this Finger Art named after an ancient queen unhurriedly disrupts any defense like reeling silk from cocoons.
Desc_586.cn: “黄帝之妃西陵氏曰嫘祖，以其始蚕，故又祀先蚕”。嫘祖剥茧式细腻精微，指力如抽丝剥茧，层层深入，可将一切守御消于无形。

Desc_587.en: Extremely vicious and curious, the Hidden Serpent Style builds up its violent power like a serpent lying in wait. When the time is right, the practitioner's finger will assault the enemy's vital points like a vicious viper.
Desc_587.cn: 寒潭藏虺式极为阴狠古怪，指力可潜藏于敌人四周许久不散，有如虺伏寒潭，不动声色，一旦发作，便似恶虺暴起，直取敌人要害，险恶难当。

Desc_588.en: Graceful, unhurried, and harmonious from a balanced combination of Yin and Yang, the Twelve Styles of Changxi are named after the Goddess who gave birth to 12 moons. Unpredictable like the moons themselves, this Finger Art is a feast for the eyes, yet calamity for every other body part.
Desc_588.cn: 常羲十二式娴雅大方，招式不疾不徐，阴阳调合，指力变幻莫测，有如轻云蔽月，时晦时明，其姿态之美之妙，可谓尽态极妍，天下无双。

Desc_589.en: The Star Gauge, or Xuanji, is a jade disc with a serrated edge that is employed as an astronomical tool. Just as subtle and hushed as the ancient instrument, the Star Gauge Finger can hone in on every vital acupoint of the opponent like the Star Gauge navigates the night sky.
Desc_589.cn: 所谓璇玑：“其变微微，而所动者大”。璇玑指穴法深微玄妙，无声无息，手指不动不移却能以精奇指力笼罩敌人全身要穴。

Desc_590.en: An extremely gentle Finger Art imbued with supreme Yin energy. However, when things reach an extreme, they can only move in the opposite direction; and that's why from gentleness comes robustness, and from supreme Yin ultimate Yang. Even water can be frozen into blades of ice.
Desc_590.cn: 大太阴一明指阴柔至极，然而阴极生阳，柔极必刚，大太阴一明乃是阴中之至阳，柔中之至刚，指出如冰刀霜剑，指力所及，无强不灭。

Desc_591.en: This technique originally comes from bonesetting. When used on opponents, it destroys their joints; it is vicious indeed. It truly is the epitome of taking something meant to do good and using it to do harm.
Desc_591.cn: 柴山擒跌手乃是由正骨之医术所化，以之摧敌关节，手法尤其狠辣。正是：“推揉捏卸法精奇，一捏一卸痛在地，扶臼捏骱出者易，攒打猝弹错骨迭”。

Desc_592.en: Heartbreak Grass is poisonous and kills whoever dares consume it. This technique primarily uses hooks, scratches, grabs, and tears that are poisoned with Heartbreak Grass, making it deadly indeed.
Desc_592.cn: “钩吻者，毒药也，入口即钩人喉吻，食之杀人”。钩吻爪以钩、抓、撕、挠四式为主，指力中暗藏见血封喉的钩吻草毒，极其险恶。
Desc_592.ru: Трава разбитых сердец ядовита и убивает любого, кто осмелится ее съесть. В этой технике в основном используются крючки, царапины, захваты и разрывы, которые Ядами отравлены травой разбитых сердец, что делает ее действительно смертельной.

Desc_593.en: It is written in the Medicina Sutra that "the Iron Flower breaks all maladies, and fiercely so, for it is extremely poisonous." This technique is vicious for it makes use of the poison of said flower. The opponent's bones rot as the poison works its way to the heart, bringing the sweet release of death with it.
Desc_593.cn: 药经有云：“铁花，破诸积冷邪，然其性暴烈，有大毒，非危病不用”。铁花腐骨爪出手狠辣，含有铁花剧毒，中者燥热难当，腐骨穿心而亡。

Desc_594.en: This technique has been described as elegant, noble, possessing of profound yet subtle implications, gentle in its application like water flowing over the opponent, and as transparent as bright jade. It is like this though as the practitioner attacks the opponent's vital points, leaving them paralyzed, their Qi stagnant.
Desc_594.cn: 玉蝉指清雅高洁，寓意深微，出手温和，指力清澈如水，透如明玉，以之点穴截脉，中者固然手足麻痹，内气亦涣散无存。

Desc_595.en: This unique art of the Kongsang Sect makes fingers as hard as polearms when it is employed on the opponent. It resounds against rock and leaves marks on wood. It is peculiar through and through.
Desc_595.cn: 青蛟铁须指乃空桑派之独门绝技，出手之时，五指如须髯戟张，齐发齐收，指力好似铁剪钢鞭，击石有声，抓木成痕，又怪又奇。
Desc_595.ru: Это уникальное искусство Секты Кунсан делает пальцы такими же твердыми, как древковое оружие, когда оно применяется к противнику. Он гулко ударяется о камень и оставляет следы на дереве. Это своеобразно насквозь.

Desc_596.en: Love turns to worry and then to trouble. If separated from love, both of these vanish. Victims of this technique do not feel pain, nor are they in control of their mental faculties in short order either, and thus love and hate both vanish and trouble with them.
Desc_596.cn: 所谓：“由爱故生忧，由爱故生患，若离于爱者，无忧亦无患”。中无患手者，身体绝无痛楚，然而心智全失，爱恨尽消，所以“无患”也。

Desc_597.en: A secret Miao technique that imbues poison in one's inner Qi and attacks with a snake Gu's venom. Although it won't channel Gu larvae into the human body, it will poison the victim with venom as toxic as that of a Gu.
Desc_597.cn: 蛇蛊手乃是引蛇蛊之毒储藏于内气当中，以之毒杀敌人的苗疆秘术。蛇蛊手虽非降蛊之术，但其毒性却与蛊毒无异。

Desc_598.en: A Finger Art that enables the practitioner to infect the opponent with a Bloody-eyed Gu nurtured in a corpse's skull, rendering the victim's face red and swollen, their eyes bleeding and subsequently blind.
Desc_598.cn: 赤目蛊双瞳血红，身有赤斑，乃是于死人头颅当中炼制而成的苗疆蛊虫。赤目蛊降手法极快，中者面目红肿，眼角流血，双目瞬间失明。

Desc_599.en: A strange technique that infects the opponent with dance-like movements and an illusion-inducing fragrance, making them the victim of an Illusionary Gu: a faintly glowing bug with a lilac hue, feeding on various flowers and smoked with dozens of types of fragrant wood.
Desc_599.cn: 螭魅蛊降手法特异，犹如舞蹈，出手之时，奇香暗生，中者心醉神迷，眼前幻象丛生。螭魅蛊经过百花喂养，再以数十种香木熏染，体色淡紫，微微有光。

Desc_600.en: A breed of jet-black bug that reeks with a foul stench, the Corruptive Gu enters the human body through wounds caused by the bone breaking through. Once its toxin enters the marrow, its victim's demise will be all but sealed.
Desc_600.cn: 黑血蛊通体乌黑，奇腥奇臭。黑血蛊降残忍无比，需先穿透敌人血肉，再将黑血蛊施于敌人骨骼之上，而后毒蛊自行钻入骨髓，则无药可解。

Desc_601.en: An infection of the Delirious Gu seizes their victim into throes of madness until they succumb to exhaustion. Almost nothing is known regarding this breed of Gu, except that it's a secret breed that almost never appears and used by the Five Immortals Sect to execute their traitors.
Desc_601.cn: 中心魔蛊者，狂性大发，状如疯魔，非气绝身死不能止歇。心魔蛊乃是五仙教用于惩罚叛徒的秘虫，极难炼制，形态亦鲜为人知。

Desc_602.en: The Tenebrous Gu can only hatch from corpses found in areas imbued with pure Yin energy. Once burrowed into the body of a living creature, it grows rapidly by devouring the host's flesh from within. When it has reached its serpent-like adult stage, it begins to gnaw its way out.
