Desc_602.cn: 以死于至阴之地，命格纯阴的死尸炼养蛊虫，遂成“九阴尸螭蛊”。九阴尸螭蛊一入活人体内便即疯长，饱食血肉后便破体而出，状若大螭。

Desc_603.en: The Gelid Gu is extremely nimble with a jade body; only the most dexterous technique can command and use it to infect enemies. Capable of spinning icy-cold silk, this parasite fills its victim's veins with cold toxins, freezing them to death in an instant. Even the dead body won't decompose, as if kept in cold storage.
Desc_603.cn: 碧玉冰蚕蛊通体碧绿，行走如风，非迅疾如电之降蛊手法不能施为。此蛊奇毒至寒，能吐冰丝，冰丝一旦侵入血脉，中者立刻僵毙，死后尸体不腐。

Desc_604.en: Appearing like a big golden silkworm, the Aureate Gu is exalted as the King of Gu for its deleterious virulence and extraordinary capability of inflicting agony. The keeper of this breed of Gu shall worship it like a deity, or it will most certainly turn on them.
Desc_604.cn: 鬼噬金蚕蛊有如金色大蚕，万中无一。金蚕蛊毒猛如烈火，中者惨不堪言，痛不欲生。施蛊者需敬之如神明，否则金蚕反噬，自害其身。

Desc_605.en: The sole survivor of 10,000 venomous Gu devouring one another becomes the Prismatic Gu. With an indescribable appearance and unpredictable behavior, this nearly sentient parasite that understands human language can only be tamed with the Five Immortals Sect's secret skill.
Desc_605.cn: 百彩青髓蛊以万蛊炼育而成，其色无名，其体无形，可飞天遁地，如鬼似魅，唯苗疆五仙教之镇教降蛊秘法方能驱驭，此蛊极通灵性，能懂人言。

Desc_606.en: By the time the opponent realizes it, this technique has already been employed due to its surreptitious method. For the opponent, "left becomes right, right becomes left, up becomes down, and down becomes up."
Desc_606.cn: 无形小擒拿出手隐秘，招招倒行逆施，讲究“左为右用，右为左用，左右逆行；上为下用，下为上用，上下倒施”。

Desc_607.en: This technique is quick and vigorous, yet flexible, like a bowstring. It is able to deal critical damage to opponents' hearts and heads from a hundred paces.
Desc_607.cn: 摘星式轻快矫捷，走转行功极其灵活，指出如箭离弦，可于百步之外袭取敌人心口要害，故而“摘星”实为“摘心”也。
Desc_607.ru: Эта техника быстрая и энергичная, но в то же время гибкая, как тетива лука. Он способен наносить критический урон сердцам и головам противников с расстояния в сто шагов.

Desc_608.en: The emperor hid ice in the well, and gave it to the minister while lying in the sun. This technique compels opponents' True Qi to flow through the practitioner's veins, using ' pure Yin to expel opponents' Yang energy, leading to their exhaustion and death.
Desc_608.cn: 所谓：“帝王藏冰于井，伏日以赐大臣”。玉井化脉手能引敌人真气从自身带脉穿流而过，其间以自身纯阴之力化去对方阳元，致其力竭而亡。

Desc_609.en: This technique leaves no evidence as it is employed, although it leaves an incision that appears to have been made by a blade of ice for the wound is covered in white frost. Even if one survives the attack, recovery is extremely difficult.
Desc_609.cn: 伏阴指出入不露行迹，指力暗生暗发，中者仿佛被冰刀冰剑所割伤，伤口凝起白霜，纵然能够保住性命，此伤亦极难痊愈。

Desc_610.en: There are seven moves to this technique derived from the Seven Luminaries: "sun, moon, metal, wood, water, fire, and earth." Each move, in turn, has seven variants. This technique, whether generating or overcoming each other, multiplying, or reinventing, has variants that are divine indeed.
Desc_610.cn: 天劫七曜指共有“日、月、金、木、水、火、土”七式，每一式又有七变。七曜指力既有相生，又有相克，或生生不息，或灭而后生，可谓变化如神。

Desc_611.en: This technique is sinister, and its moves are strange. Its victims turn blue, and their Zang-fu organs become frozen. It takes seven days for the suffering it brings to end in death.
Desc_611.cn: 玄冥指阴毒无比，其招式固然精奇古怪，出指更挟有阵阵阴邪厉风，中者全身发青，脏腑尽皆冻毁，非受尽七日折磨不能就死。
Desc_611.ru: Эта техника зловеща, и ее движения странны. Его жертвы синеют, а их органы Занг-фу замораживаются. Требуется семь дней, чтобы страдания, которые она приносит, закончились смертью.

Desc_612.en: The Taisu Finger of Veil Scar Cliff is not passed on to outsiders. It has four moves, and they are odd and unique, yet merciless. It is difficult for its victims to escape with their lives.
Desc_612.cn: 太素绝手共有四式，乃界青崖之不传绝学。因其“功力至奇至绝，出手绝不留情，手段绝无仅有，中者绝难活命”，所以谓之“绝手”。
Desc_612.ru: Палец Тайсу со скалы Вуалевого шрама не передается посторонним. В нем четыре хода, и они странные и уникальные, но в то же время безжалостные. Его жертвам трудно спастись, сохранив свою жизнь.

Desc_613.en: This technique is constantly changing, and quickly at that. "As soon as you see it, it's already changed. If you see it to the left, it's already on the right." All those who see this technique admit to being utterly confused.
Desc_613.cn: 错神指瞬息万变，快逾心念电闪，正是：“观其在前，实已在后，观其在左，实已在右”，见此指法者无不生出莫大的错乱之感，故名“错神”。

Desc_614.en: Yin and Yang don't change, and the desert is always empty. At the beginning of the universe, there's no Qi, only Taiyi. This technique gives off no light and appears to be formless, as its power, which has no name, turns all to dust. It is marvelous indeed.
Desc_614.cn: “阴阳未变，恢漠太虚，神之始而未见气也，谓之太易”。太易琉璃指无光无象，指力无形无名，所指之物，无不化为齑粉，好似叱石成羊，神异至极。

Desc_615.en: A technique commonly used in street fights between hoodlums and despised by real martial artists. Apparently those from the Sanguine Sect aren't among the latter.
Desc_615.cn: 戳眼削耳功乃是市井无赖打架时所常用的技法，讲究“斜削顺抓，指不离眼”，尽是为江湖人士所不齿的恶毒招术。
Desc_615.ru: Прием, обычно используемый в уличных драках между хулиганами и презираемый настоящими мастерами боевых искусств. Очевидно, те, кто принадлежит к Багряной секте, не относятся к числу последних.

Desc_616.en: A move that excels at sneak attacks. Disguised as a normal blow, by the time the victim realizes the target is their throat, it is already too late, and they will suffer from severe indiscernible damage later.
Desc_616.cn: 锁喉阴手擅于偷袭，出手诡诈阴险，绝不显露痕迹，待到敌人察觉指爪来势有异，已为阴劲闭气锁喉，受到极大的暗伤。

Desc_617.en: A vicious technique that seeks to sever an opponent's tendons or break their joints. Rather than dealing direct damage, the focus of this technique is to neutralize the opponent's ability to fight by inflicting great pain.
Desc_617.cn: 分筋错骨手共有“分筋”与“错骨”二法，乃是专门摧残敌人手足四肢各大关节的擒拿术，其杀伤力虽然有限，但中者剧痛难当，苦不堪言。

Desc_618.en: The most infamous finger art to come out of the Sanguine Sect. The sole requirement for its learner is be "shamelessness." It's the easiest of all moves that targets the opponent's genitalia. The ultimate goal is to ensure the enemy dies without descendants.
Desc_618.cn: 三指夺阴爪乃是血犼教最恶名昭彰的狠辣指法，此功易学易练，要旨唯“无耻”二字，其招式尽是低伏窜下，走腋夺阴，中者不免终身残疾，子孙断绝。

Desc_619.en: Something poisonous will rise from one's own wicked ideas. With the Poison Loong Claw technique, one can emit nightmarish black fog from their fingertips and directly damage their opponent's heart and lungs, who will vomit black water and die in five days.
Desc_619.cn: 所谓：“邪妄生毒龙，妖魔与心通”。毒龙爪能五指齐发黑雾，极其骇人，其恶毒直攻心肺，中者五日后必口喷黑水而死。

Desc_620.en: A fiendish Finger Art said to come out of the netherworld. Poisoned by the practitioner's fingers, the flesh and tissue under the scar it leaves will eventually melt into yellow pus and gush out.
Desc_620.cn: 黄泉者，其指有二：“其一，此功恶毒无比，指力阴邪有如黄泉阴风；其二，中黄泉指者，恶毒难除，伤口血肉无不化为黄浆泉涌而出”。
Desc_620.ru: Дьявольское искусство рисования пальцами, о котором говорят, что оно пришло из преисподней. Яд, нанесенный пальцами практикующего, приводит к тому, что плоть и ткани под шрамом, которые он оставляет, в конечном итоге превращаются в желтый гной и вытекают наружу.

Desc_621.en: To practice this technique, one shall absorb blood from human and animals alike through forbidden methods until they can imbibe blood through wounds from their fingertips, using the victims' vital energy to intensify their power.
Desc_621.cn: 血池鬼爪乃是以秘传邪功采取人畜鲜血修炼而成。鬼爪凌厉残忍，中者血液逆流，尽数被鬼爪所吸食，鬼爪吸血愈多，威力愈强。

Desc_622.en: This technique relies heavily on the legs, and if the practitioner's legs are limber, it can be like having four arms as they shoot out like bullets. It is a vigorous and swift technique for sure. If the practitioner lands their first blow, its power will spell a quick end.
Desc_622.cn: “手是两扇门，全凭腿打人，弹腿四只手，人怕鬼见愁”。元山弹腿精悍明快，首重突发迅击，其势弹如弹丸，故名“弹腿”。

Desc_623.en: The steps of practitioners of this technique are light and the body supple. Distance poses no obstacle as there are moves that can cover any distance. Where one foot goes, the other follows, like a pair of Mandarin ducks.
Desc_623.cn: 鸳鸯连环脚步轻身活，近可戳击点脚，远可连环飞踢，诀曰：“有上即有下，有左即有右，左脚发，右脚随，连绵不断，成双配偶，谓之鸳鸯”。

Desc_624.en: The practitioner of this technique is agile and vigorous. This technique focuses on interceptions and counters. When the legs are used, there's no sign that they're strking, despite this, the kicks the practitioner lands are powerful, frightening even.
Desc_624.cn: 虎尾功走转矫捷，乃是截打反击之术，不仅出腿全无征兆，说发便发，而且腿力刚劲强实，扫摆生风，于危急之际施展出来，声势惊人。

Desc_625.en: The name of this technique comes from the nine vaults of heaven and the eight trigrams of the bagua. As one advances, they attack; as they retreat, they defend. The form may seem chaotic, but it is actually the opposite.
Desc_625.cn: 九宫乱八步乃是由九宫八卦之数演化而来，共有顺、逆、阴、阳九九八十一种变化，进可攻，退可守，形乱而意整。

Desc_626.en: This technique comes from the western regions. The legs of the practitioner are formidable. Wherever they step, be it mountain or stone, they both crack. Those who master this skill can step foot on an iron urn and leave deep impressions.
Desc_626.cn: 大力金刚腿传自西域，出腿刚烈至极，所踏之处，山石崩裂，树倒墙摧，功力精纯者，能在大钟铁鼎之上踏出数寸深的足印。

Desc_627.en: In ancient times, five warriors stood mighty and unrivaled, and this technique has only five moves, but those that practice it are said to be able to shatter rocks and split open mountains. This technique's power and might are without bounds.
Desc_627.cn: “五丁者，古之五力士也，千斤力，无人敌”。五丁开山腿共有搬、移、倒、辟、开五式，可谓踏石可开山，投足可辟路，力大无比，威力无穷。

Desc_628.en: The practitioner of this technique has unusual speed and variability when it comes to their kicks. It is as if the practitioner has nine legs, although the force that these nine legs deliver is not the same.
Desc_628.cn: 云龙九现腿出腿奇快，变化极多，能于一瞬之间踢出九腿，每一腿的力道和方位绝不相同，犹如以一化九，故曰“云龙九现”也。

Desc_629.en: This supreme art of Greater Yuanshan is said to create crevices in the earth. The ancients said: "The mountains of Penglai rested upon the giant tortoise Ao's shell, and it roams the sea." It is said to have the ability to frighten mountains and rivers and to overturn the sea and rivers alike.
Desc_629.cn: 鳌王神腿足发地陷，雄强无俦，乃大元山之镇山绝学。古人云：“巨鳌背负蓬莱之山，而抃舞戏沧海之中”，故谓其有震慑山河，倒海翻江之能。

Desc_630.en: The name of this supreme art of Lesser Yuanshan comes from a Bodhisattva's transformation into a white elephant with six tusks. "The six tusks represent the six divine paths, and the four feet of the elephant represent the four bases of spiritual power." This technique's might is extensive, and its effect is a sight to behold.
Desc_630.cn: 六牙四神足乃小元山之镇山绝学，名由菩萨所化之六牙白象而来：六牙表“无漏六神通”；四足表“四如意足”。此功威能广大，神效非常。

Desc_631.en: Head below, feet above, upside down, flying to Heaven. As evidenced by this saying, the aim of this technique is to attack the enemy in a completely unexpected manner.
Desc_631.cn: 倒打冲天子讲究“头下脚上，拔地而起，上下颠倒，冲天而发”，旨在以出人意表之姿态，攻敌于措手不及之瞬间。
Desc_631.ru: Голова внизу, ноги вверху, вверх тормашками, летим к небесам. Как свидетельствует это высказывание, целью этой техники является Атака противника совершенно неожиданным образом.

Desc_632.en: Danger abounds, or so it seems, although that is not quite the case. Offense can turn to defense and back in but an instant.
Desc_632.cn: 柴山一步转脚踩奇门遁甲，步步直踏凶门，看似险象环生，实则动静相应，虽危实安，攻防之势只在一步之间便能调转。
Desc_632.ru: Опасность изобилует, по крайней мере, так кажется, хотя это не совсем так. Нападение может превратиться в оборону и обратно всего за одно мгновение.

Desc_633.en: This Exotic Art is light, nimble, and quick, having the practitioner appear as if they were leaping. Its accuracy is incomparable in striking acupoints with the foot.
Desc_633.cn: 杜鹃啄蛛式轻捷灵动，快密跳脱，走转翩翩跹跹，好似足不点地，出腿疾如骤雨，精准无比，乃是以足尖攻击敌人穴道的奇门腿法。
Desc_633.ru: Это экзотическое искусство легкое, ловкое и быстрое, заставляющее практикующего выглядеть так, как будто он прыгает. Его точность ни с чем не сравнима при нанесении ударов по акупунктурным точкам стопой.

Desc_634.en: There is a saying: "The Kongsang Sect's urn can both take and save lives, and the eight styles determine heaven and earth." The Kongsang Sect's Kicking Arts are quick, sturdy, and vigorous. Their kicks resound with a clang, like jade against metal.
Desc_634.cn: 有道是：“空桑药鼎判生死，大小八式定乾坤”，磕金震玉小八式乃空桑派之腿法精义所在，动迅静定，小巧精悍，出腿有锵锵之声，如金玉相击。

Desc_635.en: This technique only has one teachnique, and it'sy to fight for your life like a wolf backed into a corner. It is assuredly fierce, though.
Desc_635.cn: 青蛟摆尾功只有一式，乃是败中求胜，伤人伤己的搏命一击，因其狠恶刚烈，出其不意，故也被称为“青蛟断尾同生共死式”。
Desc_635.ru: У этой техники есть только одна методика обучения, и она заключается в том, чтобы бороться за свою жизнь, как волк, загнанный в угол. Однако это, несомненно, жестоко.

Desc_636.en: This unique Kicking Art of the Kongsang Sect has the practitioner fly about without pause from the moment it's employed. The more the practitioner does so though, the more intense and more formidable it is.
Desc_636.cn: 青蛟翻腾腿乃空桑派之独门腿法，施展开来，上下翻飞，腾踔太空，绝无片刻停歇，其势愈翻愈烈，愈腾愈强，不衰而反盛。

Desc_637.en: This martial art is the essence of the Kongsang Sect's Kicking Arts, light, swift and powerful. It is like the wind sweeping across the land or the ocean smashing against the cliffs. It is truly worthy of the saying "The Kongsang's urn can both take and save lives, and the eight styles determine Heaven and Earth."
Desc_637.cn: 飞山断海大八式乃空桑派之腿法精义所在，轻迅猛绝，横空超世，有风行电扫，山奔海立之威，无愧人称：“空桑药鼎判生死，大小八式定乾坤”。

Desc_638.en: This is one of the Kongsang Sect's best techniques. It is written that "Yin yearns for Yang, as does Yang yearn for Yin. Ambition is in the Dark Palace." This technique overcomes and generates itself. Its defense resides in its offense. Its offense always overcomes, and its defense is always solid.
Desc_638.cn: 玄鼎百步乃空桑派第一奇功，经云：“阴怀于阳，阳怀于阴，志在玄宫”，此功自相生克，寓守于攻，攻必克，守必坚，精微奥妙至极。

Desc_639.en: A Kicking Art that targets the opponent's genitalia. Basic, yet as wicked as any other technique to come out of an evil martial arts school, it can deprive the victim of the ability to engage in carnal activity.
Desc_639.cn: 撩阴腿乃是专攻敌人裆部之腿法，虽然招式粗浅，但阴损程度却不亚于任何邪派武功，中者往往受害极深，不能人道。

Desc_640.en: A curious kick performed by pivoting away from the target while facing them, and then striking abruptly straight backward. It can be launched without warning, thus it's extremely deadly to those who know little about it.
Desc_640.cn: 蛤蟆倒踢腿姿态诡异，乃是倒转身体向股后猝然飞踢的独门功法，能够凭空而发，无需行功借势，不识此腿法者极易受其暗害。

Desc_641.en: The Teng Serpent brings suspicions and annoyances, and the Black Tortoise likes to steal. A set of leg techniques that is full of feints and focuses on distracting the enemy to manipulate them.
Desc_641.cn: “无常起腾蛇，讹中复有讹，玄武喜偷盗，心惊肉乱跳”。无常脚虚招极多，尽是诱敌与扰敌之术，只待敌人心烦意乱，这才趁虚而入。
Desc_641.ru: Змея Тэн вызывает подозрения и досаду, а Черная черепаха любит воровать. Набор приемов ногами, который полон финтов и направлен на то, чтобы отвлечь противника и манипулировать им.

Desc_642.en: With appalling precision and nimble movement, the practitioner of the Scorpion Kick cuts through their opponent's movement and strikes them fiercely.
Desc_642.cn: 蝎子勾魂脚戳打奇准，变化奇速，讲究：“扑前抢后，以快打慢，忽收忽放，以动制静”，招式无不以抢占先机为主，攻势尤其凌厉。
Desc_642.ru: С ужасающей точностью и проворным движением практикующий удар Скорпиона перехватывает движение своего противника и яростно наносит ему удар.

Desc_643.en: The marching White Tiger shall devour two people with each of its steps; even Immortals won't stand a chance before its wings. Designed in accordance with the bad omens in divination, the Deadly March will most definitely bring bloodshed through its ferocious moves.
Desc_643.cn: 边走边杀乃是由凶神数格而化，左应太阴，右应白虎，这正是：“白虎走太阴，一步吃一人，两胁还生翅，神仙也丧命”，可谓双足一发，便要杀人。

Desc_644.en: The unpredictable hurling movement of this kick will raise a sinister wind that disturbs the enemy's Inner Breath, causing their limbs to shake and stomach wrench.
Desc_644.cn: 大阴风腿起腿不见影，出腿不见形，腿力一发便有阴风相随，可及数丈之外，当者立即四肢颤抖，烦恶欲呕，内息已受到极大的损害。
Desc_644.ru: Непредсказуемое метательное движение этого удара поднимет зловещий ветер, который нарушит Внутреннее дыхание противника, заставляя его конечности дрожать, а желудок скручиваться.

Desc_645.en: Consisting of ten moves, the Yamaraja Strikes imitates each Yamas of the Netherworld's ten chambers, bloodcurdling and death-dealing.
Desc_645.cn: 阎王鬼脚共有十式，自第一殿“秦广王”至第十殿“转轮王”，每式皆模仿一位阎罗索命时的狰狞姿态，出脚奇诡怪异，鬼气森森，骇人可怖已极。
Desc_645.ru: Состоящий из десяти приемов, "Удары Ямараджи" имитирует каждый Яма из десяти покоев Преисподней, леденящий кровь и несущий смерть.

Desc_646.en: Coming from strange lands overseas, the Bloodshadow Kick is a brutal technique that dismembers anyone in its way like a hacksaw. The victim will disintegrate into a bloody mist, hence the name.
Desc_646.cn: 血影腿传自海外绝域，腿法离奇古怪，残忍至极，中者皮肉分离，筋骨断折，犹如身中锯齿钢刀，血影弥漫之中，身体断为数截而死。
Desc_646.ru: Пришедший из чужих заморских земель удар Кровавой тени - это жестокая техника, которая расчленяет любого на своем пути, как ножовка. Жертва распадется на кровавый туман, отсюда и название.

Desc_647.en: Poison made from the Toxilla Feather, soaked in liquor, will kill anyone who drinks it. This technique can turn medicine on one's finger into mist with a gentle fragrance, similar to something fermented. Victims of this technique will find an aromatic end.
Desc_647.cn: “鸩羽之为物，浸酒有毒，饮之立死”。鸩羽香之法可将指上所沾之药霜化为雾气，此雾闻之甜香，好似醇酿，中者如饮鸩酒而立死。

Desc_648.en: This technique seems quite delicate, even as it poisons its targets. It is extremely difficult to be rescued from the inevitable fate that descends upon its victims. "When the Eight Immortals send you to the other shore, life and death are not in the hands of man."
Desc_648.cn: 彼岸八仙子出手阴柔，能以八指齐发八种不同的剧毒，变化繁多，极难解救，中者唯有待死，正是：“八仙渡尔到彼岸，生死来去不由人”。

Desc_649.en: If one wants to use this technique, they must first hide poison in their mouth and nose. As they draw near an enemy, the practitioner will surprise them as they exhale the poison. Victims will become dazed and then faint.
Desc_649.cn: 欲施惊梦香之法，需先暗藏药霜于口鼻之内，临敌之际，则可出其不意，呵出毒气以制敌，中此毒者，如入幻梦，立刻昏厥。

Desc_650.en: This technique involves an odd poison cream created by mixing poison with fresh blood. It congeals when exposed to air, taking on a form similar to that of a daffodil. It can be thrown to kill victims instantly.
Desc_650.cn: 碧血水仙乃是以药霜混入敌我鲜血而成的奇毒，毒血一遇空气便即凝固，形如六瓣水仙，坚逾金铁，可投之以杀敌，中者立毙。

Desc_651.en: The Nine Idiocies are purportedly "heartache, insomnia, missing meals, fatigue, organ failure, uncertainty, joylessness, fainting, and inability to analyze." This technique deals brain damage through the eyes, leaving a descent into madness for the victim.
Desc_651.cn: 所谓“九痴”：“心撮、失寝、忘餐、形劳、脏伤、不定、无欢、志昏、神殆”。九痴香发如红雾，可由双目侵入颅脑，中者身不由己，就此疯癫。

Desc_652.en: This secret technique of the Kongsang Sect uses rain and dew as an intermediary for a potent poison that kills with but a dab. This virulent powder generates a black fluid with a foul stench.
Desc_652.cn: 黑水断肠散乃是以雨露清水为媒，泼洒毒液以杀敌的空桑派秘传毒术，此毒猛恶绝伦，沾之立毙，所发毒水乌黑腥臭，故名“黑水”。
Desc_652.ru: Эта секретная техника Секты Кунсан использует дождь и росу в качестве посредника для получения сильнодействующего Яда, который убивает одним прикосновением. Этот ядовитый порошок образует черную жидкость с неприятным запахом.

Desc_653.en: Formless and colorless, this poison dissipates, turning into a mist. Victims smell a strange odor, but by that point, the poison has already seeped into their bone marrow.
Desc_653.cn: 百邪销骨香无形无色，所发毒雾时聚时散，若有若无，中者全身异香骤起，奇毒已然透入骨髓，闻者同受其害，可谓流毒无穷。
Desc_653.ru: Бесформенный и бесцветный, этот Яд рассеивается, превращаясь в туман. Жертвы чувствуют странный запах, но к этому моменту Яд уже просочился в их костный мозг.

Desc_654.en: Infusing one's own bloodstream with poison cream and muddling the Qi in the five Zang organs. This poison becomes activated when the practitioner is injured. It's so virulent that any plants, herbs, gold, or stones turn into sullied water when they come into contact with the blood.
Desc_654.cn: 以毒霜融入自身血脉，周行三千遍，化五脏至浊之气于其中，遂成“青蛟血”。青蛟血遇伤则发，至毒至恶，任何草木金石沾之即化为污水。

Desc_655.en: This peculiar poison is injected into the body and concentrates in the bone marrow of the practitioner, but it also flows within their meridians. Once activated, it can be released using their Qi. A red Crabapple Blossom symbol appears on the left side of the chest of the victims, and when it does, death is certain.
Desc_655.cn: 鬼骨血海棠乃是附于行功者骨髓当中，随周身经脉流动的天下第一奇毒，此毒一经催动，即可随内气而发，中者心口显出赤色海棠花印，必死无疑。

Desc_656.en: Although there are only ten moves to this technique, there are thousands of variants, so there's more complexity to it than initially meets the eye. The secret to this sect's techniques is to keep one's hands and feet concealed.
Desc_656.cn: 界青十诀虽只有十式，但变化万千，极其繁复，其要诀：“藏手匿足，一触即发”更是界青门诸般暗器手法之根本所在。

Desc_657.en: Even if the practitioner holds the softest of flower petals, as soon as they imbue it with their Qi, it becomes a lethal weapon. This technique relies on Concealed Weapons infused with Qi to deal damage in a surreptitious manner.
Desc_657.cn: 纵是极柔软的花瓣树叶，一旦为内力所附，亦能化为伤人的利器。摘叶飞花术全凭暗器上所附之内劲伤人，出手隐秘，有质无形。

Desc_658.en: There are 72 moves to this technique, although every time the practitioner launches an attack, they pull off a combination of 12 of them. As such, the practitioner has to be quick with their hands, like lightning in fact, so much so that it looks like they have six arms.
Desc_658.cn: 无影六手共有七十二式，每次出手必十二式齐发，只因手法奇快，迅如闪电，难分先后，无迹可寻，十二式恍如一式，故谓之“六手”。

Desc_659.en: Like lightning illuminating objects or a meteor in the night sky. The Concealed Weapons employed by practitioners of this technique are imbued with Qi, making them swift and vicious weapons able to strike like a bolt of lightning or a meteor through the sky.
Desc_659.cn: “划为飞电来照物，乍作流星并上空”。以飞星术所发之暗器附有极强的内劲，其势凌厉迅猛，望之白光闪烁，好似一枚飞星。

Desc_660.en: Grasp it when you see it, and throw it as you do. Ten fingers move at a very high speed. Onlookers claim this technique looks like a chaotic mess, but the truth is that it indeed belies an order. If one does not possess the incredible celerity demanded, one will have no hope of using this technique.
Desc_660.cn: 乱飞蝗讲究：“见物便抓，随抓随掷，十指连珠，间不容息”，看似杂乱无章，实则杂中有序，乱中有度，非应变奇速，功力精湛者不能施为。

Desc_661.en: Derived from the 64 hexagrams of the Book of Changes, this technique in form is like "the Weiji hexagram displaying constant changes and limitless power," and in substance it is like "the Jiji hexagram balancing water and fire, its Qi as one." It is both mysterious and unpredictable indeed.
Desc_661.cn: 爻图奇术由易经六十四卦而化，其形“上下未济，变化未尽，余力无穷”，其质“取坎填离，水火既济，气力一体”，可谓精微玄奇，深奥莫测。

Desc_662.en: This technique's momentum is as astonishing as its might. When objects are thrown, it sounds like they are ripping the air itself apart, like the roar of a Loong. Victims fall to the four incredible forces that it employs: drilling, pressing, obliterating, and twisting.
Desc_662.cn: 鸣龙掷声势惊人，威力极大，掷物有破空之声，好似龙啸狮吼，鼓角齐鸣，暗含钻、压、去、扭四种巨力，当者无不分崩离析。

Desc_663.en: When the acupoints are sealed, movement stops, as does breathing and the flow of Qi. The ultimate result is the death of the victim in short order as their body grows cold and stiff, and their shadow remains in place.
Desc_663.cn: “穴道立闭，行动立止，呼吸立停，气息立断，中者立时毙命，周身立刻冰冷，躯体立即僵硬，形影就此凝定”，谓之“定影”也。

Desc_664.en: This technique, when performed successfully, imbues the body's True Qi with vigor. When unleashed upon an opponent, True Qi attacks the opponent. If they flee, it gives chase. The Concealed Weapons that the practitioner carries are activated along with their True Qi.
Desc_664.cn: 无想神通乃界青门之不世奇功，功成以后，周身真气如有灵性，逢敌自起，遇难自解，敌逃自追，见血自回，无需动念，所携暗器已随气自发。

Desc_665.en: This unique Concealed Weapon Art of Fuloong Sanctuary relies on the hands and feet stirring up wind that hurls objects at opponents. The hands and feet are essentials to this technique; the hands can lift sand and the feet, stones.
Desc_665.cn: 飞沙走石乃是伏龙坛之独门暗器手法，全凭手足激荡起一股劲风以之挟物伤人，出手不拘一格：手能扬沙，足可抛石。

Desc_666.en: Mighty force is used to throw two objects, one after the other, like fire after a bolt of lightning. When the two objects collide in front of the opponent, it's like a mighty clap of thunder.
Desc_666.cn: 以刚猛手法分别掷出两物，两物一缓一疾，一先一后，好似疾雷追火瓮，只待两物于敌人身前相互碰撞便可发出威力极大的震击，此即是“雷火搭”也。
Desc_666.ru: Могучая сила используется для того, чтобы бросить два предмета один за другим, как огонь после удара молнии. Когда два объекта сталкиваются на глазах у противника, это похоже на мощный раскат грома.

Desc_667.en: This incredibly profound Exotic Weapons art is used to expel Qi from the mouth, which is used to propel Concealed Weapons at opponents. When expelling Qi, the practitioner's throat gives off a sound like that of a Loong.
Desc_667.cn: 所谓“龙吐珠”，乃是以极深厚之功力吐出内气，以之催动暗器迸发伤人的奇门功法。吐气之时，行功者喉发异声，隆隆然好似潜龙低呤。

Desc_668.en: It is said that "the left hand is Yin, and the right is Yang, thus the two work in concert to balance the two." To use this technique, one must use both hands to propel the Concealed Weapons being used, which receive incredible vigorous force akin to that of a wildfire.
Desc_668.cn: 诀曰：“左手为阴右手阳，左右互逐阴阳转”。赤青神火劲发力必用双手，所发之暗器受正反两股劲力牵引而疾转，力道成倍剧增，猛逾烈火。

Desc_669.en: This technique is ferocious, nay vicious without compare, for the practitioner of this technique turns red as their blood boils. Although the practitioner can't keep it up for long, the power that it imparts is incredible to say the least.
Desc_669.cn: 焚血功狂猛暴烈，凶狠无比，行功者遍体赤红，血沸如焚，虽然此功过于霸道不能持久，但此时随手一掷就能生出千斤巨力。

Desc_670.en: This Exotic Weapons unique art infuses implements with Yang Qi that is incredibly strong, so much so that if it is not released, it will backfire on the practitioner, destroying the item once touched.
Desc_670.cn: 九炼金乌也称“九注横劲”，乃是将九股至阳至烈的内劲灌注于器物之上的奇门绝技，九注横劲无比强横，劲成便要脱手放出，否则手足触之立毁。
Desc_670.ru: Это уникальное искусство создания экзотического оружия наполняет предметы Ци Ян, которая невероятно сильна, настолько, что, если ее не высвободить, она будет иметь обратный эффект на практикующего, разрушая предмет после прикосновения.

Desc_671.en: The moves of Ghost Powder practitioners in the Sanguine Sect are generally haphazard, providing no rules to follow. However, this unique concealed weapon's strength has never relied on method, so the only way to master it is to improvise and win by surprise.
Desc_671.cn: 野鬼毒砂招式杂乱，毫无章法可循，然而毒砂暗器向来不以法度为根本，唯有临机应变，出奇制胜方为其上乘之要义也。

Desc_672.en: Coming from the practitioner's stained Qi, the toxicity of Vermin Powder is slow to take effect, yet extremely difficult to diffuse. Even the practitioners themselves must abstain from directly touching it.
Desc_672.cn: 腐虫砂乃行功者体内浊沉之气所化，虽然毒性缓慢，但倘若沾染半点便极难净除，故运用此法者必先以衣物布袋包裹住毒砂之后方能以之施为。

Desc_673.en: Concealed between the practitioner's legs, the Bone-corroding Powder is the single foulest and most corrupt poison powder. Once exposed to air, the poison will diffuse on the wind, threatening even the practitioners themselves.
Desc_673.cn: 蚀骨烂肠砂暗藏于阴股之间，其质最是污秽，其毒最是阴邪，此砂一离阴股，所含恶毒便随风而发，即令育此毒砂者也绝不敢轻易触碰。

Desc_674.en: Even the dead would be driven away from their own grave. Concealed under both feet, the Graveyard Powder diffuses with each step its owner takes, poisoning anyone or anything nearby.
Desc_674.cn: 所谓：“一步枯骨一步砂，脚踏黄坟鬼离家”。黄坟砂裹于足底，伸足即发，其毒性之猛恶，纵是坟中恶鬼也不免退避三舍，离“家”而逃。
Desc_674.ru: Даже мертвые были бы изгнаны из своей собственной могилы. Скрытый под обеими ногами, Кладбищенский порошок рассеивается с каждым шагом его владельца, Ядом отравляя любого или что-либо поблизости.

Desc_675.en: The noxious Golden Toad Powder must be concealed between their teeth and in fingernails through secret methods, enabling its practitioner to poison their opponent by merely blowing or flicking their fingers. The faces of those infected will turn a flaxen color, and they will die with their eyes wide open.
Desc_675.cn: 金蟾五毒砂招式诡异，毒性极烈，需以秘传之法将毒砂嵌藏于牙间与指爪之中，临敌之际，只需弹指吹气便能杀人，中者面如金纸，无不目眦尽裂而死。

Desc_676.en: The powder is among the most difficult weapons to wield using pure Qi, yet the practitioners of Arachnid Powder are capable of controlling each grain of powder separately, like a spider reigns over its web.
Desc_676.cn: 以气御砂固然艰难，然而毒娘子砂之技却能将所御之毒砂颗颗分开，好似每颗毒砂之上均悬有细丝，可随意牵引往来，犹如奇幻。

Desc_677.en: The unique art of the Sanguine Sect. Concealing the noxious powder under their tongue and in their throat, the practitioners of Sanguine Powder would strike, utilizing the strong True Qi coming out of their Dantian, annihilating their enemies.
Desc_677.cn: 血犼砂绝技诡恶无比，乃是将剧毒细砂藏于舌下喉间，再以丹田至强至烈之真气狂喷而出以之灭敌的可怖功法。

Desc_678.en: "Emei always points its sword tip against enemies." This technique is light and elegant. Its moves never cease, like birds chasing shadows, and the sword always points toward the enemy.
Desc_678.cn: 所谓：“剑不行尾，方是峨眉”。拂花掠影剑轻灵飘逸，招式连绵不断，好似燕雀逐影，蝴蝶穿花，剑尖绝不偏转，始终直指敌身。
Desc_678.ru: "Эмэй всегда направляет острие своего Меча против врагов". Эта техника легка и элегантна. Его движения никогда не прекращаются, подобно птицам, гоняющимся за тенями, и Меч всегда направлен в сторону врага.

Desc_679.en: This technique has a long history. It is said that the technique was passed down to Taoists of the Emei Sect by the white apes living on the mountain. It loose in its movements yet precise, simple, and flexible. Sword length matters not.
Desc_679.cn: 猿公剑法源远流长，相传乃是山中白猿传授给峨眉山道人的剑术，其招式外松内紧，古朴灵动，行剑长短并用，一任自然。

Desc_680.en: Offense and defense are combined as one in this technique. The sword flies through the air like a swallow and stops like the fading wind. This technique is the essence of the Emei style, and its name comes from the White Mei Master who founded the Emei Sect.
Desc_680.cn: 白眉剑法攻防一体，虽柔亦刚，剑行似燕飞，剑落如风停。因传自峨眉派之白眉祖师，故名“白眉剑法”，可谓峨眉剑术之根基所在。

Desc_681.en: It is said that "in the windy swamp, there are floating visitors, and water and fire alike hollow out what is real therein." Although its moves seem weak, it is able to lure the enemy by showing weakness, and thus the weak can defeat the strong.
Desc_681.cn: 诀曰：“风泽中孚客从主，水火即济虚化实”。莲花妙剑虽招招示弱，避重就轻，却能于无形间牵引敌势随我而动，终于虚极生实，以弱胜强。

Desc_682.en: This technique is light, flexible, and amazing to behold. Practicing it forces one to face the divine and moves spirits. Truly "If one scares birds, they will find themselves covered in willows, and if you chase spirits, you won't abandon people. Victory or defeat is but half a movement, yet one's soul can be lost in that instant."
Desc_682.cn: 越女剑法松柔灵活，轻快神奇，出必向神，行必移魂，正是：“身若惊鸿莺穿柳，剑似追魂不离人；输赢只须出半手，纵是越女也失魂”。

Desc_683.en: Emei's Sword Arts are entrancing, able to win a fight with a single strike. This technique is lightning-quick, putting all of its power into one attack that strikes like a thunderbolt and dazzles like a rainbow.
Desc_683.cn: “峨眉剑法妙入神，残虹一式定乾坤”。残虹剑式出剑奇快无比，可谓倾其力于一动，毕其功于一击，势发如雷霆，剑出若残虹。

Desc_684.en: This technique is elegant and pure, yet peculiar. There is a myriad of variants to this technique that have the practitioner's sword floating lightly through the air, the sword and wielder as one.
Desc_684.cn: 玉女神剑高姿俊逸，清奇绝伦，功成自然，机含万变，行剑意飘飘、形怯怯、神淡淡，轻描淡写间剑我已共为一体也。
Desc_684.ru: Эта техника элегантна и чиста, но в то же время своеобразна. Существует множество вариантов этой техники, в которых Меч практикующего легко парит в воздухе, Меч и его владелец - одно целое.

Desc_685.en: Wudang Sect's basic sword technique. Through the unification of mind, will, and sword, the practitioners of Wudang Elixir Sword wield their weapon with a relaxed attitude, which is the only way to practice it.
Desc_685.cn: 武当丹剑乃武当派之内家剑法，讲究心、神、剑三者合一，行剑如龙之行，首尾相应，奇正相生，神韵悠然自得，以神足而道成。

Desc_686.en: Feints mingled with powerful strikes, the Unfettered Sword appears as smooth and nonchalant as its name indicates. It enables its practitioner to adjust their tactics based on their opponent's characteristics.
Desc_686.cn: 武当逍遥剑轻灵圆活，虚实互用，剑随身走，神清意明，剑招因敌变幻，不拘于成法，起似腾空击舞，落如清风扫尘。

Desc_687.en: Controlling no more than the one-chi radius around the practitioner, the Halo Sword Art can pass as a rather simple technique. However, besides being a watertight defensive technique, the practitioner's sword constantly locks with that of their opponent. It also enables its practitioner to take advantage of their opponent's rhythm of movement and launch unexpected attacks.
Desc_687.cn: 白虹剑法朴实无华，出剑尽在身前一尺，敌进我攻，敌退我守，敌剑时时为我所粘接，可谓：“顺人之式，借人之力，以静制动，后发先至”。

Desc_688.en: The invisible Mystic Sword strikes without a trace; yet the birds are startled away in awe, as if heaven has been turned upside down. Using Yin and Yang to guide each of the hands, and the Nine Palaces to lead the steps, the Mystic Taiyi Sword excels both in metaphysically and in battle.
Desc_688.cn: 有道是：“翻天兮惊鸟飞，滚地兮不沾尘，出似无形，去亦无影”。太乙玄门剑手分阴阳，步踏九宫，内合其气，外合其形，堪称神形俱妙也。

Desc_689.en: The methods we know are actually a coherent whole; the hidden meaning just lies in wait. Flexible yet profound, the Will of Yang guides the sword with natural Qi flow, emitting Yang energy capable of melting snow and illuminating the night.
Desc_689.cn: 纯阳剑意柔活舒展，沉着勇壮，讲究“含而不露，隐而自悟，各法贯通，内有玄机”，剑气自然生发，可以消冰释雪，照夜伏邪。

Desc_690.en: One second you see the agile sword wielder; the next, the glimmer of their blade blinds you. The Gliding Loongsoar practitioners can be patient like a snake eying its prey, yet when they strike, it will be no less overwhelming than a Loong suddenly showing itself.
Desc_690.cn: “恍若轻风不见剑，但见剑光不见人”。真武游龙剑行如蛟龙出水，定若灵蛇捕鼠，时而恍若无剑，时而恍若无人，可谓奥妙至极。

Desc_691.en: The mightiest Sword Art to ever come out of a Taoist martial art school, the Taiji Sword Art was created by the sole founder of Wudang Sect. Combining Yin Qi and Yang Qi, it endows its practitioner with an unflappable composure in battle and the capability to dish out incessant attacks.
Desc_691.cn: 太极剑法汇集阴阳两极之气，穷尽天地化生之奇，行剑松沉自然，体静神舒，绵绵不断，重意不重力，乃武当派开派祖师所创之天下内家第一剑。

Desc_692.en: The Lesser Yang is how Yang germinates; the Innate is the Origin of Nature and Man. The Innate Lesser Yang Sword is a technique driven by one's innate Yang Qi, which is the purest and truest.
Desc_692.cn: 所谓“先天少阳”：“少阳者，一阳之始动也；先天者，天人之本元也”。先天少阳剑气乃人身本元之阳气所化，至纯而至真，至阳而至强。
Desc_692.ru: Меньший Ян - это то, как прорастает Ян; Врожденное - это Происхождение Природы и Человека. Врожденный Меч Малого Ян - это техника, основанная на врожденной Ци Ян, которая является самой чистой и правдивой.

Desc_693.en: The ultimate Sword Art, nameless, formless, endless. It's deep to the point that it almost ceases to look like a Sword Art, yet whoever masters it will be capable of launching an attack from virtually nowhere.
Desc_693.cn: 无极剑式无声、无色、无始、无终，无可指名，故曰“无极”。无极之剑似剑而非剑，于无剑处却处处皆是剑，此即一切剑之始，亦为一切剑之终也。

Desc_694.en: This technique is unyielding and rigorous. Its movements are firm and steady, and its moves rarely turn. Attacks are launched from a defensive stance, which makes sense since it is a Buddhist Sword Art.
Desc_694.cn: 罗汉剑法刚直不屈，法度严谨，行剑沉稳有力，招式极少转折，每次出剑必先取守势，乃是以守为攻，四平八稳的佛门剑术。

Desc_695.en: This technique has ten moves that correspond to the ten locations around the practitioner. The practitioner's sword only thrusts out; it does not return. "The sword extends in ten directions, delivering all that live from torment."
Desc_695.cn: 普度剑法共有十式，分别指向周身四面共十个不同的方位，剑势中正平和，只去不回，此乃：“剑发十方，普度众生”之意。

Desc_696.en: This technique is exceedingly fierce with strikes high and low as if one were using just a saber. Every move of the blade howls as the blade swings through the air with a frightening momentum akin to that of lightning.
Desc_696.cn: 七十二嗔剑极其刚猛，不仅行剑直上直下，如使单刀，而且每一式剑招均有一声呵斥怒号与之相和，其声势直如雷嗔电怒，尤其惊人。

Desc_697.en: Great kindness brings merriment to all, while great tragedy brings suffering. The laws of this technique are strict and tenacious. It's actually about self-discipline rather than seemingly a defense against enemies. The might of this technique varies based on the opponent: the stronger their attacks, the mightier it is.
Desc_697.cn: “大慈与一切众生乐，大悲拔一切众生苦”。大慈悲剑法度森严，常无懈倦，看似御敌实为律己，剑力因敌而异，敌势越恶，威力越强。

Desc_698.en: This technique has 5 moves, and each has 500 minor variants and 50 major ones, all of which can be divided and combined into one. It is quite abstruse to the extent that even those gifted with intellect may not be able to comprehend it fully.
Desc_698.cn: 文殊大智慧剑共有五式，每式皆有五百小变化，五十大变化，所有变化既可分使，又可合而为一，极其深奥，纵有超凡智能者亦不能穷其奥妙。

Desc_699.en: This technique is swift and strong. When used, there is a flash of golden light. It is able to strike at those within around a hundred zhang. Its might is formidable and akin to that of Weituo suppressing demons with his Vajra Staff. It is awe-inspiring to behold
Desc_699.cn: 韦驮伏魔剑迅疾刚勇，剑出有金光，可瞬间击出数十丈之远，其威势之坚强，好似韦驮天手持宝杵以镇群魔，凛然不可侵犯，绝无消退移转。

Desc_700.en: This simple technique does not tire the practitioner. It is virtuous and vast like the enlightenment of the Buddha. It is the essence of Buddhist Sword Arts.
Desc_700.cn: 无上菩提剑质朴平和，清澈明净，剑不生疲惓，常化诸妄法，其体广大，其德无边，犹如诸佛无上究竟之正觉，乃佛门剑法之真髓正果也。
Desc_700.ru: Эта простая техника не утомляет практикующего. Она добродетельна и обширна, как просветление Будды. Это суть буддийского Искусства меча.

Desc_701.en: This formidable technique is not only a way of subduing demons, nay it also brings about a subtle change in the practitioner. Truly "as one enters a meditative state, their thoughts dissipate. Likewise when one uses the sword, distractions vanish into thin air."
Desc_701.cn: 达摩剑法正大不阿，既有刚勇强直之伏魔正法，亦不失神妙精微之奇绝变化，正是：“身入禅定无想无念，剑走玄机十方圆明”。

Desc_702.en: The so-called "to and fro" is as follows: "To the enemy goes the swords, like an arrow from a bowstring. Fro returns the sword flying without even a speck of dust." This sword art is ingenious, but also quite elegant. Its moves are unusual, and the sword can shoot out and come back at any time.
Desc_702.cn: 所谓“来去”：“去者，掷剑伤敌，如箭离弦；来者，飞身还剑，剑不沾尘”。来去剑法巧妙轻灵，招式奇异，剑可随时脱手，随时复还。

Desc_703.en: The moves of this authentic Taoist technique are neat and simple without losing what makes it remarkable. If practiced to mastery, it will be as if the practitioner were holding three swords at once. This is referred to as "One Qi, Three Pures."
Desc_703.cn: 三清剑法乃道门正宗剑术，剑招严整质朴而不失闳远微妙，练到最精深处，可于一剑之中化出三剑，谓之“一气三清”也。

Desc_704.en: This unique secret technique of the Ranshan Sect uses Qi to wield a sword to deal with any threat that approaches within a hundred paces. The sword flies and returns on its own. It's almost as if it has wings or were channeling a spirit.
Desc_704.cn: 飞剑术乃然山派之独门秘传，能够以内气御剑于百步之外制敌，其剑自发自收，自去自回，好似剑上生翼，恍如术法通灵。

Desc_705.en: There is a saying: "To observe the opening and closing of the Yin and Yang is to know the key to life and death." This technique is based on abstruse yet profound mathematics-informed techniques. Knowing the four seasons and the six Qi's helps give form to the way things are and knowing heaven, earth, Yin, and Yang helps to better visualize the way things are.
Desc_705.cn: 有道是：“观阴阳之开阖以命物，知存亡之门户”。开阖剑术以极深奥之数术为本要，知四时六气可以鉴影而度形，晓天地阴阳乃至观想之无遗。

Desc_706.en: With subtle changes and guidance, the opponent can be drawn in by this technique's moves, to the point that they will find it difficult to shirk the blade's allure. Truly it is an unstoppable force once this technique has the opponent enthralled.
Desc_706.cn: 蚨母从子剑变化精微，因势利导，敌人不知不觉间已为剑招所牵引，再也难以摆脱，正是：“若蚨母之从子也，出无间，入无朕，独往独来，莫之能止”。

Desc_707.en: There is a profundity to the moves of this most precious of Taoist Sword Arts. It seems both firm and supple, neither lacking, nor overflowing. The wielder will be solemn indeed in their comportment and attitude as if a god is watching them.
Desc_707.cn: 太宝九华剑乃道门至宝法剑，剑招深沉玄奥，外不着相，剑力寓刚于柔，无欠无余，行剑如有神明在侧，一举一动皆庄严肃穆，气度俨然。

Desc_708.en: The sword flies out as it returns. If it is curved, then it will return thusly, if not, then it shall not be so. Going against the Yin and Yang does not require the blade to injure opponents. Even the dullest of blades will do in that case.
Desc_708.cn: 所谓“阴阳逆剑”：“剑发如收，剑去如回，以曲为伸，用晦而明”；行剑逆走阴阳，绝不以剑之锋芒伤人，反而于钝拙处威力奇大。

Desc_709.en: The Taishi is the merging of Yin and Yang, the beginning of form. This technique uses Qi to give form, thus it has form but also doesn't, thus it cannot be bound nor controlled.
Desc_709.cn: “太始者，阴阳合一，形之始也”。太始剑气以气化形，有形而无质，无质所以循之不得，无有生灭，故而不受物缚，无可制御也。
Desc_709.ru: Тайши - это слияние Инь и Ян, начало формы. Эта техника использует Ци для придания формы, таким образом, она имеет форму, но также и не имеет ее, поэтому ее нельзя ни связать, ни контролировать.

Desc_710.en: It is said that "there are no limits on all kinds of changes." This technique is like a boundless illusion. Whatever you see, it will become. If you see flowers, it will become graceful. If you see the sea, it will become like a tempest. This technique can surpass the sword itself whether you are there or not.
Desc_710.cn: 正所谓：“万化而未始有极也”。万化十四剑变幻无穷，可以化入万物，见花则曼妙无方，见海则汹涌无俦，可以超于剑外，无我亦无彼。

Desc_711.en: The name Yuchang, or "bowels of a fish," which indicates where ancient assassins hid their weapons, as well as the convoluted nature of this seemingly simple Sword Art. It's extremely fast, and the attack can be launched anywhere close to the body, which makes it especially dangerous.
Desc_711.cn: 十二路鱼肠刺剑迅疾勇绝，小巧轻快，虽然剑招尽是直刺，但出剑方位曲若鱼肠，变化极快，且可贴身而发，尤其凶险。

Desc_712.en: According to legend, the Gongbu sword was a famous sword belonging to the King of Chu. Fierce and ruthless, this Sword Art, Singular Gongbu, named after a renowned weapon stops at nothing. If performed with an incomparably sharp sword, it would be even more powerful.
Desc_712.cn: 工布独一剑猛恶凌厉，剑力狠辣，出剑锋芒毕露，毫不退缩，视敌人之挡架于无物，若以无比锋利之宝剑施展出来，威力更大。

Desc_713.en: The Unfinished Shengxie is said to be a famous sword that belonged to the King of Wu. Consisting of 81 accumulated moves, this set of techniques' intensity and lethality increase as each new move begins at the previous one's end. Hence the name Shengxie: "Increasingly Vicious."
Desc_713.cn: 胜邪残剑共九九八十一式，行剑之时，每式绝不使尽，故谓之“残”，其式虽残，其力却不断积于下一式中，是以愈残愈强，一式更比一式狠恶。

Desc_714.en: Rumors abound that the Juque Sword was made by Ou Yezi, a famous swordsmith in the Spring and Autumn Period. Up, down, left, right—these are the all four moves of this seemingly clumsy Sword Art that many fear. When performing it, however, even the sword itself may break at the devastating momentum if it is not sturdy enough.
Desc_714.cn: 巨阙千钧剑仅正反竖劈、左右横扫四式，虽然运剑无比笨拙，但力发千钧，无人能挡。然而寻常铁剑绝难承受如此强力，故而此剑法之神威极难尽显。

Desc_715.en: The Ursa Sword is one of the famous ancient swords from the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period. Performed with movements resembling a coiled Loong, the Ursa Sword Art is inspired by constellations and landscapes. If used with a thin sword with a blade that can meander and spin, the effect and might of this Art would be significantly amplified.
Desc_715.cn: 龙渊七星剑法精深奥妙，广博恢弘，上应北斗七星，下应山川河岳，剑出如龙蟠，似蛇走，若以软剑施为，剑刃亦能蜿蜒盘旋，其神妙何止倍增。

Desc_716.en: The Tai'e Sword is one of the renowned swords of the Eastern Zhou Dynasty. Majestic, with tremendous power, the Infinite Tai'e Sword Art can send debris and stones flying in a large radius when performed. As its genuine power bursts forth, even the fiercest foe would be intimidated when enveloped by the immense incoming Qi.
Desc_716.cn: 泰阿无量剑沉雄威武，力量奇大，一经施展，方圆数丈之内飞沙走石，狂风怒号，真威迸发，群凶慑服，无不笼罩在纵横来去的剑气之下。

Desc_717.en: The Flawless Chunjun is the very Qi from the sword, brilliant as the sun and clear as water, gleaming with five hues. It traverses a hundred miles in an instant, severs without a sound, and slices through metal as if through soft mud. The finer the sword, the more pure and potent this Qi becomes.
Desc_717.cn: 纯钧剑气乃剑之精魂所发，其华如阳光，似清水，五色并见，瞬息百里，可断物无声，可削金如泥，越是宝剑，其气越纯。

Desc_718.en: The Zhanlu Sword is the first of the five famous swords of the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period. Taught by the legendary swordsmith Ou Yezi himself, Zhanlu Sword Art is the singular Sword Art exalted among the Swordsmith Villa. It brings out a sword's power to the ultimate finality and wields it for its own joy and wrath.
Desc_718.cn: 湛卢剑法由铸剑祖师欧冶子所传，乃铸剑山庄之镇山至宝。此剑法穷极剑之体用，洞达剑之性灵，行剑则剑喜自鸣，杀敌则剑怒自威。

Desc_719.en: A tree too big is exceptionally spiritual. A rock too huge might attract ghosts. Inspired by the way "Divine Trees" share their life force with the local biome, the movement of the Verdant Sword Art is natural yet bizarre with many twists and turns.
Desc_719.cn: 苗人自古笃信：“树大有神，石大有鬼”。绿髯剑法正是模仿“神树”垂藤挂藓的神奇姿态而创，剑招曲折离奇，宛转灵动。

Desc_720.en: Inspired by agricultural practices of the Miao people, this peculiar yet versatile Sword Art can appear rather counter-intuitive on the battlefield for those from the Central Plains.
Desc_720.cn: 勾镰剑法与中原剑术大异，好似收禾剃草，招招反拖逆撩，古怪无比。苗人习于耕作，擅使勾刃，故以之化为剑术，遂成“勾镰剑法”。
Desc_720.ru: Вдохновленное сельскохозяйственными практиками народа Мяо, это своеобразное, но в то же время универсальное Искусство меча может показаться довольно нелогичным на поле боя для жителей Центральных равнин.

Desc_721.en: Originally performed for the Miao people's sacrificial rites for ghosts, this Sword Art is swift and versatile with many strange moves. When performing it, the practitioner appears to be staggering and lurching, throwing the enemy off guard, only to strike unexpectedly like a starving tiger pouncing at its prey.
Desc_721.cn: 鬼婆婆剑乃苗人“祭鬼”之用。此剑法迅疾多变，诡怪招式极多，出剑看似肩歪步斜，蹒跚欲败，实则剑力异常凶狠，直如饿虎见羊。

Desc_722.en: Spring chases all evil spirits away, big and small alike, as the sacred wood thrives in its newly found splendor. Tight and neat, exquisite and natural, the Sacred Wood Sword infuses its practitioner with vibrant power.
Desc_722.cn: 神木辟邪剑从容严整，精奇自然，剑力阳和质朴，生气勃勃，歌诀有云：“诸邪辟易欲迎春，神木扫晦正出芽，大鬼也逃，小鬼也逃”。

Desc_723.en: Kill them, but don't bother to face them. A set of techniques consisting entirely of sneak attacks. Like apparitions, those who use the Soul-snatching Sword never bother to show themselves while delivering lethal strikes, sewing dread in their opponent's heart.
Desc_723.cn: “行剑如鬼魅，如影紧相随，杀人不着面，夺魂不见人”。鬼面追魂剑有如阴魂之索命，行剑必隐于人后，绝不与人照面，无比诡异骇人。

Desc_724.en: Ancient and mysterious, this Sword Art with a peculiar name enables its practitioner to send forth varicolored Qi bursts through their weapon, eliminating evil spirits and mutilating any opponent.
Desc_724.cn: 神尺斩妖剑古怪玄奇，能以运剑之时所发的无形剑气伤敌，剑气之中且生有陆离光彩，幻化而无定，似有斩妖除魔之神力也。
Desc_724.ru: Древнее и таинственное, это Искусство меча со своеобразным названием позволяет практикующему посылать разноцветные разряды Ци через свое Оружие, уничтожая злых Духов и калеча любого противника.

Desc_725.en: Nimble, treacherous, and baneful, the Cyan Spider is worshiped as the one supreme for the Five Immortals Sect. Imitating its movement, the Cyan Spider Sword Art's practitioner brandishes incessant attacks, while patiently gathering momentum and preparing for changes in stillness.
Desc_725.cn: 青蛛之为物，轻盈诡变，绝毒超世，乃五仙教之“至圣”。青蛛剑法极尽青蛛之姿态，动则千丝万缕，密如细雨，静则形断意连，伏藏万变。

Desc_726.en: The sword is quick to draw and sheathe. The practitioner never stops their movements, neither with the sword, nor with their feet. In the blink of an eye, the practitioner can pierce 17 vital acupoints.
Desc_726.cn: 界青快剑收发迅疾，灵敏快密，足不停步，即走即刺，能于眨眼之间同时刺击敌人周身一十七处要害，快似凫趋雀跃，星流电击。

Desc_727.en: Those of the Veil Scar excel at this technique whose moves seem to be nothing out of the ordinary. Despite this, those of the Martial World dread this technique for it takes both practitioner and opponent down together.
Desc_727.cn: 界青门人擅使绝义剑，此剑法虽然招式平平无奇，但出则共伤，发则同戮，施展开来，尽是同生共死的搏命招术，尤为江湖人士所畏惧。

Desc_728.en: The three stars to the south of Tianhuang are called the Xianchi, and fish are trapped therein. If the Xianchi trembles, then the world below will descend into chaos. This technique relies on the Qi of misfortune, especially particularly violent ones. The Qi of victims of this technique is sealed, and their True Qi flows backward, leading to death.
Desc_728.cn: “天潢南三星曰咸池，鱼囿也，动则道不通，天下败乱”。咸池剑气乃灾厄之气，尤其凶煞险恶，中者内气闭塞，真气逆乱，精神破败而死。

Desc_729.en: The moves of this technique are hidden. It is said that "even the blade cannot be seen when it's drawn, nor is any blood when the it is sheathed." When drawn, the sword leaves no trace. It is as quick as the wind or lightning and formidable enough to leave opponents with a great deal more space atop their shoulders.
Desc_729.cn: 界青暗手快剑招式隐秘，讲究：“发不见刃，收不见血”，出剑无影无踪，快如疾风之超尘，电火之行空，能断人颈项而首级绝不跌落。

Desc_730.en: This technique is fierce indeed for it does not even consist of a defense. As such, the practitioner only advances, seeking the opponent's death. Only when the opponent has perished will the sword be sheathed.
Desc_730.cn: 杀剑凌厉狠恶，只攻不守，乃是有进无退，有死无生之绝命剑法。杀剑一起，运剑者必置生死于度外，敌死方收，至死方休。

Desc_731.en: Netherworld Sword Art conceals danger under the surface of harmlessness. It is imperceptible, indescribable some say, and attacks opponents in a split second. There is a saying: "To see it is to see formlessness itself. To hear it is to hear naught but silence. Those of the nether both is and is not a metaphor for the Tao."
Desc_731.cn: 幽冥剑法阴柔害物，幽藏晦暗，似出未出，未出已至，无可察觉，不可名状，有道是：“视之无形，听之无声，幽冥者，所以喻道而非道也”。

Desc_732.en: This secret technique can cut off "joy, anger, sorrow, thoughts, sadness, fear, and surprise" to the extent that the practitioner themselves becomes a walking puppet without a thought of their own in their head. This technique can make the practitioner flawless, indeed no obstacle stands before them for long.
Desc_732.cn: 所谓“无瑕七绝剑”，乃是一门断绝“喜、怒、忧、思、悲、恐、惊”以至行如傀偶，无思无想，从而臻至行剑无碍，剑力无瑕之用剑化境的秘传剑法。

Desc_733.en: This technique is enshrouded in extreme Yin Qi and cold. The practitioner's sword leaves frost and ice in the wielder's wake. Opponents that face a practitioner of this technique will be left as shards of ice in the practitioner's wake.
Desc_733.cn: 玄冥剑气至阴至寒，凛冽惨切，剑气笼罩之处，呵气成霜，滴水成冰，似冰锥之刮骨，如厉风之穿心，当者立刻化为片片碎冰。

Desc_734.en: This technique has a total of 64 moves. The steps of the practitioner follow the Eight Trigram Palace Array. The blade hides the changes of the five elements within it. As the practitioner steps, the blade turns and the inverse, ad infinitum.
Desc_734.cn: 八卦五行刀共有六十四式，行刀之际，脚踩八卦宫阵，刀藏五行变化，步随刀转，刀随步变，连绵不断，滔滔不竭。

Desc_735.en: This technique changes along with the six directions of the Twelve Earthly Branches. Its defense is solid, and its attack formidable. As is commonly known: "Defense is like earth, it is a formidable force to take on. Its attack, like a tempest, can bring disaster in an instant."
Desc_735.cn: 六合刀法乃是应地支六合之变化而创，守也坚固，攻也刚强，有如诀曰：“守似午未合化土，柔里带刚强且韧；攻如辰酉合化金，风雷骤起祸横生”。

Desc_736.en: It is said that "there are eight Yin outside of the Jiuzhou, eight laces outside of the eight Yin, and eight poles outside of them." This technique sweeps open and close in an X-shape and can reach opponents in any direction.
Desc_736.cn: 正所谓：“九州之外有八寅，八寅之外有八纮，八纮之外有八极”。虎步八极刀大开大阖，劲走十字，沉堕刚猛，刀势可达四面八极。

Desc_737.en: This technique brings together the Five Elements as well as Yin and Yang. The practitioner of this technique must have formidable prowess with a blade to be able to manipulate it as intended.
Desc_737.cn: 太乙金刀混沉自然，一气呵成，意合阴阳五行，身走奇门遁甲，刀力既强，变化亦精，人谓之道门刀法之“金华”也。
Desc_737.ru: Эта техника объединяет пять элементов, а также Инь и Ян. Практикующий эту технику должен обладать огромным мастерством обращения с Клинком, чтобы иметь возможность манипулировать им по назначению.

Desc_738.en: This technique has 196 moves related to the changes in the seven stars of the Big Dipper and the four seasons. This technique is solid, and the rules that govern it are strict. As the practitioner employs this technique and honors its principles, their blade flies through the air as quickly as a falling star.
Desc_738.cn: 七星刀法共有一百九十六式，与北斗七星在四时当中的诸般变化一一对应，此刀法深沉刚勇，法度严谨，行刀迅若流星，应变奇速。

Desc_739.en: The moves of this Blade Art possess an uncommon force, and the blade of the practitioner possesses an uncommon form as well. It is a subtle and mysterious art that has a certain wisdom to it. There is even a pertinent saying: "Laws have no limits, nor do uses have bounds."
Desc_739.cn: 无极刀法式无常势，刀无常形，心无常念，神无常主，精微玄奥，慧勇无边，有道是：“法无尽，用无穷，无限，无终，以为无极”。

Desc_740.en: For the strong, the four uprights are strength. Obtaining uprightness in each manner is like living in the heaven of heavens. This technique is frighteningly powerful, which is what one would expect of the pinnacle of attainment in the Taoist Blade Arts.
Desc_740.cn: “罡者四正为罡，取四方之正中，居於天中之天，乃阳精真土也”。天罡刀法赫赫有威，神通广大，乃道门法刀之绝诣，玄门大道之不二正法也。

Desc_741.en: Without, Yin and Yang appear similar, as can good and evil. Within is a different story though. While it is mysterious, it is wonderful indeed, although difficult to comprehend. "When the gods war on the darkest of days, the masses help one another as the divine display the depths of their profound wonderment." This art is abstruse, but amazing nonetheless.
Desc_741.cn: 太玄神刀于外阴阳同陈，善恶并见，于内信接神明，化而入玄，正是：“神战于玄天人共济，冥交有孚入化出神”，其法玄之又玄，妙不可言。

Desc_742.en: A unique Blade Art of the Lion-Face Clan, the Tumbling Blade focuses on maiming the opponent's lower body with a peculiar movement centering on tumbles, falls, turns, and ground-bound acrobatics.
Desc_742.cn: 狮相地趟刀乃是狮相门之独门刀法，讲究：“行必翻滚，走必扑跌，缠裹圈抹，刀身相连”，尽是劈扎敌人下盘双腿之招式。
Desc_742.ru: Уникальное Искусство клинка клана Львинолицых, кувыркающийся Клинок фокусируется на нанесении увечий нижней части тела противника с помощью своеобразных движений, основанных на кувырках, падениях, поворотах и акробатике на земле.

Desc_743.en: Handed down from generation to generation of the people of Lotus Hill since time immemorial, the Groundbreaking Blade enables its practitioner to deliver precise strikes using simple techniques.
Desc_743.cn: 开山快刀自古即为莲花山山民代代相传，虽然招式简易粗陋，然而行刀精练质朴，毫无多余架势，施展起来却也举步生风，勇武不凡。
Desc_743.ru: Передаваемый из поколения в поколение жителями Лотос-Хилла с незапамятных времен, новаторский Клинок позволяет его владельцу наносить точные удары, используя простые приемы.

Desc_744.en: Characterized by wide chopping strikes, the Lion's Chop features explosive whipping motions generated by the centrifugal force of the rotating arms. It is said to be able to intercept any incoming attack.
Desc_744.cn: “高来则挂，低来则劈”，谓之“劈挂”也。狮相劈挂刀大开大合，大劈大砍，长短并用，放长击远，凶猛无比，剽悍无前。

Desc_745.en: Each of the attacks delivered using the Strenuous Strike technique is launched with literally no effort spared. Even if the strike only brushes the opponent they would inevitably suffer from split flesh and torn tendons.
Desc_745.cn: 九牛二虎刀刚强鲁勇，力大无穷，每一刀斩出皆有九牛二虎之巨力，即便只受到刀力的些许震荡，亦难免皮开肉绽，筋断骨折。

Desc_746.en: It is said Nüwa, the Mother Goddess and one of the Emperor-gods, has cut off the legs of the great turtle Ao to erect them as the four pillars of the world when heaven and earth were in disruption. Just like the name implies, this Blade Art cripples the opponent's lower body the way Nüwa amputated the enormous Ao with one slash.
Desc_746.cn: 斩鳌刀法姿态低伏，专斩腿脚。传说“女娲断鳌足以立四极”，此刀法名曰“斩鳌”，意为一刀便可将擎持玄黄四极之支柱斩断，力量之大，非比寻常。

Desc_747.en: Consisting of two stances and ten special methods, the Tyrant Blade reigns on the battlefield with unrelenting might, as if capable of holding out against thousands of enemy warriors.
Desc_747.cn: 霸王刀雄强霸道，神勇无二，共有一刀两式与十种用劲法诀，此刀一出，势如破釜沉舟，绝无退缩，好似倚天拔地，有万夫不当之威。
Desc_747.ru: Состоящий из двух стоек и десяти специальных приемов, Клинок Тирана правит на поле боя с неумолимой мощью, как будто способен противостоять тысячам вражеских воинов.

Desc_748.en: Suan Ni, or the Golden Ni, is one of the nine sons of the Loong, and the Aureate Lion that purges evil spirits. The moves of Suan Ni Blade are launched with a lionlike roar, intimidating beasts and humans alike.
Desc_748.cn: “金猊者，乃镇魔辟邪之神兽金狮子也”。金猊镇魔刀刚强无比，威力无穷，出刀且作狮子吼，百兽无不惊怖，群雄无不慑服。

Desc_749.en: Step through the Eight Gates as you sweep across the battlefield like a Loong; be ferocious like a ghost, and swift like thunder. The most swift Blade Art under the sun, the Coiled Loong Blade consists of eight moves inspired by the Eight Gates of Fate from the legendary divination method Qimen Dunjia.
Desc_749.cn: 鬼八式蟠龙刀乃天下第一之迅猛刀法，共有“开、休、生、伤、杜、景、死、惊”八式，讲究：“步闯八门，刀走蟠龙，恶厉如鬼，怒疾如雷”。

Desc_750.en: The power of the Berserk Blade grows as the battle progresses, leading the practitioner into a state of bloodlust resembling that of a deranged beast. Anything or anyone in their way would be torn apart by their unstoppable momentum.
Desc_750.cn: 狂刀刚猛无伦，勇绝无双，越战越强，愈强愈狂，形若怒猊之丧心，状似暴虎之病狂，乃凶中之至凶，狂中之至狂，八荒六合，无人能挡。

Desc_751.en: Follow your enemy at every step until you can dominate their movements with their own. Named after one of the titles of Zhang Fei, the legendary fighter of the Three Kingdoms period, Zhang Fei's Xinting Blade Art is fierce and heroic. A close pursuit of the enemy is required to perform this set of mighty techniques.
Desc_751.cn: 诀曰：“敌步则我趋之，敌趋则我驰之”。新亭侯刀法刚正强直，气度豪迈，精悍勇进，咄咄逼人，时时刻刻紧随敌身而动。

Desc_752.en: Unrushed by a winding movement, Ruan's Blade Art endows every part of a blade with lethality: blade point, spine, edge, handle, and pommel. Among its versatile moves, the mightiest ones are the seven strikes delivered using the pommel.
Desc_752.cn: 阮师刀法舒展大方，曲折回环，进若耕犁，退似旋车，能以刀尖、刀背、刀刃、刀柄、刀首分别施展诸般厉害杀招，其中尤以刀首七式最为精强。

Desc_753.en: The Loongtail Blade's moves are tailored with an unflinching resolution, the blade soaring through the air like the wind sweeps across the grassland. With a distant origin and a long development, its grandeur can only be demonstrated through appropriate ancient weapons.
Desc_753.cn: 大夏龙雀百战刀勇猛果决，法度严整，刀势腾空掠地，如风靡草，刀法千锤百炼，渊源深远，非古之利器不足以彰显其威仪。

Desc_754.en: When cutting jade, a Kunwu Blade is preferred. Although not actually used in jade-carving, the Kunwu Blade Art is equally subtle and exquisite like a sculptor, except that it won't stop at something beautiful.
Desc_754.cn: 古人云：“割玉须用昆吾刀”。昆吾刀法虽非割玉之技，但招式灵动微妙，变化多端，行刀好似雕琢玉器，精巧细腻，亦如昆吾之割玉，当者寸断寸离。

Desc_755.en: When Ding the Dissector butchers the ox, his blade does it with ease. He deals with it in a spiritual manner and does not use his eyes. Senses are discarded, and his spirit acts as it wills. With moves extremely succinct, Dissector's Blade Art enables its practitioner to dismember their opponent like an expert cook prepares food.
Desc_755.cn: 鬼庖丁刀法架势奇小，刀势奇险，动刀甚微，敌身已解，有道是：“庖丁解牛，游刃有余，以神遇而不以目视，官知止而神欲行”。

Desc_756.en: The seven styles of the Chi Blade are all inspired by incredible feats in ancient mythology, namely: heaving a mountain, cutting off a river, stepping on the nimbus, manipulating light, stifling the burning flames, shaking the earth, and altering one's own form.
Desc_756.cn: 所谓赤刀之“七绝”：“一曰担山，二曰断水，三曰履霜蹑云，四曰驱光移景，五曰回风返火，六曰阴迫阳伏以撼地，七曰反归正藏以易形”。

Desc_757.en: It's so fast that the practitioner blurs together with their blade. The Blurring Blade Style is like a spinning top sweeping across the battlefield. Only after the enemy's defeat by a thousand cuts will they finally discern the sound and light of the blade.
Desc_757.cn: 残刀式迅疾绝伦，人刀一体，行刀转如陀螺，旋如飓风，敌人已为千刀万剐之后，方闻其声响，方见其刀光，乃世所罕见之快刀绝技。

Desc_758.en: A Blade Art so powerful that it defies the control of human hands. Whoever performs it will fall under the control of the blade itself: going along with its flow will render the wielder invincible, while going against it will incur their own demise.
Desc_758.cn: 鸣鸿绝刀威力奇大，非人力可以驾驭，一旦施展，运刀者便即陷入刀法之掌控，顺刀意则无敌于天下，逆刀意则立受反噬而亡。

Desc_759.en: This Blade Art is steady and powerful. Its moves tend to slice through the air without altering their trajectory. "Use strength to attack strength and overcome the unyielding by being unyielding." The blade in this art is like the indestructible Vajra.
Desc_759.cn: 金刚刀法稳健沉猛，刚劲有力，刀招转折极少，讲究：“以强攻强，以刚克刚”，好似手中钢刀正是无可摧毁之护法金刚。

Desc_760.en: This Blade Art mimics the postures of demons and Rakshasas, making it odd yet fierce. When the practitioner attacks, they appear vicious and evil as if they were enraged to the point of devouring human flesh. By contrast, when the practitioner withdraws, it is weirdly beautiful, and even charming.
Desc_760.cn: 罗刹刀法乃是模仿恶鬼罗刹之姿态而创，古怪狰狞，捷疾可怖。其进则猛恶，作忿怒状，似欲食人血肉；其退则姝美，作嬉笑状，尤其妖异邪诡。

Desc_761.en: Demonic hindrances are obstacles to one's cultivation, but they are also a teacher and friend to the way of truth. What fruit is attained without some suffering along the way? One's mind must be sharp to use this technique, or else the blade will not be able to attain the full power that this Blade Art can imbue it with.
Desc_761.cn: 魔障既是修行之阻碍，亦是真道之师友，无魔无磨不能成正果。魔障刀法首重心修，心神愈受磨砺，刀力愈显刚强，心魔照退，刀法即成。

Desc_762.en: Turning Qi into internal fire is "Spirit Heat," and this is used to imbue one's blade with this Blade Art. The practitioner's blade is stronger than steel, sharper than a needle, and as fierce as a raging inferno.
Desc_762.cn: 以内气化作内火乃生“灵热”，以灵热附于刀刃之上，遂成灵热刀。灵热刀坚逾钢铁，锐比针锥，猛如烈火，可隔空而发。

Desc_763.en: It is said that "the Vajra has a fierce visage, which is used to subdue the four demons." This Blade Art uses the mystical power of the enraged Vajra's visage and combines it with incredible strength and sturdiness, making it especially formidable.
Desc_763.cn: 正所谓：“金刚怒目，所以降伏四魔”。金刚降伏刀具怒目金刚之神力，无比坚固刚强，有摧伏外道之神威，尤其威猛可畏。

Desc_764.en: Vajra Prajna is the wisdom of the Vajra, and it is genuine power indeed. This technique embodies the essence of the Vajra Sect's Blade Arts, thus it is incredibly powerful. No matter what obstacle arises, the practitioner's blade will not falter.
Desc_764.cn: “金刚般若”即金刚之真智、真力也。金刚般若刀乃金刚宗刀法之精义，力量极强，威力极大，无论受到何等阻碍，其刀力绝无退减，其刀势绝无转移。

Desc_765.en: Although this technique only has seven moves, the movements of the practitioner's sword are like "the Buddha explaining the principles of Buddhism, there are no obstacles, and it rus without issue or end." No matter who faces the practitioner, they will fall.
Desc_765.cn: 如意宝轮刀虽只有七式，但行刀“如佛说法，圆通无碍，运转不息”，却似有无穷无尽的刀招与功力，宝轮转动之处，一切魔异无不为其所摧破。

Desc_766.en: Using secret methods upon a blade, whilst chanting the six-word mantra "Om ma ni pad me hom," generates unimaginable power and allows the practitioner to use remarkable abilities.
Desc_766.cn: 以密法运使金刚利刃，口颂“唵、嘛、呢、叭、咪、吽”六字真言，可生无尽大力，无边加持，出刀且示现六神通，此即六神威刀。
Desc_766.ru: Использование секретных методов на Клинке во время повторения мантры из шести слов "Ом ма ни пад ме хом" генерирует невообразимую силу и позволяет практикующему использовать замечательные способности.

Desc_767.en: This is one of the most revered of the Vajra Sect's Blade Arts. It is said that there are four supreme skills: "first, commanding the countless ghosts and family members; second, blessings from the seven goddesses; third, suppressing the ghosts and evil spirits lurking in the tombs; and, fourth, bringing the vitality of life."
Desc_767.cn: 摩诃迦罗刀乃金刚宗一切护法神功之至尊，传有四无上法：“一曰无量鬼神眷属，二曰七母天女赐福，三曰冢间镇鬼伏邪，四曰气命丰足无缺”。

Desc_768.en: This Blade Art is truly mighty. It combines action with inaction, as it abides by the laws of the nine stars. Inaction resides in the Zhonggong Star to defend and action is cast out of the Pojun Star to attack.
Desc_768.cn: 伏龙刀法刚强有力，动静合一，暗藏奇门遁甲之变化，依循九星运临之规律，静则居中宫而制四方，动则出破军以伐群小。

Desc_769.en: The movements of practitioners of this technique look like they have had quite a bit to drink, but this is all a farce. It is merely to look like the practitioner has partakeng in drink. The advantage to this approach is that the practitioner can attack when it looks like they are defending, and they can attack then withdraw. In short, they can take advantage of the opponent's confusion.
Desc_769.cn: 九宫醉刀首重宫阵之走转，行刀看似半醉半醒，半倾半斜，实则形醉意不醉，步醉心不醉，虚守实发，逢击而避，乘隙而入，指东打西。

Desc_770.en: Although the attacks of practitioners of this technique are quite straightforward, their might is astonishing. There are four cuts to this technique: "first, that of beheading the bull; second, smashing the forehead of the fierce tiger; third, slicing the spine of the long whale; and, fourth, chopping the tail of Jiao, the flood Loong."
Desc_770.cn: 龙牙四斩虽尽是猛砍猛斫之刚直刀招，但威力惊人，不容小觑。其斩有四：“一斩牯牛断头，二斩猛虎碎额，三斩长鲸裂脊，四斩蛟龙折尾”。

Desc_771.en: The stops and movements of this technique are too unpredictable to leave a trace, as if drunk or befuddled, wanting to advance yet retreating; desiring to go right, then going left. Using common sense to understand the manifold nuances of the practitioner's blade is naught but folly.
Desc_771.cn: 六心四意刀行停无迹，似醉似迷，欲进又退，欲东还西，刀招之中转折变化极多，无法以常理推断，有鬼没神出之奇。

Desc_772.en: This Exotic Art is fierce to the extreme. It is called a "twisted serpent," "restlessness that brings only disaster," "Fleeing Loong," and "evil unleashed."
Desc_772.cn: 狂龙八十一斩尽走奇门凶格，刚猛狠厉至极。其起称“蛇夭矫”，谓“虚惊不宁，百事不利”；其落称“龙逃走”，谓“六畜皆伤，百事为凶”。
Desc_772.ru: Это экзотическое искусство жестоко до крайности. Его называют "извивающейся змеей", "беспокойством, приносящим только бедствия", "Бегущим Луной" и "выпущенным на волю злом".

Desc_773.en: Every move of this technique has Yin and Yang variations: the Yang side employs the back of the blade, like a Loong soaring through the sky. The Yin side utilizes the blade itself like a ghost; it pierces the darkness and then hides.
Desc_773.cn: 大两仪醉刀形颠法密，意乱神清，每式刀招皆有正反阴阳两用：阳者以刀背施为，如龙显形，长啸腾飞；阴者以刀刃施为，如鬼通灵，暗伏消隐。

Desc_774.en: Drunken repose at the East Sea, a rainbow falls; waking in Penglai, the Immortal Palace is all astir; 10,000 liang of gold cast a newborn babe; a loyal heart slays the White Loong. This technique is like flames in an inferno, crimson gold found in stone, purity without flaw, strength at its pinnacle.
Desc_774.cn: “醉卧东海披落虹，醒入蓬莱闹仙宫，万两浑金铸赤子，一寸丹心斩白龙”。赤子斩龙刀乃焰中真火，石中赤金，纯粹无瑕，精强已极。

Desc_775.en: This technique is unmatched in terms of might. Indeed, its movements are even described as domineering or haughty. The practitioner has nothing to fear, for it slaughters all before them
Desc_775.cn: 九龙霸刀威猛无双，所向披靡，行刀飞扬跋扈，无所顾忌，有形剁形，无形剁影，刀刀俱是真力，可谓威风而拔世，悍勇而超尘。
Desc_775.ru: Эта техника не имеет себе равных по мощи. Действительно, его движения даже описываются как властные или надменные. Практикующему нечего бояться, ибо он убивает всех на своем пути

Desc_776.en: With a moderate complexity, the Shaolin Harmonies Staff is succinct with forthright moves. Guided by the Six Harmonies, this Staff Art excels at delivering direct and fast attacks.
Desc_776.cn: 少林六合棍招式明快，不简不繁，尚直取快攻而忌游移不定，出棍讲究“内三合”与“外三合”、内外相合、六合相合，故名“六合棍”。
Desc_776.ru: Посох гармоний Шаолинь средней сложности отличается лаконичностью и прямолинейностью движений. Руководствуясь Шестью гармониями, это искусство Посоха превосходно справляется с прямыми и быстрыми Атаками.

Desc_777.en: Consisting of two sets of moves suitable for different situations, the Shaolin Yin Yang Staff enables its practitioner to act in concert with the circumstances or unleash everything upon the opponent.
Desc_777.cn: 所谓“阴阳棍”，乃是由于此棍法分为内与外、上与下、骑与步两组招式，两组招式既可分使，亦可高低并用，上下齐施。
Desc_777.ru: Состоящий из двух наборов приемов, подходящих для различных ситуаций, Посох Шаолинь Инь Ян позволяет практикующему действовать сообразно обстоятельствам или обрушить все на противника.

Desc_778.en: The rapid attack of the staff can defeat a group of enemies. Capable of fending off 18 opponents with a single move and dealing 18 rapid blows to a single enemy, it is an excellent skill set when faced with legions of enemies.
Desc_778.cn: 十八点齐眉棍讲究：“乱棍猛击，棍打群敌”，既可于一招之间分袭一十八个敌人，也能同时将一十八次棍击施于同一敌人之身。

Desc_779.en: Filled with jabbing moves, the Yaksha Staff is actually more like a set of spear unique arts that excels at versatility. It enables its practitioner to deal with opponents at both long and short range.
Desc_779.cn: 大小夜叉棍既可放长击远，亦可近身入怀，且多有逆挑、疾点、猛戳等凌厉绝技，正是“三分棍法七分枪法”，长短兼用，亦棍亦枪。

Desc_780.en: With rigid and grand methods, the Pouncing Tiger Staff enables its practitioner to become one with their staff. The staff wielder will be rendered invincible with the capability to deliver strikes under any state, just like a tiger sauntering through a flock of sheep.
Desc_780.cn: 五虎群羊棍法度严密，气势宏大，运棍之时全身着力，上下左右一体，俯仰进退皆可攻敌，兼之棍力刚猛，临敌直如虎入羊群，威不可当。

Desc_781.en: Making its practitioner capable of launching attacks from almost any position, this Staff Art is only given a derogatory name out of humility in front of Buddha. With astonishing strength and precision, there's no way the practitioners of this set of techniques can be seen as anything other than in a frenzy.
Desc_781.cn: 少林疯魔棍横扫东南西北，恶劈四面八方，凶猛巧健，捅天打地，为避其不尊天地方位之忌，故而取名“疯魔”，是以并无半点“疯颠”之态。

Desc_782.en: Composed and majestic, the Skanda Staff envelopes the opponent with the Tiangang Qi. Its attacks can uphold justice by eliminating evil, and its watertight defense can help withstand any incoming attack.
Desc_782.cn: 韦陀降魔杖刚勇强劲，沉雄无比，杖力笼罩之下，处处皆是无形罡气，攻可摧邪辅正，除魔卫道，守亦坚固不破，固若金汤。

Desc_783.en: For the fighting monks of Shaolin, the true objective of practicing martial arts is to hone their minds of Chan. Both fighting techniques and meditation methods make the Bodhi Wisdom Staff the truly perfect combination of martial arts and Buddhist thoughts.
Desc_783.cn: “以武入禅”乃少林武学之正果真义。大智菩提杖法于武超凡脱俗，神妙无已，于禅使人明心见性，顿悟真理，堪称“禅武合一”之无上正等正觉也。

Desc_784.en: The staff is said to be the progenitor of all weapons, just like the Bodhidharma Staff is the origin of all Staff Arts. Taught by Master Bodhidharma himself, this set of techniques consisting of 48 styles is beyond all contemporary martial artists' imagination.
Desc_784.cn: 有道是：“棍乃百兵之祖”，达摩杖法更是一切棍术杖法之先师鼻祖。达摩杖法共有四十八式，乃达摩祖师之真传绝艺，其法精奇古朴，神乎其神。

Desc_785.en: With brutish moves and ferocious momentum, the Fiend Spear Art grants its practitioner the resolution and savagery to pursue any opponent to the brutal end.
Desc_785.cn: 恶煞枪法招式粗犷，出枪凶横异常，力必用尽，势必到底，于人于己皆不留半分余地，一如其名，好似凶神恶煞一般。
Desc_785.ru: Благодаря грубым движениям и свирепому импульсу искусство владения дьявольским копьем наделяет своего практикующего решимостью и дикостью преследовать любого противника до жестокого конца.

Desc_786.en: One cun longer, one cun stronger. Although lacking in versatility, the Soul-rending Spear excels at exploiting a spear's length. It enables the wielder to attack the enemy's critical point with long, straightforward strikes at a rather long range.
Desc_786.cn: 正所谓：“一寸长，一寸强，棍打一片，枪扎一点”。五虎断魂枪无甚变化，却尤其擅长以长攻短，以长驱直入之势直取敌身之要害。

Desc_787.en: Demonstrating the essentials of Lion-Face Clan Spear Art, the Spears of Origin consists of 8 moves that beget every other move that can be performed using the spear, hence the name.
Desc_787.cn: 狮相八母枪乃狮相门代代相传之枪法要义，共有“封、闭、提、掳、拿、拦、还、缠”八式，此八式即一切枪术之根本所在，所以谓之“母枪”也。
Desc_787.ru: Демонстрируя основы искусства владения копьем клана Львинолицых, the Spears of Origin состоит из 8 приемов, которые порождают все остальные приемы, которые можно выполнить с помощью копья, отсюда и название.

Desc_788.en: Named after the legendary spear wielder from the Three Kingdoms period, this Spear Art's might comes from its steadfast stance with strict principles and unwavering movements deflecting any effort to stop it. "The curve drawn by the spear is like a flying Loong, and the defensive momentum is as unshakable as a mountain."
Desc_788.cn: 桓侯十六枪沉稳刚毅，法度极严，停必“手、足、枪，三尖相照”，行必“圈、抖、摇，枪圆如龙”，正是：“枪圆如龙威力无穷，三尖相照山岳难摇”。

Desc_789.en: Consisting of 64 moves inspired by the hexagrams, this Exotic Spear Art combines the mutability of divination of its styles with classic stalwartness of the Lion-Face Clan, coupling strength and gentleness.
Desc_789.cn: 乾坤枪法共有六十四式，乃是从先天六十四卦中所化出的奇门枪法，其变化固然奇妙，却也不失狮相门之刚猛作风，可谓虽柔亦刚，刚柔并有。

Desc_790.en: With simple moves and steady motion, the practitioner of the Roaring Spear technique is capable of delivering mountain-shaking strikes. Its name comes from the wind raised when performing this technique, which sounds like hundreds of beasts roaring in unison.
Desc_790.cn: 百兽震岳枪招式虽然鲁直，出枪虽然滞缓，但枪力浑厚，雄强无比，隆隆然似有百兽咆哮其中，山川河岳无不为其所震撼。

Desc_791.en: The practitioner is as mighty as a lion, and their spear is as furious as a Loong. The practitioner can wield the spear as a part of their own body and descend upon the opponent like a single creature, or treat it like an independent being driven by its own killing intent.
Desc_791.cn: 观其人似雄狮，观其枪似狂龙，人有慑服群鬼之威，枪有翻天覆地之力。狂龙狮子枪既可人枪合一，亦可分而为二，合之威力无穷，分之狂猛无比。

Desc_792.en: Created by Xiang Yu, the Hegemon-King of Western Chu, the Overlord's Spear is a technique only performable by those who have boundless strength. Once mastered, this ferocious technique would make its practitioner a true one-person army.
Desc_792.cn: 陀龙霸王枪乃楚霸王项羽所创，非神力无双之人不能驾驭。霸王枪壮勇绝伦，刚猛拔世，出之有鬼神之力，千军难当，万夫莫敌。

Desc_793.en: "Blood soaks our land, divine spirits guard our realm. The Aureate Lion enters the fray and reigns as king; its merits are unmatched and its eight spears perish the demons." It is said this spear art was developed over a thousand years through the combined wisdom of sixty-four valiant generals, perfected by the Great General of Divine Might. It bears the strength of a legion, commanding the vast momentum of Heaven and Earth, and standing radiant against all ancient evils. Though it consists of only eight strikes, its valor is unstoppable.
Desc_793.cn: “血洒吾土，神镇吾疆；金狮入阵，沙场称王；功盖千古，败魔八枪”。相传此枪法乃六十四位忠勇大将历经千余载辗转流传创制，至神通大将初成。此枪法有千军万马之威，恢恢然能举天地之浩荡，昭昭然可御万古之凶狂，虽只八枪，烈勇无挡。

Desc_794.en: "If my opponent won't move, then I won't, either; yet once they show signs of movement, I shall move before them." Steady and succinct, the Loongsmite Staff Art enables its practitioner to fend off their opponent with a unique crouching movement.
Desc_794.cn: 降龙棍法严谨稳重，动静分明，讲究：“敌不动，我不动，敌欲动，我先动”，运棍方圆并用，曲蟠低沉，望之好似蟠龙伏卧在地。

Desc_795.en: With 14 moves that each indicating a major star in the night sky, the Cloudclearer Staff Art is agile with many sweeping attacks, leaving a glowing afterimage. If performed using the actual Cloudclearer, the afterimage will become even more vivid to the point that it's dazzling.
Desc_795.cn: 扫霞棍法共有十四式，分别对应星相斗数之十四主星，棍招轻灵舒展，首重扫劈，棍影之中且隐隐泛出霞光，若以扫霞棍施为，其霞光更盛。

Desc_796.en: Performed with extremely bold movements, the Infinite Staff begins and ends each of its moves with the staff's one end pointing at the sky and the other at the ground, asserting its reign in all directions.
Desc_796.cn: 十方山河杖气势雄迈，开阖极大，招式之起毕无不以杖首指天，杖尾指地，意为：顶天立地，十方尽在我杖间，十方尽归我所有。

Desc_797.en: Sneaky and tough in equal measure, the Ghast Staff Art is fraught with both dexterous feints and powerful strikes. Its versatility enables the staff wielder to change the vigorous force's direction even after landing a hit, catching the opponent unprepared.
Desc_797.cn: 鬼头棒法诡秘、刚猛并重，虚引、实击共存，每式皆可由退改进，由进转退，即便击中敌身，亦可将劲力在虚实之间瞬间调转，令人难以预料。

Desc_798.en: Heavy yet swift, bold yet clever, this Staff Art features numerous feints, taking advantage of the human eye's flaws. Presumably, if performed with a Gemstone Staff, its illusions would become even more deranging.
Desc_798.cn: 金睛玄虎棒法厚重而不失迅捷，刚勇而不失巧妙，障眼法极多，若能以宝石杖施为，更能施展出无数耀眼生花之制敌奇技。

Desc_799.en: Consisting of 81 subtle moves, each with 9 variants, the impeccable Penglai Ruler enables its practitioner to penetrate some of the most solid defenses with uncatchable maneuvers.
Desc_799.cn: 蓬莱仙尺招式精奇，共有九九八十一式，每式且有九种不同的变化，施展开来似有若无，来去无踪，可谓无懈可击，难挡难防。
Desc_799.ru: Безупречная линейка Пэнлай, состоящая из 81 тонкого движения, каждое из которых имеет 9 вариантов, позволяет практикующему проникать в самые надежные системы защиты с помощью неуловимых маневров.

Desc_800.en: Mighty and upright figures in legends are often referred to as a "beam holding up the sea" by storytellers, just like the practitioner of this technique. The Beam of Sea technique endows a staff wielder with unparalleled skill and might to brandish a hefty weapon with ease.
Desc_800.cn: 正所谓：“擎天白玉柱，架海紫金梁”。架海神杖神勇无比，力大无穷，以之运使千斤重杖，如臂使指，举重若轻，其运劲法门无比独特，世间罕有。

Desc_801.en: Originating from the secret smithing techniques of the Swordsmith Villa, the Primordial Iron Staff technique is at the same time mighty yet subtle, forming endless cycles of Yin and Yang with its dominating yet refined moves.
Desc_801.cn: 浑元铁棒法脱胎于铸剑山庄之锻铁神技，不仅威猛雄强，而且精奥奇妙，运杖环环相扣，循环无端，杖力非柔非刚，阴阳二气并有，浑元如一。

Desc_802.en: This technique is light, quick, and clever to boot. Its movements to the left and right can be divided up into the generating and overcoming interactions of the Five Elements. If the left and right are complementary then they end like a spear; if not, then they are difficult to predict.
Desc_802.cn: 五行刺轻快迅速，灵活巧妙，左右双刺可分含不同的五行生克变化，左右互为相克则双刺变幻难料；左右互为相生则双刺锋芒陡长。

Desc_803.en: It is said that "seeing them, they are like a gentle lady, attacking them, they become a fearsome tiger." This technique's moves are difficult to detect, and they look like they are utterly bereft of force, but it is in fact the counterattacks that one should watch out for; they are devilishly quick.
Desc_803.cn: 有道是：“见之似好妇，夺之似惧虎”。失魂刺招式隐蔽，极难察觉，行止间看似柔弱无力，实则反击之势异常迅疾，敌人难免猝不及防，惊惶而失魂。

Desc_804.en: This technique is light and graceful and as gentle as a babe in inaction yet like a hare set loose in action. The practitioner will evade when the opponent attacks, and pursue when the opponent retreats, leaving the opponent no room to breathe.
Desc_804.cn: 美人刺轻灵柔活，曼妙多姿，静如处女，动若脱兔，出手即让以避其锐气，敌收即随以击其惰归，始终不骄不躁，若即若离。

Desc_805.en: As venomous as a two-headed snake, as fierce as a twin-tailed scorpion. This technique is fast like lightning or a meteor. This unique art of Exotic Weapons targets specific points on the opponents' legs.
Desc_805.cn: “毒似两头蛇，狠如双尾蝎”。灵蛇刺快如闪电，迅比流星，乃是专攻敌人膝、趺、趾、踵的奇门刺法，双锥青芒时时入地，婉如灵蛇刻刻盘旋。

Desc_806.en: This technique is as fast as lightning, making concealing their attack no great feat for the practitioner. It is said that "If I am unseen, what technique can you use on me? what move can't I employ?"
Desc_806.cn: 化影刺难躲难让，从无捉摸，快如电光火石，尤擅藏形化影，正所谓：“以彼之有形当我之无形，彼何功可施，我何式可寻”。
Desc_806.ru: Эта техника быстра как молния, что делает сокрытие их Атаки не таким уж большим подвигом для практикующего. Сказано: "Если я невидим, какую технику вы можете применить ко мне? какой прием я не могу использовать?"

Desc_807.en: This unique art of the Emei Sect derives its name from the following: "casting away rampant thoughts and meditating, meditating leads to happiness, happiness leads to wisdom, and ends in tranquility unobstructed."
Desc_807.cn: 定慧神针乃峨眉派僧门之绝技，所谓“定慧”，乃是“由摈弃杂思而入定，由入定而生妙乐，由妙乐而生智慧，终于舍念清静，再无阻碍”之意。

Desc_808.en: This graceful technique seems formless to the extent that opponents don't even see the attacks coming. If you don't see the attack, it's already too late. Likewise for its defense, if you don't see it, how can you find a way around it?
Desc_808.cn: 玉女刺高姿飘然，迷离无形，人不见其所攻，亦不见其所守，未见其攻其已攻，未见其守其已守，来无影，去无踪，如鬼魅，似灵梭。

Desc_809.en: This technique requires one's Qi from Hunyuan. "With desire, but a sliver can be seen; without desire, all is on display. When it wants to move, earth and heaven have not yet formed." This technique is formless, and its way has no excess.
Desc_809.cn: 金顶仙针乃是以浑元内气所发，讲究：“有欲观窍，无欲观妙，一念欲动处，天地未形时”，其力无形无相，其法无欠无余。

Desc_810.en: Although this technique is called a "spell," it's not evil sorcery. This technique merely transfers the practitioner's Qi to the opponent's feet, so that they fall and hurt themselves.
Desc_810.cn: 跌打梅山咒虽名为“咒法”，却非江湖术士之邪异法术，乃是驱使内劲传自敌人足下而令其跌倒受伤的独门秘传之技。
Desc_810.ru: Хотя эта техника называется "заклинанием", это не злое колдовство. Эта техника просто переносит Ци практикующего на ноги противника, так что он падает и ушибается.

Desc_811.en: This skill is able to employ Qi to attack opponents. If the victim is not determined enough, the Qi will enter their body and leave them paralyzed, as if trapped by a spell.
Desc_811.cn: 定身法能以极猛烈之心念内气冲击敌人，中者若定力不足，极易陷入身体麻痹，失措神离之状态，仿佛遭到法术定身一般。
Desc_811.ru: Этот навык позволяет использовать Ци для Атаки противников. Если жертва недостаточно решительна, Ци войдет в ее тело и оставит ее парализованной, как будто в ловушке заклинания.

Desc_812.en: This technique can even subdue demons and ghosts with its ancient and odd energy that it emits, which doesn't deal damage to opponents, which makes it even more odd and astonishing. It is said that "astonishment leads to chaotic Qi," and for victims of this technique, it is indeed the Qi that inevitably results in their demise.
Desc_812.cn: 惊鬼符可降妖镇鬼，且能发出极古怪之内劲，此内劲虽于敌身无害，但诡异非常，无比骇人，有道是“惊则气乱”，中者不免气冲颅脑而亡。

Desc_813.en: Five thunders, 3,000 generals. Thunder flows over eight barbarian hordes, fire covers the earth, and turns demons into ashes. This exotic technique concentrates True Qi in the hands, feet, and heart to then shoot electricity, demolishing the enemy.
Desc_813.cn: “五雷三千将，雷流八蛮兵，火光烧世界，邪魔化灰尘”。五雷招来咒乃是聚真气于手、足、心口，迸发电光与强力而摧灭敌人之奇术。

Desc_814.en: This secret technique of the Ranshan Sect is also known as the "Secret Wish of Six Heavenly Stems." The wish is as follows: "Lin bing dou zhe, jie lie zhen qian xing (Those ready to fight line up in formation)." This technique's genuine power is something of a mystery, although when unlocked, it is unrivaled.
Desc_814.cn: 九字真言咒乃然山派之破敌秘法，亦称“六甲秘祝”，祝曰：“临兵斗者，皆阵列前行”，此九字秘祝真力，玄奥无比，无所不辟。

Desc_815.en: The "wooden noble" refers to the noble in the east. This technique's power is miraculous. Originally formed from the innate Qi of the Eastern Emperor, this technique can bind all demons and evil spirits. The victims of this technique will find that they are no longer able to move, speak, or think. Even their spirit will be arrested in place.
Desc_815.cn: 所谓“木公”，乃“东王公”也。木公咒神通广大，由先天东华之气所化，能缚一切妖邪魔异，中此咒者，身不能动，口不能言，意不能转，神不能变。

Desc_816.en: The momentum of this technique is oddly immense, and its movement rolls like thunder. It can rend any trap lain by ghost or demon asunder, indeed strange obstacles of any demonic nature.
