Desc_816.cn: “西真七白，华光金德，焚妖斩逆，绝汝鬼迹，急急速速，扬威戮力”。七白破身法声势奇大，动如雷霆，能破一切妖迷鬼困，魔障怪墙。
Desc_816.ru: Импульс этой техники странно огромен, и ее движение раскатывается подобно грому. Он может разорвать на части любую ловушку, расставленную призраком или демоном, действительно, странные препятствия любой демонической природы.

Desc_817.en: With the power to move the nine celestial bodies and to harness their power, verily this technique is mighty. It can turn iron and stone into dust, and it can vanquish demons as well as the darkness.
Desc_817.cn: 九星金光咒能动九曜之力，发九星之华精，此咒威力无比，神化无穷，能消石成粉，化铁成灰，除九万八千五百种恶鬼，扫万物之暗晦。
Desc_817.ru: Обладая способностью перемещать девять небесных тел и использовать их силу, эта техника поистине могущественна. Он может превращать железо и камень в пыль, и он может побеждать демонов так же, как и тьму.

Desc_818.en: Boundlessly profound, this book of seals is replete with spells and methods that amalgamate the divine as one, returning everything to its origin, to nothingness.
Desc_818.cn: 符解神通奥秘无穷，微妙真空，乃书万符于一符，敕万咒于一咒，融万法于一法，化万神于一神，返一切于本元，解一切于虚无。
Desc_818.ru: Безгранично глубокая, эта книга печатей изобилует заклинаниями и методами, которые объединяют божественное в единое целое, возвращая все к его истокам, к небытию.

Desc_819.en: Powerful and sturdy, this technique's strikes are fierce, able to turn stone into dust and to leave marks on iron. Relying on a wild bravery, it is able to shatter the opponent's skeleton with one blow.
Desc_819.cn: 碎石杵刚强有力，攻势猛烈，击石能成粉，撞铁能生痕，乃是全凭一股蛮勇之力而发，一旦为其击中，骨骼必然断折。

Desc_820.en: This technique makes heavy use of defense in dealing with enemies. The practitioner of this technique's pestle is steady and powerful. This technique's attacks are quite unique, as they first aim at protecting the body before using fearsome strength to flatten the opponent.
Desc_820.cn: 护法金刚杵多以守势应敌，杵势沉稳坚强，牢固如钢铁，其攻敌之技尤其特别，乃是先护住全身，再以蛮力推压敌人，虽攻仍守，不失慎重。

Desc_821.en: This technique is truly a fearsome sight to behold as the practitioner first leaps quickly at the opponent, attacking them fiercely "Like a mad tiger pouncing, it falls like a ghost stealing souls."
Desc_821.cn: 罗刹杵法气势汹汹，十分猛恶，出手必先疾奔猛跃，攻势格外凌厉凶狠，正是：“其起似疯虎之扑人，其落若恶鬼之夺魂”。
Desc_821.ru: Эта техника представляет собой поистине устрашающее зрелище, поскольку практикующий сначала быстро прыгает на противника, яростно Атак его, "Как бешеный тигр набрасывается, он падает, как призрак, крадущий души".

Desc_822.en: This technique has 18 moves in total, and they are fearsome, heavy-handed, formidable and can destroy anything the practitioner sets their gaze upon. The movements of the practitioner are like that of an enraged Vajra. It has been remarked that the practitioners of this technique possess "the fierce visage of the Vajra and the resounding might of a thunderclap."
Desc_822.cn: 怒目金刚杵共有十八式，威猛厚重，力大无比，刚强可畏，无可摧毁，行功即示现金刚之忿怒状，可谓：“金刚之怒目，霹雳之手段”也。

Desc_823.en: This technique's name is a reference to the Wisdom King of the Wheel. The practitioner of this technique has the ability to destroy creatures of evil, and they possess the wisdom and virtue to dispel confusion and relieve disasters. The practitioner uses moves nonstop just like the great wheel of the dharma never stops turning.
Desc_823.cn: 大轮金刚乃“转法轮明王”也。大轮金刚杵有摧毁业障之法力，有断惑息灾之智德，行止忿怒狰狞，运杵轰如雷鸣，招式循环无断，法相圆转如轮。

Desc_824.en: This technique is as ferocious and mighty as they come. It is able to subdue demons, and thus it is referred to as the great might, for it is tasked with protecting good from evil. It is also referred to as the great virtue, and happens to possess 34 moves as well as the ways of speech, intention, and livelihood, thus symbolizing the Bodhisattva's 37 Ways.
Desc_824.cn: 大威德金刚杵凶猛至极，威力巨大，能降服恶魔，故称大威，有护善之功，故称大德，共有三十四式与身、语、意三法，象征菩萨之三十七道品。

Desc_825.en: This technique is profound and abstruse with innumerable variations. Legend has it that there are 8,000 moves, 7 main styles, and 50 billion variations. Like the treasured tree of lore, it has seven treasure flowers, seven treasure nets, and 50 billion flower palaces.
Desc_825.cn: 如意宝树杵精微古奥，变化万千，传说有八千招式，七大行法，五百亿种变化，好似如意宝树，有七宝花叶，七重宝网，五百亿间妙花宫殿。

Desc_826.en: The Immovable Wisdom King, Acala, is the most revered among the Wisdom Kings, and thus this technique is the pinnacle of the Pestle Arts. Its might is great, unyielding, and cannot be shaken. The body of the practitioner is perfect with its enraged visage that can scare off even the most fearsome of demons.
Desc_826.cn: 不动明王乃诸明王之至尊，不动明王杵乃诸杵法之至极，其力至大至刚，无可撼动，身相圆满，极忿怒形，能降伏吓退一切魔障。

Desc_827.en: Whoever holds a horsetail whisk must not be an everyman. Being a special weapon of the Taoists, the Horsetail Whisk has its ways derived from the Taoism. Its unconstrained moves are all performed in a continuous, intuitive stream.
Desc_827.cn: 有道是：“手拿拂尘不是凡人”。拂尘乃道门之法器，拂尘功亦自道法而生，首重自然洒脱，以“绵绵不断，一气呵成”为运用之要诀。

Desc_828.en: A unique Martial Art of Wudang Sect that endows gentleness with strength, the Wudang Iron Whisk technique enables one to land forceful strikes with a horsetail whisk like wielding iron weapons.
Desc_828.cn: 武当铁拂尘能以至柔之拂尘发出坚逾钢铁，重达百斤的刚强劲力，乃是虽柔亦刚，寓刚于柔的武当派独门拂尘功法。
Desc_828.ru: Уникальная Боевая техника Секты Удан, которая придает мягкость Силе, техника железного венчика Удан позволяет наносить мощные удары венчиком из хвоща, как при использовании железного Оружия.

Desc_829.en: Consisting of 6 styles demonstrating various interactions of Yin and Yang, each providing 6 moves, the Dualism Whisk Style enables its practitioner to handily launch trains of interlocking and ingenious attacks at their opponent.
Desc_829.cn: 两仪拂尘功分“独阴、独阳、和合、互易、浊清、显藏”六法共三十六式，招式精巧多变，阴阳并济，节节相连，环环如扣。

Desc_830.en: Tao has too many faces to be identified. Versatile and profound, the technique seemingly animates any horsetail whisk in its practitioner's hand; each of its threads is brought to full play, making its attacks harder to predict.
Desc_830.cn: “道亦形变，谁能识真”。老君拂尘功变幻莫测，古朴精深，以之运使拂尘，拂尘便似化为有灵之物，有千万根柔丝便有千万般变化。

Desc_831.en: An especially peculiar set of whisk unique arts even among the Exotic Arts, which surprises the enemy with counter-intuitive attacks. A gentle wave may land like the slash of a sword, while a violent swing may actually entangle and restrain, like a snake.
Desc_831.cn: 错倒阴阳拂尘无比特异：“视之如青丝，着身如利剑；视之如铁尺，着身似灵蛇”，无法以常理预测，乃是颠倒刚柔之形，错乱阴阳之力的奇门拂尘绝技。

Desc_832.en: Unfettered and incessant, the Taiyi Sweep boasts a powerful and unconstrained style. Creating attack opportunities out of thin air, its practitioners can subdue their opponent without even touching them.
Desc_832.cn: 太乙云拂功飘逸自然，连绵不断，似高山之流水，若天马之行空，精微奥妙，变化无穷，招式不拘形迹，可化无为有，隔空制敌。

Desc_833.en: Like the sweeping wind heralds a rising storm in the mountains, the whipping of Infinite Sweep brings havoc to the battlefield. Contrary to the gentle and spiritual nature of a horsetail whisk, it is a technique with unfathomable power, capable of delivering devastating blows.
Desc_833.cn: 无量扫尘功凝重刚烈，一反拂尘之轻柔性灵，一举一动皆有“山雨欲来风满楼”之势，运力深沉似渊水，不动如山岳，力达千钧，威力巨大。

Desc_834.en: The void is formless and unfathomable, just like the Way itself. With no beginning or end, the technique of Void Sweep is said to be inspired directly by the profound Tao. Its moves reinforce each other and beget each other, enabling infinite tactics.
Desc_834.cn: “玄者，道也，然道体无形，故曰空”。玄空神拂玄奇深奥，从道而生，无师无祖，无始无终，招式可自相生生化化，所以有无极无穷之用也。

Desc_835.en: Versatile and snappy, the Krait Whip Art encompasses every basic move of a whip. Its name comes from the coiling movements and golden flashes accompanying it, just like a sly Banded Krait.
Desc_835.cn: 黄鳞鞭法灵活多变，干脆利落，包含了“正、反、平、斜”诸般五花鞭技之要义，收放盘绕似金环长蛇，故名“黄鳞”。
Desc_835.ru: Универсальное и быстрое искусство Кнута Krait включает в себя каждое базовое движение Кнута. Его название происходит от извивающихся движений и сопровождающих их золотистых вспышек, совсем как у хитрого полосатого крайта.

Desc_836.en: With succinct stance and intensive movements, the Centipede Twine enables one to control their whip with Qi and attack from extremely tricky angles, like a centipede slithering into every nook and corner.
Desc_836.cn: 蜈蚣索架势极小，抖钻极快，因其招式快密，且能以内力操纵鞭梢自极刁钻的角度袭击敌人，故以“蜈蚣”为名，谓其好似蜈蚣之钻爬，无孔不入。

Desc_837.en: For the Five Immortals Sect members, poisonous creatures are commonly thought to be divine, especially spiders, snakes, scorpions, toads, and centipedes, which are exalted as "Poison Sages." Inspired by their predatory behavior, the Whip Art of Poison Sages combines their strength and endows the practitioner with astonishing versatility.
Desc_837.cn: “蛛、蛇、蝎、蟾、蜈”即五仙教之“五圣”也。五圣鞭法乃是模仿五种毒物之不同形态而创，集五大特征于一体，可谓动静攻防兼备，刚柔阴阳并有。

Desc_838.en: Fierce and swift, this whip technique is far more vicious than ordinary blades ever can be. Anyone it hits will have their flesh stripped off and bones shattered, as if cut by a saw blade or snagged by a hook.
Desc_838.cn: 勾魂碎骨鞭凌厉迅疾，凶恶异常，力道之狠辣远胜寻常刀枪剑戟，中者仿佛身受锯刃之切割，尖钩之撕扯，皮肉无不破裂，筋骨无不断折。

Desc_839.en: An ancient secret technique of the Miao people handed down to the present day, Chiyou's Iron Whip lacks any sleight of hand or winding up, yet its practitioners are capable of launching abrupt assaults with immense power.
Desc_839.cn: 蚩尤铁鞭乃苗人自古秘传之奇技，既无盘转舞花，亦无抡旋蓄力，但说发便发，说起便起，能将一条软鞭使的直入直出，抖声如雷，发出千斤之巨力。

Desc_840.en: With each of your moves, there shall come one change to the flow of battle. Hold still like a flower, ready to bloom, and release your attack like an off-season flowering. Intricate and flamboyant, the Jade-shattering Twine destroys the enemy with astounding alacrity.
Desc_840.cn: 破玉索快疾如风，乃盘花鞭技之至极，诀曰：“花接花，花套花，一动一变，一变一花，收如含苞待放花形犹在，放如花开并蒂处处是花”。

Desc_841.en: A technique unique to the Five Immortals Sect of the Miao land, the Azure Web is light and fast, exquisite and delicate, enabling one to rise high into the air and restrain their opponent tightly like a spider spitting webs with nimble, incessant movements.
Desc_841.cn: 仙蛛擒蟒功轻盈柔活，快密无影，精奇绝伦，巧妙无比，能似仙蛛一般夭矫腾空，以飞丝走线之奇技擒缚敌人，乃苗疆五仙教之独门秘传也。

Desc_842.en: Bashe the Big Snake eats elephants, and after three years, it disgorges their bones. As ferocious as the name indicates, the Bashe Whip technique overcomes the enemy like the legendary python devours behemoths.
Desc_842.cn: “巴龙，大蛇也，巴龙之大，可以食象，三岁方出其骨”。巴龙神鞭雄强无比，凶猛绝伦，有龙腾虎蹴之威，有移山吞象之力。

Desc_843.en: Having been handed down for so long that no one knows its origins, the Sky Serpent Twine is the ultimate secret technique enshrined by the Five Immortals Sect of the Miao lands. Beguiling human eyes with ever-changing moves, it can even disrupt the opponent's sense of time.
Desc_843.cn: 天蛇索传自上古，起源已无可溯究，乃苗疆五仙教之不世绝秘。天蛇索绝技神变无方，幻化无穷，进似未至实已至，退似未归实已归。

Desc_844.en: This unique technique of the Valley of Flowers is able to use Qi to manipulate fine needles and administer them to the opponent's acupoints. Although this was born out of acupuncture and moxibustion and thus was meant to save lives, it can also take them without spilling a drop of blood.
Desc_844.cn: 御针之术乃百花谷之独门手法，能以内力隔空操纵细针，使之分毫不差的施于敌人周身大穴，虽是脱胎于救人的针灸医术，却也能杀人而不见半滴鲜血。

Desc_845.en: This technique has 5 methods for sealing acupoints: "metal, wood, water, fire, and earth." Only by using a method that generates and overcomes the element used to seal the acupoint can a victim of this technique be saved.
Desc_845.cn: 五行梅花针施针极快，变化极多，共有“金、木、水、火、土”五种不同的闭穴针法，遭此五针而封闭之穴道，亦需施以相应的生克针法方能救治。

Desc_846.en: This technique can take Yin Qi and transform it into ice needles that pierce the enemy's acupoints. These ice needles cut off the meridians as soon as they enter the body. If they enter a tendon or bone, only extremely unorthodox techniques can be used to save the victim.
Desc_846.cn: 寒冰刺骨法能以异常绵密之纯阴内气化成冰针刺入敌身穴道，此冰针无形有质，一旦入体便即截断穴脉，附于筋骨之上，非寻常手法可以解救。

Desc_847.en: This technique is especially difficult to learn as the acupoints that it targets are ones that few know about. Although this technique has mostly been all but forgotten, it still has its mysteries and profundities yet to be discovered and understood.
Desc_847.cn: 扁鹊神针乃扁鹊遗技，尤其艰涩难学，其所刺之穴位尽在罕有人知的无名奇脉，经外奇穴。此技法虽已亡佚十之七八，但仍可谓古奥精奇，神乎其技。

Desc_848.en: This technique's might is great indeed, as is its ability to kill. The acupoints it strikes are not sealed, but rather opened. The victims' Primordial Qi flows out from these points. If not counteracted soon enough, their Qi will be expelled in short order.
Desc_848.cn: 破元长针威力极大，杀伤力极强，中针之穴道并不封闭，反而洞开，中者周身元气由此倾泻而出，若不及时施救，毕生功力必尽散失于此一针之下。

Desc_849.en: This technique's name is derived from "Of those that have fallen under this technique's needle, all are the dead. Even if one does not die right away, there is no hope of living." Thus this technique only takes lives, it doesn't save them. It only kills and doesn't leave anyone alive.
Desc_849.cn: 所谓“针死不针活”，意为：“此针法之下只有死人，纵使中者一时未死，也绝无活命可能”，乃是有杀无救，有死无生之绝针也。

Desc_850.en: This unique technique of the Valley of Flowers uses six inner Qi flows to operate nine needles. It is miraculous without compare, with many imitators. The nine needles can enter separately or as one, depending on the circumstances.
Desc_850.cn: 六弦九针术乃是以六道无形内气同时操纵九支长针的百花谷独门秘技。此术精妙无比，变化如神，九针既可分进，亦可合击，如知人意，恍若通灵。

Desc_851.en: This technique does not manipulate acupoints, nor does it sever blood vessels, rather the needles employed flow throughout the body's meridians, allowing them to damage all acupoints they pass through. This technique is able to destroy all of an opponent's meridians in short order.
Desc_851.cn: 化脉神针既非点穴，亦非截血，其所发之细针能随人体周身经脉游动，所经之诸穴无不受损，乃是能一举化灭敌人全身经脉之化脉奇法。

Desc_852.en: This technique uses Qi to manipulate countless needles along 12 inner Qi flows to attack the body's 72 primary acupoints, as well as 36 nameless acupoints. This is the pinnacle of the Exotic Arts of the Valley of Flowers, and it truly has no equal in the world.
Desc_852.cn: 十二弦奇针功能以十二道无形内气同时操纵无数长针刺击人身七十二处大穴与三十六处无名奇穴，可谓天下无双，入圣通神，乃百花谷御针奇术之绝诣也。

Desc_853.en: Stealthy and quick to launch, the Sparrow in Sleeve requires only a few steps to assemble. Once launched, each shot can split into several small darts, targeting the enemy's hands, feet, neck, and eyes.
Desc_853.cn: 袖里飞燕招式隐秘，施放迅速，仅需极少的步骤即可组合完成，且能于飞出后分散为数支细小短镖，分点敌人手、足、颈、目。

Desc_854.en: Although easy to assemble due to its simple structure, the Rending Hook is a brutal gadget that unfolds into a thorny shape with barbs that tear the enemy's flesh open, inflicting unbearable agony.
Desc_854.cn: 错骨钩虽然结构简单，易于组配，但招式狠辣，功用残忍，刺入敌身之后便能展开化作八面有刺之倒钩状，中者皮开肉裂，筋穿骨错，苦不堪言。
Desc_854.ru: Несмотря на то, что раздирающий крюк прост в сборке из-за своей простой конструкции, он представляет собой жестокое приспособление, которое складывается в колючую форму с зазубринами, которые разрывают плоть врага, причиняя невыносимую боль.

Desc_855.en: Designed to capture the enemy alive, the Pentalock is an interlocking gadget consisting of intricate parts. Although its lethality is limited, its exquisite design makes it excruciating to disassemble unless following specific instructions.
Desc_855.cn: 五子连环扣旨在生擒敌人，乃是由众多部件结成五锁相连之形状而成，虽杀伤力有限，但设计精密无比，若非按特殊顺序依次拆卸绝难解开。

Desc_856.en: With its peculiar structure, the Loong Claw Chain operates by adhering a set of elaborate rules. It can be coiled on one's arm to launch devastating attacks by simply lifting up one's hand. The victim will suffer grievous injury as if mauled by a tiger.
Desc_856.cn: 奇形龙爪索不仅结构特异，运转巧妙，而且力量极大，破坏力惊人，可盘于臂上，抬手即发，中者如受狮虎扑击，轻则骨骼断折，重则裂肺掏心。

Desc_857.en: The machine is ingenious indeed; yet the concept is even more brilliant. Made up of more than 100 delicate strings and 36 sets of mechanisms, the Omnisnare is capable of automatically operating according to the relative positions of the practitioner and their enemy.
Desc_857.cn: 天罗地网由百余道细索及三十六组机簧组合而成，不仅构造无比巧妙，且可依循宫阵方位之变化而收发，可谓：“器既坚利，法亦精奇”。

Desc_858.en: Consisting of 18 parts and measuring three chi and six fen long, the lock is a mighty battle machine that suppresses the opponent with immense weight. Whoever is bound will lose any capability or will to escape.
Desc_858.cn: 泰山锁长三尺六分，由十八个部件组成，能发巨力，威力奇强，中者如泰山压于顶，铅铁灌于身，无不伏地待毙，束手就擒。

Desc_859.en: Lu Ban constructed a bird from bamboo and wood and flew when complete, staying aloft for three days. Although not as enduring as the legendary engineer and carpenter's work, the Yellow Loong Kite is capable of various airborne maneuvers, including throwing flames from its talons and beak at its opponent.
Desc_859.cn: “公输子削竹木以为鹊，成而飞之，三日不下”。黄龙木鸢虽无“三日不下”之神异，但能飞能旋，迅猛无比，爪喙可发炽热烈火，所指无不焚为焦炭。

Desc_860.en: A wooden dummy with arms and legs like a human, its soul tempered by fresh blood, its body infused with Genuine Power. It can wield a sword, as well as throw stones. A work that can only be done by someone who has decoded the Heaven's Mechanism.
Desc_860.cn: 巧工作木人，手足俱齐全，以热血漆心，以真力贯顶，能执剑，能投石，恍如有生，此乃巧夺天工，鬼设神施之技，名称“天枢玄机”之法也。

Desc_861.en: A marvel of craftsmanship, composed of 99,999 intricate parts. It can transform into eight types of fortifications, eight battlefield machines, and eight humanoid constructs. As a fortress, it builds and defends; as a war machine, it shields armies; in its human form, it bends to countless wills.
Desc_861.cn: 神工如意塔共九万九千九百九十九个部件组成，能变作八种“城器”、八种“阵器”、八种“人器”，城器者，可建城拔寨；阵器者，可供卫千军；人器者，可万般如意。

Desc_862.en: This song is melodious and relaxing. It rises and falls while maintaining clarity. At first, it's like a gentle breeze, then it transforms into an ocean wave, and gradually into a sea of clouds.
Desc_862.cn: 云水引悠扬自然，洒脱自如，曲调疾缓相间，高低分明，初如清风徐来，水波不兴，渐而浩如云海，壮如波涛，汹涌不可抵御。
Desc_862.ru: Эта песня мелодичная и расслабляющая. Он поднимается и опускается, сохраняя при этом ясность. Сначала это похоже на легкий ветерок, затем превращается в океанскую волну и постепенно в море облаков.

Desc_863.en: This song is flexible and attractive, yet at times it gurgles. At others, it's drawn out, like this it slows down and speeds up in a carefree manner. It has been described as "a meal with a fine liquor, you wouldn't think to return home."
Desc_863.cn: 不思归啸傲风月，洋洋洒洒，曲声时而汩汩争奔走，时而悠悠浅自流，快慢随意，自在逍遥，正是：“一酌误人千日酒，醉埋荒冢不思归”。

Desc_864.en: The flute has almost finished its crescendo, and the Fenghuang has arrived. High-pitched and clear, the tune is harmonious like the Fenghuang and is truly inspiring to hear. It is able to dispel darkness and gloom.
Desc_864.cn: “箫韶九成，凤凰来仪”。凤来仪曲调高亢，清亮透彻，似凤凰和鸣锵锵铮铮，闻之鼓舞人心，暗霾尽祛，其声有腾跃九州，扬至四海之能。

Desc_865.en: As it rises, it is like notes of guqin dancing before flowers. As it falls, it is like drums that resound like a marching army. From time to time, it lingers; at others, it stirs the soul, attracting you like a moth to a flame.
Desc_865.cn: 玉妃引起时如琴瑟和鸣，花前舞霓裳，落时如鼙鼓同声，惊破千军师，时而缠绵迤逦，只道女儿心思，时而惊心动魄，却述飞蛾扑火，自取灭亡的痴心情长。

Desc_866.en: Gentle, soft, and sung low, it goes on without end. It is so melodious and divine it is almost like picking jade flowers.
Desc_866.cn: 琼花叹婉转阴柔，浅唱而低吟，谱曲绵绵不尽，引扬州风月和而歌之，采枝上新琼为尔成词，其情也深深，其意也切切。
Desc_866.ru: Нежная, негромкая и исполняемая вполголоса, она продолжается без конца. Это так мелодично и божественно, что почти все равно что собирать цветы из Нефрита.

Desc_867.en: In the haze, the past is like a fond dream. This technique is ethereal, yet free and natural. In the Valley of Flowers, Orchid Grass are used to bury the white deers, this song is played, and those who listen feel as if they are entering a dream.
Desc_867.cn: “一切迷离里，往事作南柯”。葬鹿兰飘渺出尘，空灵悠远，乃是百花谷以兰草埋葬死去的白鹿时所奏之挽歌，闻者如入梦中，难分虚实有无。

Desc_868.en: Since heaven and earth split, it has been several thousand chi, yet I lift my glass to the sky and smile, the setting sun smiles back westward every day. This technique is vast, clear as a bell, and within it, the Tao of Heaven and Earth and the logic behind prosperity and decline are contained. It is said that to know it is to understand heaven and earth, life and death.
Desc_868.cn: “自从天地开，更长几千尺，举杯向天笑，天回日西照”。天地笑苍茫轩昂，黄钟大吕，涵天地之道于其中，盖盛衰之理于其内，谓知此曲而知天、地、生、死也。

Desc_869.en: What are the feelings of men? They are joy, anger, sadness, fear, love, dislike, and affection. Upon hearing the bizarre Melody of Emotions, one can't help but experience a tumult of inner feelings, and become emotionally disturbed by the time the music stops.
Desc_869.cn: 所谓七情：“喜、怒、忧、惧、爱、憎、欲”。七情曲扑朔迷离，诡奇多变，初闻此曲者即生患得患失，亦喜亦忧之感，待得七情曲终，闻者无不情思错杂，百感共乱。

Desc_870.en: Qingping Melody is an ancient piece of music that has been handed down for generations since the Tang Dynasty. Whoever listens to it will lose control of their body and become lost in memories even after the music stops. The more emotional one is, the deeper they will be haunted by this song.
Desc_870.cn: 清平调乃唐朝遗曲，曲音百转千回，悲愤沉郁，闻者四肢不主，恍如堕入前尘往世之中，纵是曲终，亦不能自拔，越是有情之人，陷入此曲越深。

Desc_871.en: Rattling the human soul's very foundation, the Song of Torn Souls can continue to play and linger in the air. It is so melancholic that it sounds like a continuous sigh of sorrow or like a ceaseless weeping fueled by grief.
Desc_871.cn: 断魂幽吟曲共有胎光、爽灵、幽精三段，每段又分尸狗、伏矢、雀阴、吞贼、非毒、除秽、臭肺七种变化，其声呜呜然，如怨如慕，如泣如诉，余音袅袅，不绝如缕。

Desc_872.en: With fond hopes Queen Mother keeps her windows open. She hears only the song Huangzhu mournfully resounding over the earth. 'With eight steeds running 30,000 li a day, what is keeping King Mu from coming a second time?' Distant and woeful, the Huangzhu Melody tears the listener's heart open with the sorrows of the Queen Mother of the West.
Desc_872.cn: 黄竹歌曲调低沉，遥不可及，曲中绵绵不绝地述说着西王母候穆王而不至的相思与哀愁，正是：“瑶池阿母绮窗开，黄竹歌声动地哀，八骏日行三万里，穆王何事不重来”。

Desc_873.en: When Emperor Shun suddenly died during a trip to Cangwu, the tears of his two concubines fell onto surrounding bamboo and stained it forever. The Damsel's Woe is a sad and haunting piece of music, and those who hear it can't help but feel torn inside by mournfulness until their hearts and souls ultimately break.
Desc_873.cn: “舜崩，二妃啼，以涕挥竹，竹尽斑”。湘女泣苍梧哀婉幽怨，思绪缠绵，闻此曲者，不由得悲从中来，终于肝肠寸断，心神俱伤。

Desc_874.en: Legend has it that the song was originally performed by three immortal maidens (Yunxiao, Qiongxiao, and Bixiao) from above the sky. An extremely sensual tune, this melody bewilders anyone who hears this song with all manner of desires, and from then on they are controlled by the musician and become a walking corpse.
Desc_874.cn: 传说三霄迷仙曲乃“云霄、琼霄、碧霄”三宵娘娘所合奏。此曲情色迷浪，风风韵韵，闻此曲者，无不意乱情迷，神思不能自已，从此为奏曲者所驱策，而成行尸走肉。

Desc_875.en: Chang'e must regret stealing the pill of longevity, and now she grieves alone night after night in the sky. Bleak and hazy, this piece of music makes whoever hears it feel as if they're in the Guanghan Palace until they become numb from the bitterness, losing all hope.
Desc_875.cn: “嫦娥应悔偷灵药，碧海青天夜夜心”。广寒歌朦胧苍凉，寂寂清清，闻此曲者，犹如身在广寒，凄入肝脾，冷入心肠，终于麻木不仁，不知何去何从也。

Desc_876.en: Composed by a lady from long ago named Tushan Jiao, who fell in love with the legendary Emperor Yu, this song has only one repeating line consisting of four syllables meaning simply "I'm waiting for someone." Nonetheless, it's capable of touching even the most distant heart.
Desc_876.cn: 候人兮猗出自远古涂山氏女娇，此曲虽仅有“候、人、兮、猗”四个字音，但字字发于心声，动于至情，乃是痴言，乃是蜜语，乃是“直道相思了无益，未妨惆怅是清狂”。

Desc_877.en: Emperor Shaohao requests Sunü the Immortal to play Se, an instrument with 50 strings; yet he can't help but becomes overcome by woe upon hearing it, so he removed 25 strings. The Empyrean Tune is a legendary piece of music handed down from times long past. The cosmic sorrow within defies description and can't be unheard, hence the name "Empyrean."
Desc_877.cn: “太帝使素女鼓五十弦瑟，悲，帝禁不止，故破其瑟为二十五弦”。素女天音乃上古遗音，起如天地悲鸣，落似万念成灰，其音无法可述，无法可解，故称“天音”。

Desc_878.en: A secret manual containing the Martial Art of Celestial Pivot's Profound Mechanism.\nIn addition to the obscure original text, the manual is densely packed with many notes in its margins, most of which are in foster father's handwriting.
Desc_878.cn: 记载有《天枢玄机》功法的秘本。\n除了晦涩难懂的秘本原文，书中还密密麻麻地写着许多注解，其中大部分乃是义父的笔迹。
